Title: Decision Scientist, Payments Intelligence
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As a Decision Scientist, you will work in a cross-functional Payments Intelligence team that supports all Payments Business Unit across different domains. This role is part of the Data Science & Analytics (DSA) function, reporting to the DSA Manager for Payments Intelligence. You will play a key role in shaping our payments products by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making.

Currently, Payments is a quickly growing business area, which brings its own challenges and opportunities. To be successful and satisfied in this role, you need to be comfortable with a fast pace and continuous change. In return, you get to build something really big together with other driven and caring colleagues.

In this position, you’ll


Partner with your team and stakeholders at Vinted, to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations, as well as answer critical business questions.
Test and analyse developed opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools
Select, calculate, and monitor key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact
Familiarity with SQL and Python
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Fluent in English, both written and spoken


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€69.600—€100.100 EUR

Title: Fraud Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay

Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content.

Role Overview

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

Key Responsibilities


Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.
Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time.
Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.


Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.

Title: Marketing Data Analyst (18-month contract)
Description:
Our Story

Founded in 2009, we're one of the world's leading game studios, and proud of our extremely international team, consisting of more than 50 different nations. We are part of Playtika and the global leader in the category of Hidden Object Games. With June's Journey, we're providing joy for millions of players around the world every day.

How we work

Our aim is to keep doing so for many more years, if not decades. In order to be able to do so, we've defined a distinct way of how we're working at Wooga, so that all relevant aspects intertwine and have a positive impact on the game. No matter if you're part of a game team or support the success of Wooga as part of a central team, all 250+ employees from around the world can make an impact. We're proud of the environment we've built, and believe you'll enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry.

Our drivers: Speed, Focus, Ownership, and Impact, guide our working style at Wooga and help us make a deliberate choice to focus on what is important to us, while working towards a shared goal.

These drivers shape how we work together and what we expect from ourselves and our leaders.

As a Marketing Data Analyst, you will analyze large-scale data across user acquisition touchpoints in order to generate insightful metrics, custom dashboards, and deep-dive analyses to measure marketing performance.

Our marketing teams aim for best-in-class user acquisition strategies, bringing high-quality players to our games while driving innovation around performance marketing and targeted campaigns. We're looking for a passionate, results-oriented talent to join our team, develop new insights to shape data-driven decisions, continuously improve marketing efficiency, and help drive business growth for years to come.

About The Job


Design, build, and maintain automated, interactive dashboards in Tableau to give the Marketing team up-to-date visibility into performance and KPIs.
Dive deep into large-scale marketing data to identify key insights that will inform user acquisition strategies and business growth.
Help define how best to measure and monitor our marketing channels, creatives, budget allocation, and overall campaign performance.
Help to develop an analysis strategy and perform analysis of complex campaigns and A/B tests, both systematically and on a one-off basis.
Provide data-driven recommendations to help Marketing Managers optimize their campaigns across various channels (e.g., Facebook Audience Network, Snapchat, TikTok).
Partner with Data Engineering on data gathering and signal sharing, integrating 3rd-party data providers (e.g., AppsFlyer, Kochava), democratizing data with reporting tools, AI Agents, and innovating workflows.
Communicate actionable results and data-driven findings across the organization clearly and concisely.


About You


You have recent experience in a data analyst role, preferably in digital advertising, performance marketing, or the app industry.
You have experience with (app) Attribution Services (eg: AppsFlyer or Kochava).
Literacy on Agentic Workflows, and other productivity and modern self-service data innovations.
You can use SQL effectively within an enterprise data environment and you have a good understanding of commonly applied statistical techniques. Basic understanding of programming is not required, but is appreciated.
You have strong experience using Tableau (or similar) to build interactive dashboards and visualizations.
You have good problem-solving skills and can look for logical connections between marketing spend, consumer behavior, and data.
You have a deep understanding of the digital advertising market,including communication patterns as they relate to consumer marketing. You are in tune with user acquisition patterns, and you understand mobile app growth.
You know your way around designing, communicating, visualizing, or reporting your results/analysis so they are clear and unambiguous to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Please note: Research has shown that some under-represented groups in the gaming industry (eg: women) tend to apply only if they meet every single requirement. Here at Wooga, the desire to learn and the willingness to solve problems are more important to us than your experience on paper. We encourage you to apply even if you do not think that you tick all the boxes - thinking outside of such boxes and embracing the diversity of mindsets and backgrounds is what we believe makes our teams thrive.

Our Promise


Shape the future! Challenge the status quo and team up with a diverse group of experts (over 50 nationalities!) working on crafting the world's best games.
We offer a generous relocation package and home search support if you are not already located in Berlin. Did we mention that we also cooperate with Kindergartens?
Make use of a significant education budget and extra days off for self-development. Join our meet-ups, talks, brown bag lunches, internal trainings, workshops and many others.
Enjoy the yoga, mindfulness app, sports and transport subsidies. And a Purpose Day to donate your time to a worthy cause!
Did you know that German is the third most commonly taught language worldwide? Learn it too! We offer German language classes for you and your significant other.
With our hybrid work model you will work in the office with your teams twice a week, to encourage in-person collaboration and team bonding The other three days you can choose if you want to work from home or from the office. We also offer 10 days a year to work from abroad.


At Wooga we are committed to providing a friendly, safe and welcoming environment for everyone who works here or with us, regardless of gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, religion (or lack thereof) and game preferences. Be yourself, we like you that way!

Title: Senior Quantitative Analyst
Description:
About Schumacher

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the$150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life.We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers “celebrate the feeling of home”. F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what’s come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our Competitive Advantage In The Industry Is Our People. We Believe That Our Employees Are Our Most Important Assets. F. Schumacher & Co Is Deeply Anchored In Our Company Core Values Which Are As Follows


Preserve Our Entrepreneurial Spirit
Take Ownership & Accountability
Be Solutions-Oriented
Demonstrate Courage
Practice Adaptability
Embrace Collaboration


We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is a 12 month contract and is a part of Data Insights & AI team

Role Overview

We're looking for a hands-on, Senior Quantitative Analyst, Product Portfolio (Statistical Modeling) to own analytics and reporting in support of our Portfolio Development team, with a specific focus on SKU productivity & capital allocation across a portfolio of 20,000+ SKUs and growing. This role will report directly to the Sr. Director of AI & Data Insights, but is expected to work directly with the CEO & Chief of Staff on a day-to-day basis.

This is not a role for someone who takes data at face value. You'll need to distinguish real signal from noise (e.g., a SKU selling poorly because it's out of stock, not because demand is weak), and when you find data that's wrong or inconsistent, you'll have the access and judgment to go into Snowflake and fix it — not just flag it and wait.

What You’ll Do


Work hands-on with CEO & Product Strategy stakeholders to understand key strategic questions, and then build analysis and reporting to address them directly
Use statistical methods (e.g. conjoint analysis, multivariate regression) to identify which product attributes and characteristics (e.g., color, pattern, material, price point, availability) drive productivity, and translate that into data-driven guidance on where the portfolio should expand, contract or shift
Cut through data noise at scale: systematically identify and control for confounders like stock-outs, new/discontinued SKUs, and seasonality so reported trends reflect real pattern performance
Identify data inconsistencies at the source (e.g., ERP, web, product master data) and directly and systematically correct records in Snowflake and work with upstream platform owners to improve the accuracy of source data and downstream analytics
Present findings clearly and independently to executive audiences, adapting the message for technical or non-technical stakeholders
Recommend and maintain recurring analytics & reporting to provide accurate and timely snapshot of SKU productivity
Use AI across your own workflow to explore data faster, automate repetitive reporting, catch errors, and multiply output given the scale and growth of the SKU portfolio


What We're Looking For


2-5 years in data science, analytics, statistics in similar SKU-driven businesses
Solid grounding in statistics or operations research (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, optimization). Able to move beyond descriptive reporting to model relationships between variables and quantify drivers, not just flag correlations
Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on Snowflake experience including writing back to correct or clean production data (not just read-only querying)
A track record of presenting findings and challenging assumptions directly with senior stakeholders and executives
Independent executor — sets analysis priorities against business goals without waiting for direction, and ships accurate, high-impact work in a timely manner
Curiosity — asks why the numbers look the way they do and keeps digging until the answer holds up, rather than reporting the first number that looks plausible
Thinks in terms of SKU-level economics: sell-through, margin, inventory position, lifecycle stage — and knows how to separate a true productivity problem from a data artifact
Treats data quality as part of the job, digging into root causes and correcting them directly rather than working around bad data
Hands-on experience applying AI/ML in a business context for task automation - automating repetitive analysis to spend more time on judgment calls
Strong English communication skills and a high ownership mindset


Nice to Have


Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools alongside Snowflake
Exposure to margin, pricing, or demand forecasting data
Experience in retail, e-commerce, or luxury/home furnishings goods


What We Offer


Competitive salary and benefits, based on experience
Fully remote work within Europe, with optional time in our NYC office (1–2 weeks per year)
Direct visibility with the CEO, with real influence on Product Strategy and Merchandising decisions
Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego working environment


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

Title: Business Operations Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Company Description

We are Flink - your online supermarket revolutionising the way you do your grocery shopping. With a wide selection of over 2,400 high-quality products, we aim to deliver to your door in minutes. We put our customers first and ensure all products delivered are fresh and nutritious. Additionally, we can customise our national assortment to be able to offer you unique local products in every city. Our delivery hubs are located in densely populated inner-city locations and we strive to be sustainable by delivering on electric bikes and using packaging that can be recycled.

Founded by experienced e-commerce professionals and seasoned entrepreneurs with exceptional track records, backed by some of the most renowned Global investors, we are growing rapidly and have a great hunger to continuously challenge ourselves. We pride ourselves in being an inclusive and equal opportunities employer with a diverse and multicultural team.

If you want to be part of this exciting journey… read on!

In your role as Business Operations Analyst (m/f/d) you will be critical in the continued success of our marketplace partnerships. With our ambitious growth targets set for 2027, our marketplace partnerships play a crucial role, and understanding performance to better forecast success will be a key part of this role.

Job Description


Performance Analysis: Drive the analysis of performance across all marketplaces. This is more than just analyzing data! It’s deriving the business impact and driving initiatives that solve the problems.
Troubleshoot and Resolve: Act as the first line of defense for any operational issues that arise. You'll separate the real problems from the noise, solve problems or route them to the right people internally or with the partner, until they're solved.
Automate and Innovate: Leverage your skills to build, maintain, and improve scripts and tools that automate repetitive operational tasks, such as catalog updates and hub availability checks, reducing manual effort and eliminating errors.
Collaborate Across a Global Stage: Work hand-in-hand with internal teams (Commercial, Tech, and Operations) and external marketplace partners to ensure smooth day-to-day operations and execute strategic projects.
Experimentation: Run commercial experiments aimed at measurable growth across the marketplaces from setup through to the read-out. You'll help size the opportunity, track the test, and make an honest call on whether it worked.


Qualifications


A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Computer Science, or a related field.

Title: Spezialist:in Analytics und Prozessmanagement
Description:
Die Deutsche Bahn ist nicht nur einer der wichtigsten Mobilitätsdienstleister, sondern auch eines der größten Ingenieurbüros Deutschlands. Die Analyse und Bewertung von Technologien und Prozessen der Leit- und Sicherungstechnik (LST) übernimmst du unter technischen, betrieblichen und wirtschaftlichen Gesichtspunkten
Standards und Prozesse für bereichsübergreifende Projekte und Programme zur Weiterentwicklung der digitalen Leit- und Sicherungstechnik entwickelst und implementierst du

Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Verkehrswesen, Bahningenieurswesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung bringst du mit

Analytisches Denkvermögen und ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für betriebliche, technische und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge gehören zu deinen Stärken
Die strukturierte Entwicklung von Kennzahlen, Dashboards und datenbasierten Entscheidungsgrundlagen liegt dir und macht dir Spaß

Das ist uns wichtig:

Unser Anspruch ist es, allen Kandidat:innen bei gleicher Eignung die gleichen Chancen für den Einstieg bei uns zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv die Vielfalt und das Miteinander in unseren Teams. Wir schätzen jede Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, Dauer der Arbeitslosigkeit sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Benefits:


Wir unterstützen dich bei der Suche nach Kitaplätzen oder Ferienbetreuung für deine Kinder. Außerdem kannst du Auszeiten für die Pflege von Angehörigen oder Sabbaticals nehmen. Je nach Job ist eine flexible Gestaltung von Arbeitszeit/-ort möglich.
Wir bieten dir 16 Freifahrten innerhalb Deutschlands pro Jahr und weitere Fahrvergünstigungen wie z.B. DB Job-Ticket für deinen täglichen Arbeitsweg. Darüber hinaus gibt es günstige Mitnahmemöglichkeiten für Familie und Freunde.
Bei uns können alle DB Mitarbeitenden günstig shoppen. Jeden Monat findest du auf dem DB Reisemarkt neue Angebote, wie z.B. Mobilfunkverträge, Versicherungen, Vergünstigungen bei Hotelketten, Mode und Lifestyle.

Title: Senior Growth Analyst, User Acquisition
Description:
Who we are




JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business, from the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events and best-selling console games. We also own the world's largest streaming guide, giving us unique insights into audience behaviours and content tastes.

From a small startup, we've evolved into a team of more than 200 people, based in Berlin, around the world or working remotely. We've built a profitable business while continuing to grow.




Who we need




We are looking for a Senior Growth Analyst with at least 3 years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing analytics. You will support growth across JustWatch TV and our streaming guide, with the main focus on JustWatch TV.

You will partner with our marketing, campaign, product and Business Intelligence teams to understand which acquisition activity brings valuable users, improve confidence in measurement and testing, and turn findings into budget and campaign decisions.







What you will be doing




Analyse user acquisition performance across channels, markets and audiences, and recommend where to scale, adjust or stop spending.
Develop our attribution approach and interpret MMP and ad platform reporting. Work with BI and technical teams to define conversion events, validate tracking and resolve data discrepancies. You will lead analytical requirements and validation; technical teams own implementation.
Analyse acquisition cohorts, activation, retention, subscription conversion and revenue alongside LTV, CAC, ROAS and payback periods. Make assumptions explicit and use findings to guide acquisition and bidding targets.
Design and evaluate A/B tests, holdouts and incrementality tests with the marketing team. Distinguish attributed conversions from incremental impact and turn findings into practical recommendations.
Build benchmarks, forecasts, dashboards and efficient reporting to guide planning, budgets and growth targets, working with BI to keep KPI definitions consistent and data reliable.
Support selected client campaign analyses and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, prioritising work that improves decisions and performance.







What we need from you




Essential experience

At least 3 years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing analytics, ideally in an app, subscription or digital consumer business.
A strong understanding of mobile analytics, including attribution, conversion events, measurement limitations and discrepancies between data sources.
An understanding of paid acquisition channels such as Meta, TikTok and Google, their optimisation goals and performance metrics.
Experience analysing acquisition funnels, retention cohorts and unit economics to assess user value beyond installs or initial conversions.
Confident working with spreadsheets, BI tools and data from multiple sources.
The ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations, challenge assumptions constructively and prioritise independently.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Useful extras
Hands-on experience with mobile measurement partners such as AppsFlyer or Adjust.
Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, holdouts or incrementality tests.
SQL or Python.
Experience with CTV app measurement, ASO or CRM and lifecycle analytics.
German language skills.




What we offer you

An open-minded, international team that enjoys collaborating to reach shared goals.
Meaningful work, opportunities for personal growth and the chance to make a lasting impact.
A permission-less environment where you can take ownership and focus on delivering value without unnecessary complexity.
Trust in your expertise and judgement, with room to improve how we work and bring new ideas.
A collaborative and supportive environment that helps you achieve your personal and professional goals.
A flexible hybrid working environment, with no requirement to come to the office.







Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality.




If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

A company culture that really works
Audience as a Service
Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog




How to apply

Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.

Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.

If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.




Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

Title: (Associate) Consultant Business Intelligence & Data Analytics (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir bei Capgemini Invent glauben, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven den Wandel vorantreiben. Als innovative Transformationsberater vereinen wir unsere strategischen, kreativen und wissenschaftlichen Fähigkeiten und arbeiten eng mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um zukunftsweisende Lösungen zu entwickeln. Hilf uns dabei, den Wandel voranzutreiben, der auf die Herausforderungen unserer Kunden von heute und morgen zugeschnitten ist. Informiert und validiert durch Wissenschaft und Daten. Verstärkt durch Kreativität und Design. Und das alles auf der Grundlage von Technologien.

Deine Rolle

Als (Associate) Consultant (m/w/d) im Bereich Business Intelligence & Data Analytics meisterst du spannende Projekte, stellst dich anspruchsvollen Herausforderungen und gestaltest die Transformation von Organisationen und Geschäftsmodellen bis hin zum Leitbild datengetriebener Unternehmen.


Du berätst nationale und internationale Klient:innen branchenübergreifend in der Entwicklung von nachhaltigen und innovativen Lösungen für eine Transformation unserer Kunden zu einer datengetriebene Unternehmenssteuerung
Du identifizierst und priorisierst Analytics Use Cases, analysierst fachliche Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in technische Spezifikationen für maßgeschneiderte Reporting-Lösungen für Geschäftsprozessen und der Interaktion mit (End-)Kund*innen
Du konzipierst und entwickelst Dashboards und Reports für datengetriebene Entscheidungen und quantitative Insights – von der Datenaufbereitung bis zur Visualisierung und anschließender Industrialisierung des Produkts
Du arbeitest eng mit Strategie-, Daten- und Technologieexperten in interdisziplinären Projektteams zusammen
Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unseres datenfokussierten Offerings mit und bringst deine Perspektive in Kundenprojekte ein


Dein Profil


Du bringst erste praktische (agile) Projekterfahrung im Requirements Engineering und der Umsetzung von datengetriebenen Lösungen, z.B. Reportings, Analytics-Produkten oder KPI-Analysen
Du hast erste fundamentale Erfahrung in der Beratungsbranche gesammelt oder vergleichbare Aufgaben in anderen Kontexten mit Kunden bereits übernommen
Du hast einen exzellenten Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor/Master) mit wirtschaftlichem oder technischem Hintergrund (z.B. Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder verwandte Studiengänge) und/oder hast ggf. bereits als Business Analyst Erfahrung gesammelt
Du besitzt erste Kenntnisse von ETL-Prozessen (z.B. mit SQL) sowie Erfahrung mit mindestens einem BI-Tool (z.B. Power BI, Tableau, Qlik)
Du hast Spaß an der Kombination von technologischem Verständnis, strategischer Analyse und Implementierung, hast Freude an Verantwortung und kritischem Hinterfragen und Lust, die Transformation unserer Kunden zu begleiten
Du bist kommunikationsstark und überzeugst durch deinen Teamgeist, hohe Zuverlässigkeit sowie ein hohes Engagement und selbstbewusstes Auftreten
Du besitzt exzellente Deutsch- (mindestens C1) und Englischkenntnisse und zeigst Flexibilität sowie Reisebereitschaft


Was du bei uns schätzen wirst


Werde Teil einer international führenden Unternehmensberatung, die durch innovative und wegweisende Projekte, globale Teams und digitales Know-How die Zukunft gestaltet
Bekomme klare Perspektiven für deine Karriere und Freiraum für Eigeninitiative
Erhalte individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
Erlebe unser kontinuierliches Engagement für Chancengleichheit, Vielfalt und Inklusion
Profitiere von unseren Benefits zur optimalen Work-Life-Balance mit attraktiven Angeboten rund um Gesundheit & Wellbeing, Zusatzpaketen rund um Mobilität sowie modernen Offices

Das Unternehmen unterstützt diese bei ihrer dualen Transformation für eine stärker digitale und nachhaltige Welt – stets auf greifbare Fortschritte für die Gesellschaft bedacht. Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A oder Corporate Finance, idealerweise auch Carve-out- oder komplexe Deal-Erfahrungen
Fundiertes Wissen in Accounting, Financial Modeling und Unternehmensbewertung

Title: Senior Sales Analyst (d/f/m) 1-year fixed-term contract
Description:
Job Description

In the Kleinanzeagen PRO Business Unit, we are scaling a high-growth SMB powerhouse. To achieve our ambitious growth targets, we are looking for a Senior Sales Analyst who will closely collaborate with PRO Sales leadership to bring our reporting and insight generation to the next level.

This role is designed for an independent decision-enabler who can challenge senior stakeholders while maintaining tight organization over their backlog and execution.

Job requirements

Your Profile


Experience: 4–5+ years of hands-on experience in mid-to-senior sales analytics roles, ideally within a marketplace (e.g., Amazon, eBay, Allegro), SaaS, or E-Commerce environment.
Core technical stack: Advanced SQL skills (code optimization) alongside proven hands-on experience with Salesforce data (must) and Databricks (must). Proficiency with Python, dbt, and CI/CD workflows is a strong plus.
Modern data architecture: Solid understanding of modern data flows (Salesforce -> Databricks -> dbt -> BI/Products) and analytics infrastructure. Ability to partner with Data Engineering and Platform teams to design scalable solutions.
Advanced & predictive analytics: Proven track record with advanced analytical techniques and statistical forecasting methods to convert complex datasets into predictive insights.
Visualization & reporting: Demonstrated experience with data visualization platforms; Tableau and Databricks Dashboards are a major plus.
Modern AI integration: Practical experience with AI tools in analytical workflows. Knowing when to automate versus when to perform deep manual analysis. Using agentic AI as a daily companion, with a proven track record of leveraging AI tooling (especially Claude) to execute both tedious administrative tasks and high-value deliverables efficiently.
Stakeholder management & ownership mindset: Decision-focused with a strong sense of end-to-end ownership, accountability, and backlog prioritization. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders and translating complex data for non-technical audiences.
Languages: Fluency in English is required; German is a strong advantage.


Job responsibilities

Your Role


Drive partner & professional sellers’ self-service analytics: Build a robust, scalable self-service reporting base for our professional sellers, as well as partners and associations.
Automate sales campaign reporting: Restructure campaign management and reporting, driving the shift toward automated, self-service channel data.
Lead data Integration & modeling: Ingest, model, and integrate third-party partner data streams directly into internal systems alongside data engineers, platform teams, and external Salesforce consultants.
Cross-functional collaboration & sales enablement: Act as a sparring partner for sales stakeholders by providing access to critical data, translating business requirements into scalable solutions, and leading cross-functional alignment.
Attribution & performance intelligence: Deliver revenue reconciliation, attribution models, market intelligence, and risk/opportunity recommendations to optimize sales performance.
Advanced analytics & future foundations: Lay the analytics foundations for forward-looking predictions and sales forecasting models to support strategic decision-making.
AI Integration: Integrate AI tools into your analytical workflows and help stakeholders do the same. Automate where it creates leverage; go deep where it matters.


Job benefits

At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive.

Flexible working time (hybrid)
20 days “work from anywhere”
Paid additional parental leave for both parents
Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move)


❤️‍🩹 Wellbeing & Support


Confidential support & coaching for you and your loved ones
Annual company sports events
Pension and life insurance


📚 Growth & Development


Personal development budget
Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career


🛍️ Perks & Everyday benefits


Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts
An attractive referral program
Transportation allowance
Free shipping on Kleinanzeigen Direktkauf


Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability.

Title: Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data.

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, you’ll:


Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.

Title: Senior Berater Real World Evidence (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Abrechnungsdatenanalysen
Description:
Über uns

Die IGES GmbH ist auf gesundheitsökonomische und strategische Forschungs- und Beratungsdienstleistungen für internationale Arzneimittel- und Medizinproduktehersteller spezialisiert. Sie bietet Biotech-, Pharma- und Medizinprodukteunternehmen Lösungen für den Market Access, Preisbildung und Erstattung ihrer medizinischen Innovationen. Das Unternehmen ist in Frankreich, Deutschland, Italien, Spanien, Schweden, der Schweiz und Großbritannien vertreten und unterstützt auch bei multinationalen Produkteinführungen. IGES ist Teil der Athagoras Gruppe, die verschiedene Beratungsunternehmen für die Lifescience-Branche vereint.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Value Strategy & RWE suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt an unserem Standort in Berlin einen Senior Berater Real World Evidence (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Abrechnungsdatenanalysen

Ihre Aufgaben


Konzeption, Durchführung, Auswertung und Interpretation von Analysen auf Basis von Abrechnungsdaten – insbesondere Kassendaten (GKV) und/oder Registerdaten – von der Datenaufbereitung über die Kohortendefinition bis zur Ergebnisaufarbeitung
Interpretation und Einordnung der Analyseergebnisse zur Generierung belastbarer Real World Evidence sowie deren Übersetzung in strategische Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden
Strategische Beratung von Market-Access-, HE&OR- und RWE-Abteilungen führender Pharmaunternehmen und Emerging Biotechs
Fachliche Steuerung und Qualitätssicherung von Analysen in interdisziplinären Projekten sowie Anleitung weniger erfahrener Kolleginnen und Kollegen
Unterstützung bei HTA-relevanten Fragestellungen (z. B. Evidenzanforderungen, PICO-Scoping, Analysestrategien) sowie Transfer der Ergebnisse in Publikationen, Präsentationen und Projektberichte
Durchführung systematischer Literaturrecherchen und strukturierte Auswertung zur Ergänzung der Befunde aus Abrechnungsdaten
Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung interner Daten- und Methodenkompetenz, für Analysen von Gesundheitsdaten des FDZ-Gesundheit
Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen, z. B. in wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften, Projektberichten und Ergebnispräsentationen


Ihre Qualifikation


Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Master/Diplom) in Versorgungsforschung, Public Health, Gesundheitsökonomie, Statistik, Epidemiologie oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse von Abrechnungsdaten – insbesondere Kassendaten (GKV) und/oder Registerdaten – im industriellen oder akademischen Umfeld
Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Analyseergebnisse eigenständig zu interpretieren, zu Real World Evidence zu verdichten und adressatengerecht aufzubereiten
Sicherer Umgang mit epidemiologischen und statistischen Methoden, soweit für die anwendungsnahe Auswertung von Abrechnungsdaten erforderlich
Erfahrung in der Erstellung wissenschaftlicher Dokumente, z. B. Studienprotokolle, Studienberichte oder Publikationen
Programmierkenntnisse in R oder Python von Vorteil
Kenntnisse in HTA-/Market-Access-Anforderungen sind willkommen, aber nicht Voraussetzung
Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative
Aufgeschlossene und kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit Team- und Kundenorientierung
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (wissenschaftliches Niveau)


Unser Angebot


Mitarbeit in abwechslungsreichen Projekten zu hochinnovativen Arzneimitteln an der Schnittstelle von Versorgungsforschung, Real-World-Evidence und strategischer Beratung
Ein interdisziplinäres, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und guten Entwicklungsperspektiven
Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch anspruchsvolle Projektarbeit, viel Raum für eigene Ideen und individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen (z. B. Konferenzen)
Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung großer Abrechnungsdatensätze sowie frühzeitiger Kompetenzaufbau im Hinblick auf das FDZ Gesundheit
Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung nach einer strukturierten Einarbeitung am Standort Berlin, inklusive Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
Unbefristete Festanstellung mit marktgerechter Vergütung, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tagen Urlaub sowie zusätzlich frei an Heiligabend und Silvester


Kontaktinformation

Wenn Sie diese Aufgabe reizt, freuen wir uns über Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse) unter Angabe Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellungen und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins hier über die Direktbewerbung oder per Mail an Frau Alina Weber (personal@iges.com). Für weiterführende Informationen steht Ihnen Frau Weber unter der Rufnummer 030/230 809-418 gern zur Verfügung.

Title: Product Analyst Lead
Description:
HEY THERE

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.




Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.




You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.




Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!




This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.




YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:

Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next
Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on
Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up
Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it
Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before
Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool
Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions




YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:

You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course
You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself
Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways
You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through
You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data
When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it




Bonus points for:

Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)
A strong statistics background
Dagster or Airflow for scheduling
Data catalogues like DataHub




OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:

Warehouse: Snowflake
Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster
Experimentation: GrowthBook
Self-service analytics: Omni
ML workflows: Prefect
GenAI: Claude




If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.




WHY US?

An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating
A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year
30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you
A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!
A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement
A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks
Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development
A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health




DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.




READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

Your CV in English
Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

Title: eCommerce Growth Analyst (all genders)
Description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an eCommerce Growth Analyst to join our eCommerce Solutions team to lead data analytics and real-time tracking, ensuring the quality and stability of our rapidly growing white-label solution.




What you will do:

Performance Optimisation & Analytics: lead site performance optimisation through advanced analytics tools and data-driven insights.
Monitoring & Growth Analysis: monitor key metrics such as traffic, user behaviour, and conversion rates to identify growth opportunities and drive continuous improvement.
Analytics Tools & Tracking: leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, and heatmaps to track, measure, and analyse website performance.
A/B Testing & CRO: implement A/B testing and Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) strategies to improve user engagement and conversion performance.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: collaborate closely with marketing, UX, and development teams to enhance user experience and overall site effectiveness.
Tag Management & Data Accuracy: ensure accurate website tracking, including the setup and management of tags in Google Tag Manager for reliable data collection.




Workplace: Germany & Remote // Berlin & Hybrid

We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.




Who you are:

Experience & Background: 4+ years of experience in growth, product optimisation, or similar roles within B2C e-commerce or consumer digital products.
Conversion Optimisation & Experimentation: strong hands-on experience improving website and app conversion funnels through experimentation, user behaviour analysis, and data-driven decision making.
Analytics & Tools: strong hands-on experience with tools such as Amplitude, Google Analytics, SQL, Grafana, Hotjar, and A/B testing platforms like AB Tasty, Maxymizer, or Optimizely.
Ownership & Problem Solving: strong ownership mindset with the ability to proactively investigate root causes and drive solutions when metrics or user behaviour change unexpectedly.
Customer & Product Mindset: customer-focused and curious about user behaviour, with the ability to identify friction points and opportunities to improve conversion and overall experience.
Analytical Thinking: ability to turn complex business problems into clear hypotheses, experiments, and actionable product improvements.
Collaboration & Ways of Working: comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, and commercial teams.
Communication Skills: clear communicator who can work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability & Impact: thrives in fast-moving environments, adapts quickly to ambiguity, and is motivated by driving measurable business impact.




What you can expect:

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support, and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company




Our hiring process for this role:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Benedetta, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Francesc Ferre.




For any queries, please contact your Talent Partner at (talent@distribusion.com).

Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability, scalability and the most advanced technology? Come join us!

Title: (Senior) Product Analyst, Real Estate & Motors (d/f/m) - 1-year fixed-term contract
Description:
Job Description

Kleinanzeigen is the leading online classifieds market in Germany. Users buy and sell on Germany's No. 1 for classifieds mainly second-hand. In this way they make an active contribution to more sustainability. On average, more than 55 million ads are available in numerous categories – from children's supplies to electronics and real estate. Kleinanzeigen also offers small and medium-sized businesses the opportunity to present their services online. Around 35 million users per month make Kleinanzeigen one of the most widely used websites in Germany. Kleinanzeigen was launched in September 2009 as eBay Kleinanzeigen. Since June 2021, the company has been part of Adevinta, a global provider of online classified ads. In May 2023, the name was changed to Kleinanzeigen.

The Job

As a (Senior) Product Analyst in the Real Estate & Motors Analytics team, you are the data expert for product decisions across the RE and Motors domains. You ensure tracking is right, experiments are sound, and stakeholders have the data foundations they need to act independently. Working closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, and Business peers, you combine deep analytical expertise with a builder mindset — automating what can be automated, enabling what can be self-served, and owning the complex cases that need expert judgment.

This is a limited 1-year contract position. The role is hybrid and our office is in Berlin. You report to the Analytics Lead, Real Estate & Motors.

Job requirements

Who You Are


You bring strong SQL skills and hands-on product analytics experience including tracking ownership, experimentation, and performance KPI analysis.
You bring practical experience with AI tools in analytical workflows and know when to automate vs. when to go deep. Agentic AI is your daily companion and you come with a proven track record of utilizing AI tooling to get annoying and valuable tasks done (big plus: Claude).
You have personally defined tracking specs, coordinated their implementation across PM/SWE/DE, and verified them in production — not just configured existing tools.
You've designed and evaluated A/B tests independently, not just read results. You understand statistical power, guardrail metrics, and when not to trust a result.
You demonstrate an ownership mindset, strong prioritization, and clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are comfortable building data products for self-service — semantic layers, metrics definitions, reusable templates.
Nice to have: advanced experimentation methods (CUPED, sequential testing, Bayesian approaches), exposure to Python, dbt, or modern analytics engineering tooling; experience in classifieds or marketplace platforms.


Job responsibilities

What You'll Do


Own product analytics for RE and Motors squads: tracking definition, funnel analysis, KPI monitoring, and performance reporting across seeker experience, seeker monetization, seller experience and Motors product initiatives.
Define event tracking specifications end-to-end — from schema design through coordination with PM, SWE, and DE to verification in production. Build automated checks that scale beyond manual QA.
Lead A/B experimentation: design tests from hypothesis to readout, apply advanced methods (sequential testing, CUPED, interaction effects) where appropriate, and build self-service tooling and templates so product teams can run standard experiments independently.
Contribute to the semantic layer and data model so RE&M data is self-queryable by stakeholders — reducing analyst bottlenecks for routine data access.
Integrate AI tools into your analytical workflows and help stakeholders do the same. Automate where it creates leverage; go deep where it matters.
Support forecasting, planning, and operational analytics initiatives across the RE&M domain.
Own your backlog — prioritize with transparency, push back on low-value requests, and make trade-offs visible to stakeholders.


Job benefits

At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive.

✨ Flexibility


Flexible working time (hybrid)
20 days “work from anywhere”
Paid additional parental leave for both parents
Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move)


❤️‍🩹 Wellbeing & Support


Confidential support & coaching for you and your loved ones
Annual company sports events
Pension and life insurance


📚 Growth & Development


Personal development budget
Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career


🛍️ Perks & Everyday benefits


Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts
An attractive referral program
Transportation allowance
Free shipping on Kleinanzeigen Direktkauf


Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability.

If this role sparks your interest but you’re not sure you meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you anyway.

Process Intelligence & Consulting

Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch sind für unsere Kundenprojekte ein Muss.




Du musst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt erfüllen. Wenn du fachlich stark bist, schnell lernst und richtig Lust auf Process Intelligence hast, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.




Wir bieten




Ein richtig cooles und erfahrenes Team, in dem du viel lernen kannst und gleichzeitig Raum für deine eigenen Ideen bekommst.
Viel Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, Proxius aktiv mitzugestalten, statt nur Teil eines großen Beratungsapparats zu sein.
Projekte bei großen, bekannten Unternehmen mit komplexen Prozessen und echtem Impact.
Flexibilität, wie und wo du arbeitest: remote oder gemeinsam im Büro in München, Berlin oder Köln.
Eine transparente und faire Vergütung: Consultant 55–65k €
Und für uns eigentlich selbstverständlich und nicht zu erwähnen (tun wir aber trotzdem ;) ): neuestes IT-Equipment mit iPhone und leistungsfähigem Laptop, Wellpass / Sachbezug, Fortbildungen und richtig gute Team-Events.

Weil wir klein genug sind, dass deine Ideen und deine Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied machen und gleichzeitig an Projekten arbeiten, die alles andere als klein sind.

Bei uns bist du keine Nummer und musst dich nicht durch fünf Hierarchieebenen kämpfen, bevor du Verantwortung übernehmen darfst. Wenn du etwas gut kannst, bekommst du den Raum dafür. Wenn du etwas noch nicht kannst, helfen wir dir dabei, es zu lernen.

Und wenn du eine gute Idee hast, wollen wir sie hören.

Title: Data, Economic & Impact Analyst
Description:
Non-Key Expert – Data, Economic & Impact Analyst




NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Support to the Africa-EU Space Partnership Programme – AESPP Boost.”




The programme aims to strengthen cooperation between Africa and the European Union in the space sector, supporting policy dialogue, institutional partnerships, knowledge exchange, innovation, private sector engagement and investment, while contributing to stronger and more sustainable African space ecosystems.




In this context, we are seeking a qualified Non-Key Expert – Data, Economic & Impact Analyst to support data and economic analysis, monitoring and evaluation, impact assessment, evidence synthesis, indicator monitoring, and results reporting under the programme.




Minimum Qualifications and Skills

University degree of at least three years in statistics, economics, data analytics, social sciences, or a related field.
Excellent command of English.
Working knowledge of French and/or Portuguese is an asset.




Minimum General Professional Experience

Minimum 3 years of professional experience in data analysis, economic analysis, surveys, reporting or indicator monitoring.




Minimum Specific Professional Experience

At least 1 year of professional experience supporting MEL, evaluation or impact assessment, including quantitative and qualitative analysis, evidence synthesis, data compilation and preparation of dashboards or performance reports.




If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and upload your CV via LinkedIn or send to recruitment@ntu.eu. Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted due to the large amount of applicants.

Title: Manager Data Analytics, Global Marketing (m/f/d)
Description:
Location: Berlin or Stäfa, Hybrid




We are looking for a Manager Data Analytics to establish and lead the day-to-day analytics capability within our Global Marketing organization. As the first dedicated data analytics expert in the team, you will have the opportunity to shape how we use data across brands, products, markets and consumer touchpoints.

This is an individual contributor analytics role that sits close to the business. You will work directly with marketing, product and portfolio stakeholders, helping them understand what the data means, what actions to take and how analytics can support better decisions for our brands and consumers. While embedded in Global Marketing, you will be connected to a broader community of analytics experts and work closely with our central Data & Data Science function.




Your Responsibilities




Partner with Global Marketing stakeholders to translate business questions into clear analytical requirements, KPIs and decision-ready insights
Deliver analyses across areas such as product usage, NPS and voice of the customer, campaign performance, digital behavior, funnel performance and customer feedback
Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports and self-service analytics solutions
Combine information from different data sources and transform complex datasets into clear business stories, implications and recommendations
Act as Global Marketing’s main interface to the central data and data science organization for advanced analytics and cross-functional projects
Support test-and-learn initiatives, A/B testing and experimental approaches
Manage recurring and ad hoc analytics requests while helping stakeholders prioritize the topics with the greatest business impact




What You Bring




A degree in data science, business analytics, statistics, economics, marketing analytics or a related field
At least 5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics or digital analytics
Strong experience working with large and complex datasets and translating them into actionable insights for business stakeholders
Hands-on experience with Power BI, SQL and Excel; knowledge of Python or R is an advantage
A good understanding of KPI frameworks, data visualization and applied business analytics
A self-starting, structured and independent working style, combined with strong stakeholder-management skills
Fluency in English; German is an advantage.




Why join us




This is a unique opportunity to become the analytics subject-matter expert embedded directly within Global Marketing.
You will have the freedom to build the analytics capability, establish effective ways of working and create your own path within an international marketing organization.




As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model.




Our benefits in Berlin:

30 days of paid annual leave
Subsidized VBB or Deutschland ticket
Dedicated learning & development budget and weekly learning time + LinkedIn Learning license
Company Urban Sports Club membership
Mobility allowance for relocation if you are relocating to join our team




Sonova is an equal opportunity employer.

We team up. We grow talent. We collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds to win with the best team in the market place. We guarantee every person equal treatment in regard to employment and opportunity for employment, regardless of a candidate’s ethnic or national origin, religion, sexual orientation or marital status, gender, genetic identity, age, disability or any other legally protected status.

Title: (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d) in Berlin
Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Corporate Functions - Performance & Reward ein attraktives, motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld gestalten? Unser Team entwickelt Konzepte und Programme rund um die Themen Karriere, Benefits, Recognition oder (leistungsbezogene) Vergütung. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d).

Standorte: Düsseldorf, Berlin, Dresden, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, Leipzig, Magdeburg, Mannheim, München, Nürnberg und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d) erwartet dich eine anspruchsvolle Rolle als Data Scientist zur Entwicklung datengestützter Modelle zur Aufbereitung und Interpretation entscheidungsrelevanter Daten.


Konzeption: Du entwickelst geeignete Algorithmen und Modelle zur Aufbereitung entscheidungsrelevanter Daten und erschaffst individuelle Dashboards anhand moderner Business-Intelligence-Tools.
Verifizierung: Um deine aufgestellten Hypothesen zu prüfen, identifizierst du Zusammenhänge und Muster in deinen Daten.
Entwicklung: Gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern entwickelst du Reporting und Analysetools.
Präsentation: Strukturierte Aufbereitung der Inhalte für verschiedene Zielgruppen und Reporting-Anforderungen.
Management: Selbstständig identifizierst und entwickelst du Schritt für Schritt den notwendigen Prozess zur Entwicklung der gesamte Wertschöpfungs- und Engagementkette.


Dein Skillset:


Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Physik bspw. mit Schwerpunkt Statistik, Data Analytics oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung z. B. im Bereich Analytics und/oder Projektmanagement
Der Umgang mit großen Datenmengen in einem hochvertraulichen Umfeld ist für dich kein Problem
(Erste) Programmierkenntnisse in R, Python, SQL oder vergleichbar sowie Erfahrung mit Business-Intelligence-Tools wie Qlik, Sense oder PowerBI
Exzellente analytische Fähigkeiten und einen hohen Anspruch an die eigenen Arbeitsergebnisse


Deine Chance:


Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr
Gesundheit & Fitness im Fokus durch regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, Kooperation mit Fitness-Anbietern und die Unterstützung von Sport- und Teamevents
Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working
Vielfältige Gestaltungsräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke


Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied!

Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich.

Gleiche Chancen für alle: Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die so vielfältig sind wie wir – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft und Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. Noch Fragen? Alle Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du in unseren Bewerbungs-FAQs.

Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111.
