Title: Senior Data Analyst - Customer Insight & Performance
Description:
Location: HSK, London

Contract Type: Full-time/Permanent




About the Role

The Senior Data Analyst - Customer Insight & Performance, owns the operating rhythm of the Customer Intelligence team: the weekly reporting cadence, the full relationship with the central Data and Insights team and the Voice of Customer programme. Every analysis the team uses to brief CRM, flag churn risk, or feed the 12-week forecast runs through this role. The output is interpretation and application, not raw data: this role translates what the data says into what the business should do.




This is one of three peer roles in the Customer Intelligence team, all reporting directly to the Director of Customer Success. This role sits alongside, not beneath, the two Senior Manager roles in the team; there is no reporting relationship between this role and either of them. Grade reflects scope of accountability, not position in a reporting line.




Main Responsibilities




Subscriber Intelligence

Maintain a standing analytical view of subscriber behaviour across lifecycle stage, acquisition channel, offer type and engagement profile, including by market (UK, US, Australia).
Produce weekly performance reporting covering subscriber base movement, churn cohort analysis, CRM campaign incrementality and payments recovery status, distributed to the Director of Customer Success, Director of Acquisition and Group MD.
Flag material shifts in cohort behaviour before they surface in aggregate churn numbers, feeding both the Senior Manager, Subscriber Intelligence & Forecasting and the Senior Manager, Lifecycle & Segmentation Strategy.




Data and Insights relationship

Act as the primary structured client of the central Data and Insights team on behalf of the Customer Intelligence function: named contact, weekly cadence and standing data requirements.
Define the analytical questions the team needs answered: predictive, behavioural and cohort-based, not binary reporting queries.
Commission analytical work from Data and Insights using well-defined briefs that produce actionable insight, not binary reporting.
Translate Data and Insights output into retention intelligence: the interpretation and application layer, not the data production layer.




Voice of Customer

Advocate for our customers by turning survey feedback and data into insights that shape our core incentive programs
Identify where Voice of Customer data confirms or contradicts behavioural data and surface those tensions to both Senior Managers in the team.




Forecasting support

Provide the data inputs that underpin the Senior Manager, Subscriber Intelligence & Forecasting's 12-week rolling forecast and cohort LTV model.
Maintain the historical forecast accuracy log as a continuous improvement tool.




OKRS: FIRST 90 DAYS

Establish the standing Data and Insights cadence and agree the initial analytical brief set within 30 days.
Produce the first weekly performance report within 30 days.
Map current Voice of Customer data sources and integrate into a structured team analytical view within 60 days.
Agree the forecast data framework and cadence with the Senior Manager, Subscriber Intelligence & Forecasting within 45 days.




OKRS: LONGER TERM (ANNUAL AND BEYOND)




Annual (FY27)

Weekly performance reporting is relied upon by the Director of Customer Success and Group MD as a standing commercial input, with no supplementary data requests needed to understand subscriber base performance.
The Data and Insights relationship produces analytical output that is genuinely predictive: cohort-level churn risk identified before it appears in aggregate numbers.
Voice of Customer data is integrated into the team's analytical picture in a way that materially changes at least one lifecycle intervention per quarter.
Forecast data inputs are accurate to within an agreed tolerance, measured against actual base performance over rolling 12-week periods.




Multi-year (toward FY28)

The team's incrementality measurement framework is robust enough to attribute subscriber outcome changes to specific lifecycle interventions with statistical confidence.
The Voice of Customer programme produces insight that influences product and editorial decisions, not just CRM briefs.




Person Specification




Analytical Background: Minimum of 4–6 years in a data analytics, business intelligence, or performance insights role.
Interpretation Capability: Proven experience moving beyond raw data production to deliver strategic recommendations and actionable business insights.
Analytical Methods: Hands-on experience with predictive modelling, cohort-based analysis, and behavioural segmentation.
Subscription Models: Strong experience working within a subscriber-led business model (e.g., SaaS, media, telecoms, or digital subscriptions).
Key Metrics: Deep understanding of retention metrics, including churn forecasting, cohort LTV, subscriber lifecycle stages, and acquisition channel performance.
Voice of Customer: Experience integrating qualitative feedback (VoC programs) with quantitative behavioural datasets to resolve conflicting data trends.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated experience acting as a primary client or liaison to a centralized corporate Data & Insights team.
Briefing Skills: Proven track record of drafting complex, well-defined analytical briefs to commission targeted research and projects.
Senior Exposure: Experience distributing performance reporting and presenting insights directly to C-suite or Director-level stakeholders (e.g., Director of Customer Success, Group MD).
Peer Collaboration: Ability to operate autonomously as a peer alongside senior managers without needing direct reporting lines to them.




Package Description

Our benefits package increases the longer you’ve been with us. Here’s what to expect:




25 days’ holiday (increasing by 1 per year up to a total of 30)
Upon joining you will be automatically enrolled onto the Pension Plan at
the minimum level of 5% employee contribution, 3% Company
contribution.
Life cover under the Pension Plan of up to 3x your basic salary.
DMGT Discounts (for discounts on online shopping, vouchers and
reloadable cards)
Subsidised canteen
Onsite gym (Northcliffe House only)
Onsite nurse and GP clinics (Northcliffe House only)
Our Employee Assistance Programme
Discounted dining cards




Plus many other benefits….

Please be assured that any such information will be held separately to your recruitment application and will not be considered as part of the selection process

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Do you want to use data to shape decisions across the global research communications industry?




Do you thrive on leading stakeholders from a business question to a data-driven action?

Location: London or Oxford

About Our Team




The Scientific, Technical & Medical Journals (STMJ) business, part of Elsevier, provides researchers with a trusted platform to publish and share their work. Publishing research across approximately 3,000 journals annually, STMJ plays a critical role in advancing scientific discovery and knowledge dissemination worldwide.




The STMJ Data & Analytics team is a global group of data professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality insights and analytics that enable data-driven decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, the team transforms complex data into actionable recommendations that drive performance, innovation, and customer value.




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our STMJ Data & Analytics team. You will act as a trusted thought partner to stakeholders, leading complex analytics initiatives, independently managing projects, and helping to shape business decisions through data.




As a senior member of the team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy, serve as a subject matter expert, and support the development of junior analysts through coaching and knowledge sharing. You'll join a large, established team of data professionals that supports STMJ, with direct access to enterprise-grade platforms and tools, and be a part of a wider Elsevier organisation that's a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes worldwide.




Responsibilities




Lead complex analytics projects from planning through delivery, translating loosely defined business problems into a clear plan of action.
Act as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders, shaping strategy, guiding them through hypothesis driven thinking, and challenging assumptions through data.
Identify and execute the most relevant analyses, metrics, and reporting solutions.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while effectively prioritising workload.
Collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to overcome challenges and deliver results.
Continuously adapt to new tools and technologies, evaluating and adopting emerging techniques, including AI-assisted analytics, as the field evolves.
Coach and mentor junior data analysts, sharing best practices and analytical expertise.




Requirements




Demonstrated ability to influence decision-making through data-backed recommendations.
Proven experience managing projects and delivering results independently.
Good understanding of core analytics concepts, such as data modelling, blending, and visualization.
Experience balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Comfort operating in a fast-changing technical landscape and learning new tools, technologies, and analytical methodologies.
Experience within scholarly communications, publishing, or a related industry is advantageous but not essential.




Applicants must include a cover letter. This should clearly describe your interest in the role and how your skills, knowledge, and experience would contribute to the journal. Applications that do not include a cover letter will not be reviewed.




Work in a way that works for you




We promote a healthy work-life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people, with numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and flexible working arrangements to help you meet your personal and professional goals.




Working for you




We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:




Generous holiday allowance
Health and wellbeing benefits
Pension and savings plans
Life assurance and income protection
Flexible and hybrid working options
Employee assistance programmes
Learning and development opportunities




About Us




A global leader in information and analytics, Elsevier helps researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Our innovative solutions combine world-class scientific information with technology and analytics to help make research more effective and impactful.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
EXL (NASDAQ: EXLS) is a global data and artificial intelligence ("AI") company that offers services and solutions to reinvent client business models, drive better outcomes and unlock growth with speed. EXL harnesses the power of data, AI, and deep industry knowledge to transform businesses, including the world’s leading corporations in industries including insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, media and retail, among others. EXL was founded in 1999 with the core values of innovation, collaboration, excellence, integrity and respect.

We are headquartered in New York and have more than 60,000 employees spanning six continents. For more information, visit www.exlservice.com.




Role Title: Data Analyst

BU/Segment: Analytics

Location: London, United Kingdom (Hybrid working 3 days a week in the client office)

Employment Type: Permanent




Summary of the role:

EXL is looking for a Data Analyst with a passion for sports who will play a key role in providing analytics support to a client within our Sports, Media and Entertainment practice. Based in London, the role sits within the International Fan Data & Analytics team, supporting fanbase growth and engagement across international markets.




The primary responsibility of this role is to turn large, complex fan datasets into clear insights that help business stakeholders make better decisions. Working hands-on with SQL, Python and cloud data platforms such as Databricks, AWS and Snowflake, you will build the analysis, reporting and audience segments that power international marketing campaigns and track performance against growth goals. You will work with a dynamic team and will have real ownership of, and impact on, the analysis and data products you deliver.




The ideal candidate brings 2–5 years of analytics experience, strong technical skills and an understanding of the fan lifecycle, combined with the ability to translate business questions into well-structured analysis, explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences, and work closely with marketing, international and data engineering teams to deliver measurable value.

If you’re a passionate sports fan who enjoys solving problems with data – and you thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments – we’d love to connect.




As part of your duties, you will be responsible for:

Data Analysis

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, clean, transform and analyse large fan and marketing datasets.
Work within cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) to build and maintain analytical datasets and workflows.
Take a business question, develop an analysis plan, and deliver an answer that addresses it.
Summarise large data outputs into clear, business-friendly takeaways for stakeholders.




Reporting & Performance Tracking

Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports on fan growth, engagement and lifecycle metrics across international markets.
Monitor campaign and go-to-market (GTM) performance using agreed KPIs and success criteria.
Contribute to regular performance updates for team leads and senior stakeholders.




Campaign & Audience Enablement

Prepare audience segments and data for 1:1 marketing campaigns, including test/control groups.
Support segmentation analysis that helps regional teams deepen fan engagement in local markets.




Data Quality & Collaboration

Support user acceptance testing (UAT) of database changes and updates.
Help data engineering teams with root cause analysis (RCA) of data issues and bugs.
Work with marketing, international and data engineering teams to gather and document business requirements.
Liaise with third-party partners on data needs and definitions.




Qualifications and experience we consider to be essential for the role:

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
2–5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role.
Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations and window functions.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis (e.g., pandas, NumPy).
Hands-on experience with at least one cloud data platform: Databricks, AWS or Snowflake.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.
Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences




Skills and Personal attributes we would like to have:

Experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
Experience in marketing, CRM or customer analytics.
Knowledge of consent management, identity resolution or UK GDPR.
Experience in a consulting or client-facing environment.
Passion for sport and an understanding of global fan cultures.




As part of a leading global Data and AI company, you can look forward to:

A competitive salary with a generous bonus, private healthcare, critical illness life assurance at 4 x your annual salary, income protection insurance, and a rewarding pension.
EXL provides everyday financial well-being solutions, such as cash back cards, in which you can earn cashback while enjoying discounts, promotions, and offers from top retailers. We also offer a Cycle Scheme where you can save money on bikes and cycling accessories.
At EXL, we are committed to providing our employees with the tools and resources they need to succeed and excel in their careers. We offer a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities. We also support a range of learning initiatives that allow our employees to build on their existing skills and knowledge. From online courses to seminars and workshops, our employees have the opportunity to enhance their skills and stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, EXL is committed to diversity. Our company does not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, age, or disability status.
EXL employees are eligible to purchase stock as part of our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
At EXL, we offer a flexible hybrid working model that allows employees to live a balanced, healthy lifestyle while strengthening our culture of collaboration




To be considered for this role, you must already be eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Senior Data Analyst

Location: Very flexible - we’re happy for folks to work WFH and lots of us do. We only ask that you come into our London office a couple of times a month for team strategy days and socials - but of course, you're more than welcome to come in as much as you like! (+ we're working a 4 day work week - Fridays off!) 🏡

Contract: Permanent

Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 + benefits listed below




About Cuvva

We're on a mission to give everyone affordable access to a car anytime, anywhere 🚙




We offer short-term car insurance through our world-class app, creating truly flexible products that meet people’s real needs. Using lightning-fast technology to unlock better experiences and fairer prices for our customers, Cuvva is building the future of insurance every day.




Cuvva was the first to sell hourly insurance via an app in the UK back in 2016. And we haven’t stopped innovating since. We’ve sold over 16 million policies, and supported over 1.5 million drivers and we’re just getting started. We’re a team of 100 people, passionate about solving our customers’ problems. Join us. 🚀




Our Data & BI Stack:




Data & Analytics: SQL, Python, Sagemaker, Jupyter
Bi & Visualisation: Looker, Power BI
Data & Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform & wider cloud data environment
Product & Collaboration: Notion, Miro, Figma
AI & Data Science: Python based science tooling and emerging AI capabilities




About the role:

We’re looking for a commercially minded, technically strong individual contributor to join our Business Intelligence team at Cuvva. You’ll report to BI Management, working on some of the most interesting data and analytical problems across our insurance business.




We’re deliberately keeping this role broad. You might currently be working as a Data Analyst, Pricing Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Analyst or BI Manager, but what matters most is the depth of your analytical thinking, your understanding of insurance, and your ability to turn data into better commercial decisions.




You’ll work with complex datasets to understand performance, identify trends and opportunities, and help us make smarter decisions about our products and our business. You’ll bring industry knowledge, strong statistical reasoning, hands-on experience with SQL and Python, and the curiosity to dig beyond the obvious answer. You’ll be comfortable moving between detailed analysis and the bigger commercial question: what does this tell us, and what should we do about it?




Insurance experience is important to us, particularly within personal lines. Motor insurance is especially relevant, but we'd also consider strong candidates from other personal lines backgrounds such as home or pet. You’ll bring an understanding of how insurance businesses operate, the role data plays in pricing and performance, and the commercial factors that sit behind the numbers.




You’ll have the opportunity to work across areas including performance monitoring, pricing, product analytics, marketing, data science and AI, partnering with teams across Cuvva to turn analysis into action. We’re looking for someone who can challenge thinking, spot opportunities, explain complex ideas clearly and help us make better decisions through data.




On a day-to-day basis you’ll:




Manipulate, analyse and interpret datasets to provide insights and recommendations that help our business make better decisions
Work directly with our Head of Product to size opportunities before we build them, and to measure the impact of what we've shipped once it's live
Design and interpret A/B tests and feature rollouts, with a clear view on what the result means for the product and wider business
Work day to day with behavioural data, using funnel analysis and event tracking to connect app behaviour with policy, pricing and claims data
Analyse pricing, business and product performance, identifying trends, opportunities and areas where deeper investigation is needed
Follow analysis through to claims and loss ratio, so we understand the risk and commercial impact of what we ship, not just conversion
Own metric definitions and contribute to our semantic layer, helping ensure the business works from a consistent version of each number
Collaborate with BI and Data Engineering colleagues on analytical and data projects
Drive self-serve analytics across the business by coaching stakeholders and building the dashboards, metrics and documentation they need to answer their own questions
Support the Product team as we launch and iterate on new products and features




You’ll do great here if you have:




Experience working with data in the insurance industry, ideally within personal lines and preferably motor
Strong statistical reasoning, and can explain what an analysis does and doesn't support, including the assumptions and limitations behind your conclusions
A strong commercial mindset and can connect analysis to business performance, customer outcomes and commercial decisions
Are highly proficient in SQL and Python, being comfortable using Python for analysis, modelling and problem solving
Can work confidently with complex datasets, joining information from different sources to uncover insights and answer ambiguous questions
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner with senior stakeholders, ask the right questions and challenge thinking when needed
Excellent communication skills and can turn complex analysis into a clear story, recommendation or decision for your audience
Are comfortable working across functions and collaborating with BI, Data Engineering, Product, Pricing and other teams to solve problems
Experience working as a Data Analyst, Pricing Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Analyst or in a similar analytical role
Are curious about new approaches to data, including data science and AI, and are interested in how they can improve the way we make decisions
The ability to take an ambiguous business problem, work out what we need to know, and independently take it from question through analysis and recommendation




It’s a bonus if you have:




Have designed, run or interpreted experiments, A/B tests or feature rollouts
Have worked with a behavioural analytics tool such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or GA4 alongside a data warehouse
Have experience with machine learning models, including understanding how their performance and accuracy are evaluated




The hiring process: (All interviews are held remotely)




Initial chat with hiring manager (60m)
Technical interview & live challenge with peers (90m)
Values interview with People team & stakeholders (45m)
Founders chat with our CEO, Freddy (20m)




Benefits:

As well as a competitive salary (80,000 - £100,000 depending on experience), benefits of working at Cuvva include:

Very flexible WFH set up, we only ask folks to come in a couple of times a month for team strategy days and socials - but of course, you're more than welcome to come in as much as you like!
A four day work week (Fridays off!)
An office worth visiting - Old Sessions House is a stunning private members club with a rooftop, infinity pool and regular members events. Not your average workplace!
Transparent salary model and bands for all roles (without sharing anyone's individual salary of course!)
20.5 days of holiday a year + public holidays - rising with each year at Cuvva 🌞 (holidays have been prorated based on our 4DWW)
Quarterly team socials and company events
Private medical insurance with Bupa
Professional development budget
Health, WFH and wellbeing budget 🧘 ♂️
Increases to all allowances year on year
Enhanced parental leave and pay
Cycle to work scheme
Mental Health and Coaching Support - We offer free and confidential access to comprehensive mental healthcare and coaching through Oliva. Giving you the space to talk to a coach or therapist about anything you like
Hundreds of perks and discounts with Perkbox
£100 a month towards your Cuvva car insurance
Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join the Cuvva team 💸




Referrals:

Know someone who could be right for this job? We’d love to hear from them, please drop us a note at jobs@cuvva.com to let us know who you'll be referring and for which role. If they get the job, you will receive an Apple Watch! If someone has already applied to the role before we receive your email they will not be considered a referral, so please check with them beforehand to make sure 🙂




Cuvva ways of working:

We’re dedicated to creating a place where people want to work, a place where people believe in what they’re doing, have clear expectations and a bunch of freedom.




Our approach to hybrid working is very flexible: we only ask people to come a couple of times a month for team building or company events. The rest of time it’s up to you where and how you work. You can of course come into the office as much as you like!




Diversity, inclusion and belonging at Cuvva:

At Cuvva, we’re dedicated to building an environment where individuals from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging and have the support they need to thrive. To us, it’s crucial that our differences are embraced and celebrated - and that you’re able to bring your whole self to work everyday.




Research shows that men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, but women and those in traditionally underrepresented groups tend to apply only if they check all the boxes. If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
CBRE Global Workplace Solutions is a leading global provider of integrated facilities and corporate real estate management. We are recruiting a Data Analyst to join the team located in London.

About The Role

As a CBRE Data Analyst, you will perform basic analysis to ensure that recommendations and business conclusions are backed by thorough data research and findings.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Coordinate data aggregation and curate reports using existing business intelligence and reporting applications.
Perform ad-hoc, strategic review of structured and unstructured data, reflecting global real estate markets and the operations of real estate assets.
Assist with developing data structures and pipelines to organize, collect, cleanse, and standardize information to generate insights.
Define basic data requirements and gather information using judgment and statistical tests.
Use programming and evaluation tools, including open-source programs to plan models and extract insights.
Apply modeling and optimization methods to improve business performance.
Develop ad-hoc reporting based on the review of existing data sources.
Exhibit rigor, judgment, and ability to present a detailed 'data story' to a business line.
Confirm the quality and integrity of existing data sources.
Collaborate with the agile development team to provide recommendations and communications on enhancing existing or new processes and programs.
Have some knowledge of standard principles with limited practical experience in applying them.
Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values.
Impact the quality of own work.
Work within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
Exchange straightforward information, ask questions, and check for understanding.


What You’ll Need


Bachelor's Degree preferred with up to 3 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. MCSE and CNE Certification preferred.
Ability to use existing procedures to solve standard problems.
Experience with analyzing information and standard practices to make judgments.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.


Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Moon Commerce

Moon Commerce Limited is a UK-registered technology company building and operating digital ventures across commerce, consulting, property and SaaS. We trade online, advise businesses on digital transformation and data-driven marketing, and are developing an AI-powered automation platform that turns repetitive processes into scalable systems.

We're small and early-stage, which means the person in this role will see the whole business rather than one corner of it.

The role

Our data currently lives in separate places — sales platforms, ad accounts, client reporting, and internal systems. You'll bring it together and turn it into reporting the team actually uses to make decisions.

This is a hands-on role with direct mentoring from the leadership team. You won't be maintaining someone else's dashboards; you'll be building the reporting layer from the ground up.

What you'll do

Build and maintain dashboards covering trading performance, marketing spend and client delivery
Extract, clean and join data from multiple sources
Turn business questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations people can act on
Own weekly and monthly reporting across our ventures
Support pricing, inventory and campaign decisions with evidence
Document your work so it survives you

Your first three months

Month 1: learn the ventures, map where every data source lives, fix the reporting that's most broken
Month 2: ship your first dashboard into weekly use
Month 3: Own the monthly reporting pack end to end

What we're looking for

Minimum 2 years' hands-on SQL experience
Python (pandas) or strong Excel, plus Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio
At least one project you can walk us through end to end and defend the decisions in
Clear written and spoken English; you'll present to non-technical people
Attention to detail and a habit of checking your own numbers
Right to work in the UK — we cannot offer sponsorship
Able to work from our [area] office 2 days a week

Nice to have

eCommerce, marketplace or digital marketing data experience
GA4, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central or similar
Any exposure to Git

What we offer

Salary £35,000–£39,000 depending on experience
25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays
Office closed between Christmas and New Year
Workplace pension with [15 ]% employer contributions]
Hybrid working — 2 days a week at our [area] office, 37.5 hours, permanent
£[3750] annual learning budget for courses and certifications
Direct mentoring from the leadership team and exposure across every venture
Real ownership of your work and a short path to broader responsibility

Hiring process

20-minute introductory call
45-minute technical conversation including a short SQL exercise
30-minute conversation with the founding team

We aim to give a decision within a week of the final stage, and we give feedback either way.

Reporting to: Technology Lead

Visa sponsorship: We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must already hold the right to work in the UK.

Equal opportunities

Moon Commerce is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions on merit. If you need any adjustment to the application or interview process, tell us and we'll arrange it.

Description:
About MoonPay
MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

Remote across Europe, with hybrid working encouraged if you're near a Moonbase (around 2 to 3 days per week in the London office).



About The Opportunity
In this role, you'll help shape MoonPay's product and business decisions through data, combining deep analysis, experimentation, and strong stakeholder partnership to drive real impact.

You'll sit within our centralised Product Data team and work closely with Product and Engineering, owning analytics across the full product lifecycle, from defining problems and success metrics through to launching, measuring, and optimising products at scale.

Your work will directly influence product strategy, customer experience, and business health, helping teams make better, faster decisions through trusted insights and clear narratives. You'll also raise the leverage of the whole team by building reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that let the wider org self-serve reliable answers.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning complex data into clear direction, influencing decisions, and helping shape the future of high-impact financial and crypto products.

What You Will Do


Partner with product and business teams to run rigorous analysis (root cause, opportunity sizing, funnel drop-off) and turn it into clear, prioritised recommendations, moving across problem areas as priorities shift.
Define, document, and maintain clear metric definitions and business context, so stakeholders can understand the performance of their area and AI tools can interpret our metrics correctly (e.g. Transaction Success Rate, Fraud Rate).
Set up tracking and monitoring for new launches and changes, and quantify and measure their impact on KPIs.
Build and maintain a reporting layer, with automated alerting and root cause analysis that flags when KPIs move unexpectedly and why.
Design, run, and interpret experiments, from A/B tests to quasi-experimental methods like difference-in-differences when randomisation isn't possible.
Model robust, trusted data in our dbt and BigQuery layer, safeguarding its quality through testing, documentation, and certification in collaboration with engineering.
Create reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that scale the team's impact and help Product and Engineering self-serve.
Communicate complex concepts and findings to technical and non-technical audiences across different teams, while ensuring clarity and understanding to drive critical business decisions.



About You
Must-have experience and skills

5+ years of hands-on experience as a data analyst or data scientist, preferably in a product-focused role.
Advanced SQL and data visualisation are second nature to you.
Hands-on experience building data models in a modern cloud warehouse and transformation framework (e.g. dbt with BigQuery, Snowflake), with a strong instinct for data quality.
A solid grasp of statistics and probability, including experiment design and interpretation (A/B and quasi-experimental methods such as difference-in-differences).
A working understanding of how a payments or fintech business operates, including fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, and payment success rates.
Comfort using AI-assisted and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, and curiosity about building reusable skills that scale your impact.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder skills. You can distill complex findings for any audience up to C-level, and lead projects independently.



Nice-to-have Experience

Familiarity with our stack (dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Python) and AI tooling such as Claude Code.
Hands-on financial crime, payments, or fraud analytics experience.
Experience working in start-ups or scale-ups.



Bonus Points


A crypto-native perspective and experience with on-chain and blockchain data (e.g. Dune, Flipside, Chainalysis).
Experience making data self-serve for non-analysts (e.g. semantic layers, metric stores).

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Location: Home-based (UK)

Travel: Approximately 2 UK trips per year

Hours: Full-time (37.5 hours per week)

Turn data into insights that drive business decisions.

At BioPhorum, we bring together the world's leading pharmaceutical, biotech and MedTech organisations to collaborate, solve complex challenges and accelerate innovation that improves patient outcomes.

As our organisation continues to grow, data is playing an increasingly important role in how we make decisions, measure performance and identify new opportunities. We're looking for a talented Business Intelligence Analyst to help transform data into meaningful insights that support every part of our business.

If you're passionate about analytics, enjoy solving problems and want your work to have a genuine impact, we'd love to hear from you.

About The Role

Reporting to the IT Operations Director, you'll play a key role in developing and delivering business intelligence across BioPhorum.

Working with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Client Services and Operations, you'll build dashboards, analyse complex datasets and provide insights that support strategic planning, operational performance and business growth.

This is an opportunity to work with modern Microsoft technologies, contribute to a growing data function and influence how data is used across the organisation.

What You'll Be Doing

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Building, developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports
Analysing complex business data to identify trends, opportunities and risks
Developing robust data models using SQL, DAX and Power Query
Supporting business forecasting, KPI reporting and performance measurement
Working with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and deliver practical solutions
Improving data quality and helping maintain trusted reporting across the organisation
Automating reporting processes to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency
Presenting data and insights in a clear, engaging way for both technical and non-technical audiences


About You

You'll be naturally curious, analytical and enjoy using data to solve business problems.

We're Looking For Someone With


Strong experience developing reports and dashboards in Power BI
Excellent SQL skills for querying, transforming and analysing data
Experience with DAX, Power Query and data modelling
Knowledge of data warehousing, ETL processes and reporting best practice
The ability to communicate complex information clearly and influence decision-making
Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
Experience working with multiple data sources and supporting self-service reporting
Experience with Microsoft Azure, the Power Platform or Dynamics 365 would be an advantage, but isn't essential.


Why Join BioPhorum?

At BioPhorum, data isn't just about reporting—it's central to how we improve our business and deliver value for our members.

We Offer


A fully remote UK-based role with flexibility and work-life balance
The opportunity to work with modern Microsoft data technologies
Interesting, business-critical projects with real organisational impact
A collaborative, supportive and high-performing team
Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning
The chance to influence how data is used across a growing international organisation


About BioPhorum

Founded in 2004, BioPhorum is the global collaboration community for the biopharmaceutical and MedTech industries. We connect over 7,000 subject matter experts from more than 150 leading organisations, helping them work together to solve complex industry challenges and drive innovation.

Recognised as one of Europe's fastest-growing companies, we're continuing to invest in our people, technology and future growth.

If you're looking for a role where your analytical skills will influence real business decisions and where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of business intelligence within a growing organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Senior Data Analyst – Labour & Productivity
Description:
The Role..

We are starting a labour optimisation programme with our Operations team, alongside FP&A and Data Science. The aim is to improve our wage percentage to sales while improving service standards at the same time. We are not interested in an approach that delivers one at the expense of the other.

We are currently selecting an advanced scheduling platform to support this. The analytical foundation underneath it,how we measure productivity, what our labour standards are, how good our demand forecasts need to be - is what this role owns.

You will sit in the Data team and work in close partnership with FP&A. Analysis alone will not move the number; changes stick when a Finance Business Partner and a General Manager can see the opportunity in their own House, agree the size of it and hold it in their forecast. Your job is to give them that, in a form they can act on.

Key Responsibilities..


Labour productivity analysis, identifying site-by-site opportunities for efficiency gains and sizing each one
Work with Operations and Finance to trial changes to scheduling and measure their impact
Build improved labour reporting, so Business Partners and GMs can see productivity, schedule changes and shift adherence on a daily and weekly cadence
Support Finance translate demand forecasts into labour requirements, helping to build the models that turn covers, check-ins, treatments and occupancy into hours by role
Partner with our Data Science and Operations teams to understand forecast accuracy and recommend improvements
Connect labour deployment to member experience, so that productivity gains are demonstrably not coming out of the House


What we are looking for..


Proven experience in labour optimisation. You have personally delivered measurable improvement in wage percentage or sales per labour hour in a multi-site operation, and can talk us through the levers you pulled, how you sized them and how you proved the result
A track record of partnering finance and operational stakeholders to land change, not just report on it
Several years in an analytics role, with genuine multi-site operational exposure — hospitality, retail, leisure or QSR
Advanced SQL, and comfort in a modelled data warehouse (experience with dbt an advantage)
BI development experience (Omni, Looker, Tableau or Power BI), building tools operators actually use
Experience with rota, time and attendance and payroll data, and a realistic view of its challenges
Able to evaluate a demand forecast critically — accuracy, bias, seasonality — without needing to build one


Desirable..


Experience with a workforce management or scheduling platform — Unifocus, HotSchedules, Dayforce, Fourth, S4 Labour, UKG, Quinyx or similar
Strong financial modelling and fluency in P&L mechanics — wage percentage, flow-through, contribution
An understanding of how labour regulation constrains labour models internationally, particularly the US — predictive scheduling and fair workweek rules, overtime and break requirements
Labour standards or time-and-motion experience
Python for data analysis and modelling, and/or use of AI tooling such as Claude Code to accelerate it
Experience linking labour deployment to customer experience outcomes


Benefits..

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to grow your career.


Discounts at Soho House globally, as well as Soho Home and Cowshed
Annual Every House Membership
Enhanced Pension Scheme
Private Health and Dental Care
Cycle to Work Scheme/Season Ticket Loan
In conjunction with Soho Impact, take 3 days paid a year to support a charity of your choice.
Cookhouse & House Tonic: Our Cookhouse & House Tonic programmes offer unique food and drink trainings, events and opportunities to inspire and educate.
Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing Policy team, working with 24 leading UK universities. We’re looking for an outstanding Data Analyst to provide analytical and data visualisation support for our policy development and advocacy work.




Through collaboration and advocacy, the Russell Group works to advance and champion the positive economic, societal and cultural contributions of our universities. The Russell Group represents the interests of our 24 university members at the highest level of government, as well as with key research and innovation funders, with business, third-sector partners, regulators, and internationally with like-minded bodies.




As Data Analyst, you will provide robust, clear and timely analysis of a wide range of higher education and research datasets to support the Russell Group’s policy and advocacy positions. This is a new role in the organisation to increase our data analytical capability, supporting the work of colleagues across the Strategic Policy and External Relations teams.




The role involves, but is not limited to, the following:




Undertaking regular and timely analysis of official datasets relevant to the Russell Group including:

Higher Education datasets published by UCAS, HESA, OfS and DfE.
Research and Innovation datasets published by HESA, UKRI, and DBIST.
Datasets relevant to the international team including the CORDIS Horizon Europe Dataset and Home Office migration statistics




Providing data analytical support across the organisation including to colleagues in the Strategic Policy and External Relations teams. This will include:




Working with the Senior Data Manager to quality assure internal data and analysis across the organisation.




Assessing and critiquing ad hoc data presented in media articles, academic publications and think tank reports.




Providing high quality briefings in writing and in person for internal and external parties on data relating to higher education and research.




Creating effective data visualisations to support analysis, storytelling and advocacy, tailoring outputs appropriately for internal colleagues and Russell Group members, as well as political, media and other external stakeholder audiences.




Ensuring that Russell Group policy and external engagement work is informed by an awareness and thorough understanding of relevant data.




Working with the Senior Data Manager to enhance the overall competency within the Russell Group to use data effectively for policy and communications purposes.




Managing data in accordance with the Russell Group's data protection policies.




You will also be responsible for delivering any additional responsibilities, at the request of the Director of Strategic Policy, in accordance with your experience and the broad purpose of this role.




Candidates will need to be able to demonstrate the following:




Keen attention to detail and strong analytical skills, including the ability to undertake statistical analysis. Being an expert user of Excel, including the use of pivot tables, is essential.




Substantial experience analysing large and complex data sets. Ideally with direct experience of working with the higher education and research datasets described above.




Experience of using data to inform policy analysis/development and to underpin impactful advocacy.




The ability to exercise excellent judgement on the confidence of particular data analysis outputs and be able to advise Strategic Policy and External Relations colleagues on the limitations of available datasets and how to use data in ways which are proportionate, robust and not misleading.




Experience of presenting and explaining data outcomes to a range of audiences including internal and external stakeholders, and communicating complex findings clearly and succinctly.




Experience of selecting and creating appropriate visual formats to communicate complex data clearly, including charts, dashboards, infographics and other accessible formats for non-specialist audiences.




The ability to work in an agile way in a fast-paced environment, managing and prioritising a challenging and varied portfolio of work to meet tight deadlines. A flexible, collegiate and cooperative approach to working is essential.




An interest in and knowledge of the higher education policy landscape would also be desirable.




Our Candidate Pack, which includes the vacancy description for the role, and our Equal Opportunities Monitoring form are available to download from the Russell Group Careers site (https://russellgroup-ac-uk.pinpointhq.com/)




Our offices are based in the heart of Westminster, with proximity to key stakeholders and easy access to public transport links. To maximise effective team-based working, we offer flexibility for staff to work from home up to two days a week, subject to work priorities. Benefits include:




Membership of the USS pension scheme
25 days of Annual Leave at start, increasing by 1 day annually to a maximum of 30 days
Discretionary closure days at Easter and Christmas holidays (in addition to Public Holidays)
Private healthcare insurance
Employee Assistance Programme




The starting salary will be in the range of £40,000-£45,000. This is dependent on skills and experience. A higher salary may be available for exceptional and highly experienced candidates.




Closing date for all applications: 17:00 on Wednesday, 28 October 2026




To apply, please visit our Careers site (https://russellgroup-ac-uk.pinpointhq.com/) and submit the following by the closing date:




1) An up-to-date curriculum vitae (max. two sides of A4) including:

details of your current and past employment
your degree qualifications including subjects and grades
a reference from your current or most recent employer




2) A cover letter no more than two sides of A4 addressing the following points:

how your knowledge, skills and experience meet the requirements of the role
why you are interested in working for the Russell Group




3) We ask all applicants to complete an Equal Opportunities Monitoring form which you can download from our Careers site.




Further information on the Russell Group can be found at https://www.russellgroup.ac.uk/

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
London (Hybrid) |circa £45,000 | Permanent




Our client is a global leader in shopper intelligence and personalised retail media. For nearly four decades they have helped many of the world's largest FMCG/CPG brands and retailers turn purchase data into measurable commercial growth. Operating across six major international markets and reaching hundreds of millions of shoppers, the business analyses billions of retail transactions every year, drawn from tens of thousands of connected stores. That gives it one of the richest and most complete views of real shopper behaviour anywhere in the industry - the kind of first-party purchase data most brands can only dream of.




The Role

Sitting within the analytics team, you'll turn shopper and campaign data into clear, actionable insight. Day to day that means building dashboards, running customer and shopper segmentation, and using Python to analyse behaviour and measure campaign performance for CPG/FMCG clients.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role for a genuinely analytical person - someone who enjoys getting into large datasets and working out the outputs that drive decisions. You'll work closely with commercial, marketing and account teams, translating technical analysis into recommendations that non-technical stakeholders can act on.




Key Responsibilities:

Build and maintain dashboards that give stakeholders clear visibility of shopper and campaign performance.
Deliver customer and shopper segmentation to sharpen targeting, audience strategy and campaign effectiveness.
Use Python (and SQL) to extract, clean and analyse large transactional datasets.
Measure campaign performance and ROI, surfacing trends, patterns and commercial opportunities in the data.
Translate analysis into practical, commercial recommendations for internal teams and clients.
Partner with commercial, marketing and account teams to ensure analytics directly supports business objectives.
Help streamline and automate reporting workflows to make insight faster and more scalable.




Requirements:

Essential

Around 3 years' experience in a data or analytics role - ideally within CPG/FMCG, retail, loyalty or marketing/media analytics.
Strong Python for data analysis and automation.
Proven dashboard / BI development (Power BI, Tableau or similar).
Hands-on experience with customer or shopper segmentation.
Strong SQL and confidence working with large datasets.
A genuinely analytical mindset a curious, problem-solving person who enjoys getting into the data and working out the outputs.
Excellent communication - able to turn technical analysis into clear commercial insight for non-technical stakeholders.




Desirable

Exposure to FMCG/CPG, retail or loyalty-scheme data.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure or Databricks.
Understanding of campaign measurement and personalised media.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact


Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights.
Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement.
Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions.
Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs.
Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.
Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems.
Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use.
Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities.


Your background


A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or a similar analytics role.
Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently extract, manipulate and analyse complex datasets.
Experience using Tableau or another mainstream BI/data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase or Sisense.
Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect analysis with meaningful business outcomes.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
A proactive approach, with the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and take ownership.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex business requirements into meaningful insights.


The role is based in London, UK, with a hybrid working model requiring three days per week in the office.

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

Title: Data Analyst III
Description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

We are seeking a Data Analyst III to join our Sportsbook organization in the Product Analytics team.

This role will focus on creating insights to drive product development and enhance business performance. The individual will partner closely with senior stakeholders in the Sportsbook Product team and be responsible for supporting them with testing, performance tracking, reporting, and ad-hoc queries.

Responsibilities


Develop a strong understanding of Fanatics Betting and Gaming, with particular focus on the Sportsbook.
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, becoming a key contributor to data-driven decision-making within the Sportsbook Product team.
Support the Sportsbook Product team with testing, analysis and reporting as they develop the product and optimize user experiences.
Be a hands-on analyst, creating insights both regular and ad hoc. Gather and present insights metrics and activities to key stakeholders, becoming a trusted source of intelligence and advisory over time.
Collaborate with Analysts and Data Scientists to find solutions to business problems.
Remain current on technology and trends in data analytics and the sports betting & gaming industry.


Experience


A minimum of 5 years proven experience in an analytics role
Previous experience in the betting and gaming industry is a significant plus


Technical Skills


Degree in a relevant field, e.g. Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Engineering, or Computer Science
Strong SQL proficiency
Proficiency in a statistical programming language, e.g. R or Python
Proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools, e.g. Tableau or PowerBI
Strong proficiency in data analysis or mathematical model development, with a strong understanding of statistics concepts such as multivariate testing
Experience using code repositories, e.g. GitHub
Experience with Amplitude a plus


Non Technical Skills


Demonstrated ability to partner closely with stakeholders, earning trust and prioritizing relationships
Customer focused; highly outcome-oriented and data-driven; experienced in working in high-growth environments
Logical and analytical approach to problem solving, with strong organizational and communication skills


Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.

Title: Data Analyst – Power BI Microsoft Fabric (35903)
Description:
Data Analyst – Power BI / Microsoft Fabric

Location: Ottawa, ON – On-site

Hours: 40 hours/week (8 hours/day)

Start: ASAP

Compensation: $90,000–$106,740

Benefits: Full benefits

Clearance: Must be eligible to successfully complete the required background/security screening

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join a highly collaborative technology and data team supporting a complex, operational environment in Ottawa.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior-to-mid-level Data Analyst with strong Power BI, SQL and Microsoft data technologies experience who enjoys turning data into meaningful dashboards, reporting and business insights.

Reporting to a senior technology leader and working closely with a Data Architect, you will design and maintain dashboards, reports, data models and analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related Azure/cloud analytics technologies.

This is also a stakeholder-facing role. Strong communication, listening skills and the ability to understand business requirements and explain data clearly are equally important to technical capability.

What You'll Do


Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations and performance metrics for operational and executive audiences.
Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze data from multiple systems.
Build and maintain dimensional and semantic data models supporting reporting and self-service analytics.
Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse workloads, and related Azure Data Services.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Use Python/Pandas for data preparation, automation and analysis.
Gather and understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into effective analytical and reporting solutions.
Analyze complex datasets and communicate findings as clear, actionable business insights.
Support data quality, consistency, documentation, governance, privacy and security requirements.
Help evaluate, improve and automate existing reporting processes and systems.
Work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders and external vendors/service providers.


What We're Looking For


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or a related analytical role.
3+ years developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with dimensional data modelling.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse), Azure Data Services or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms.
Experience with Python/Pandas.
Experience integrating data using APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Ability to analyze complex information and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong communication and listening skills, professional presence and a clear, structured approach to problem-solving.
Comfortable working directly with business users, customers and stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
Tableau experience and exposure to other BI/reporting technologies such as Qlik, Looker, SSRS or advanced Excel.
Experience with Snowflake, AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience in aviation, transportation or another complex 24/7 operational environment.
Knowledge of data governance, privacy and information security practices.
Experience with operational performance metrics and reporting standards.
Ability to communicate in English and French is an asset.


Who Will Succeed In This Role

You don't need to be the most senior technical person in the room. We're looking for someone who combines solid hands-on data skills with the ability to listen, understand requirements, communicate clearly and work collaboratively.

You should be technically adaptable, comfortable taking direction from senior data/technology professionals, and confident interacting directly with stakeholders to turn their requirements into useful, reliable data solutions.

À propos de Highspring

Highspring est une firme de consultation et de services professionnels de nouvelle génération. Nous accompagnons des organisations partout en Amérique du Nord dans leurs initiatives de transformation, de modernisation technologique et d'innovation.

Nous collaborons avec des organisations de premier plan, notamment dans les secteurs bancaire, de l'assurance et des technologies, afin de concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions modernes ayant un impact concret.

Chez Highspring, nous valorisons l'excellence technique, la collaboration, l'apprentissage continu et le développement de nos talents.

L'opportunité

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Data Analyst pour rejoindre une équipe travaillant sur des projets data d'envergure à Montréal.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable d'analyser, de transformer et de valoriser les données afin de générer des insights d'affaires concrets et de soutenir la prise de décision. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes techniques et d'affaires afin de comprendre les besoins, développer des analyses pertinentes et contribuer à l'évolution des solutions data.

Une bonne maîtrise de SQL et des services AWS est essentielle pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Localisation : Montréal, QC

Mode de travail : Hybride

Langues : Français et anglais - bilinguisme requis

Analyser de grands volumes de données afin d'identifier des tendances, anomalies et opportunités.
Transformer les besoins d'affaires en analyses et solutions data concrètes.
Développer et optimiser des requêtes SQL complexes.
Travailler avec les services AWS afin d'extraire, traiter et analyser les données.
Participer à la conception et à l'évolution des processus de collecte, transformation et consommation des données.
Développer et maintenir des rapports, dashboards et indicateurs de performance.
Transformer les résultats d'analyse en recommandations et insights actionnables pour les équipes d'affaires.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data Engineering, BI, développement, produit et les parties prenantes d'affaires.

Identifier les problèmes liés aux données et contribuer à leur résolution.
Documenter les analyses, les processus et les indicateurs développés.
Participer à des projets d'amélioration continue et de modernisation des solutions data.
Évoluer dans un environnement Agile et collaboratif.

3 à 5+ années d'expérience en Data Analytics ou dans un rôle similaire.
Excellente maîtrise de SQL.
Expérience pratique avec AWS, notamment avec certains des services suivants :
Amazon S3
Amazon Athena
Amazon Redshift
AWS Glue
Expérience avec des outils de BI et de visualisation, tels que :
Power BI
Tableau
ou outils similaires.
Expérience dans l'analyse de données et la production de business insights.
Bonne compréhension des bases de données relationnelles et des concepts de data warehousing.
