Title: Data Analyst, Go-To-Market Sales Insights
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data is at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to build the tools and analytics that drive revenue for the sales organization behind Lyft's B2B portfolio — a multi-billion-dollar book of business spanning healthcare, business travel, corporate commute, automotive, and transit. This team has real say in what gets built.

You will be the analytical partner to our Sales and account teams — someone who can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Build the tools and analytics sales leaders use to grow their accounts — pacing views, account-health signals, territory and segment views that change what a rep or manager does next
Field requests from Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, leadership, and external stakeholders, and decide what's worth building, what's worth a sharp piece of analysis, and what's out of scope
Build and maintain production data pipelines, and automate recurring workflows, with documentation and validation clear enough that a teammate — or an AI agent — can use them without asking you first
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Contribute to the internal tools and semantic layer — prompts, context, and guardrails — that let stakeholders query B2B data in natural language and trust what comes back
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally supporting a sales, go-to-market, or B2B organization
Proficiency in SQL — able to read, write, and review structured, efficient queries on large data sets, whether you wrote them yourself or an AI coding assistant did; you own the correctness of every query and result before it reaches stakeholders
Experience building production data assets — pipelines, data models, or orchestrated tables (Airflow, dbt, or similar) — not only ad-hoc analysis
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Hex, Mode, or similar
Experience with sales or account analytics — pipeline, bookings, pacing to target, account segmentation — is a strong plus
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Commercial instinct paired with a builder's instinct — a track record of turning a recurring request into a durable tool or dataset instead of answering it one more time
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits


Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

The expected base pay range for this position in the Torornto area is CAD $102,000 - CAD $!27,500, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

Lyft may use artificial intelligence to screen applicants, however, Lyft employees make the ultimate selection and hiring decisions.

This job fills an existing vacancy.

Title: Analyste sénior en intelligence d'affaires
HTML:
Sous la supervision de la Directrice-adjointe analyse, l'analyste en intelligence d'affaires senior jouera un rôle clé dans la conception de tableaux de bord, l'analyse de tendances et la production de prévisions basées sur les données. Il/Elle contribuera à la définition, la mise en place et l'évolution des indicateurs de performance, des mesures, des tableaux de bord et des schémas de données nécessaires au déploiement de l'intelligence d'affaires d'AGA.

L'analyste sera également responsable de promouvoir et d'assurer l'application de bonnes pratiques en matière de gestion et d'utilisation sécuritaire des données. Le développement de relations solides, tant avec les collègues multidisciplinaires de l'équipe qu'avec les clients internes sur le terrain, demeure essentiel pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Le·la titulaire de ce poste sera, entre autres, appelé à :

  • Collecter, transformer, nettoyer et organiser les données provenant de différentes sources internes, en veillant à leur qualité et à leur cohérence;
  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et rapports à l'aide d'outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou outils similaires;
  • Accompagner les équipes dans la gestion du changement lors de l'implantation de nouvelles solutions, notamment par la formation et la documentation;
  • Proposer et réaliser des analyses descriptives et exploratoires pour identifier des tendances, infos pertinentes, anomalies ou opportunités;
  • Collaborer avec l'ensemble des équipes métiers AGA (actuariat, finances, opérations, marketing, etc.) afin de comprendre leurs besoins, analyser leurs flux de travail afin de proposer des solutions et identifier des axes d'amélioration basées sur les données;
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de gestion de données et de production de rapports;
  • Documenter les méthodologies, les besoins, les indicateurs de performance, les mesures, les tableaux de bord, les schémas de données, les sources de données, les processus afin d'assurer la traçabilité et la fiabilité des analyses;
  • Déterminer les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), élaborer les mesures nécessaires à l'évaluation de la performance, analyser l'évolution des résultats et développer des modèles prévisionnels lorsque requis;
  • Effectuer des analyses ad hoc ou extraire des listes de données selon les besoins;
  • Documenter et mettre à jour de façon quotidienne et systématique l'ensemble de ses tâches et projets dans JIRA, afin d'assurer un suivi clair et en temps réel de l'avancement;
  • Créer et maintenir des flux Power Automate;
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe de même nature et en relation directe avec cet emploi ou à la demande de son supérieur.

Le·la candidat·e idéal·e possède ce qui suit:

Formation et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, intelligence d’affaires, informatique / sciences informatiques / informatique de gestion, gestion de l'information ou Baccalauréat d’ingénieur (génie informatique / génie des technologies de l’information) et/ou d’ingénierie et analytique des données (Maîtrise est un atout);
  • 5-7 ans d’expérience en analyse de données, prévisions et création de tableaux de bord;
  • Expérience en assurances collectives est un atout.

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de Power BI;
  • Maîtrise d’Excel, de la suite Office et de SQL;
  • Compétences mathématiques et/ou académiques nécessaires pour recueillir, mesurer, organiser et analyser des données et effectuer des prévisions statistiques;
  • Capacité à transformer des données brutes en informations utiles et compréhensibles;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, pour collaborer efficacement avec nos équipes partout au Canada;
  • Connaissance de Power Automate un atout;
  • Connaissance de Power BI Report Builder un atout;
  • Familiarité avec un langage de programmation analytique (Python ou R) un atout;
  • Connaissance de base de JIRA et de Confluence un atout.

Qualités personnelles et professionnelles

  • Esprit analytique développé et grande rigueur;
  • Forte curiosité analytique et esprit critique pour proposer des axes d’analyse innovants et des visualisations percutantes;
  • Excellent sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités;
  • Aptitude à travailler en équipe et à communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs non techniques (vulgarisation des calculs ou des résultats);
  • Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité des données.

Mistplay is on a mission to be the best way to play mobile games for everyone everywhere! Download Mistplay on the Google Play Store here and follow us on Instagram, Twitter and Facebook.

Au sein du service des données de Mistplay, l'analyste de données sénior I, Produit jouera un rôle crucial dans l'amélioration de la performance commerciale de Mistplay grâce à une analyse perspicace et à une stratégie d'analyse dynamique. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A career as a Senior Data Analyst in the Financial crime team at National Bank means serving as a Data and Analytics Specialist. This position allows you to have a concrete impact on decision-making and the evolution of the sector's analytical capabilities thanks to your expertise in data analysis, business intelligence and information governance. You will play a key role in transforming data into strategic information, supporting business partners in their decisions and contributing to the evolution of data solutions in a constantly changing environment.




Your job

Understand the needs of business partners and translate them into data requirements and adapted analytical solutions.
Analyze sector data, define business rules and ensure they are documented in order to support rigourous governance.
Prepare and validate reliable data for reports, dashboards, analyses and strategic initiatives.
Work with the it and data engineering teams to develop data platforms and contribute to modernisation projects, particularly on snowflake.
Diagnose data issues, identify their causes and coordinate their resolution to ensure operational continuity.
Produce value-added analyses, make recommendations based on data and communicate the results to the partners concerned.




Your team

The Vice-President, Technology and Data, more specialists work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

Within the Financial crime and regulatory projects sector, you will be part of the FinCrim Data Warehouse team and report to the Senior Manager – it Delivery – Data and Analytics. Our team stands out for its expertise in data engineering, its culture of collaboration and its commitment to developing reliable, high-performance and scalable solutions that support the Bank's financial crime activities and regulatory initiatives. Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.

The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalised training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.




Prerequisites

A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Analytics, Business Intelligence or a related field.
Over two years of significant experience in data analysis, business intelligence or analytics in a complex data environment.
Proficient SQL and be able to analyse complex data sets.
Python experience analyzing, profiling or automating data
Ability to transform business needs into data requirements and analytical solutions
Knowledge of modern data platforms, such as snowflake, as well as data modelling concepts, such as Data Vault or dimensional modelling.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Business Acumen, Dashboard Creation, Data Cleansing, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data pipeline, Data Validator, Data Vaults, Data Visualization, Exploratory Data Analysis, Microsoft SQL Server, Python, Risk Data and Analytics, Snowflake, Teamwork

Your benefits
In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment
We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Ethics and Compliance
Description:
When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:


Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
Competitive base salary
Retirement savings plan
Employee Assistance Program
Tele Health Program



What are your contributions to the team?


Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that provide clear visibility into Ethics & Compliance metrics, trends, and risks (e.g., investigations, hotline, third-party risk, training).
Integrate and analyze data across multiple Ethics & Compliance datasets, creating a unified view to support decision-making and oversight.
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify anomalies, patterns, and potential indicators of misconduct or non-compliance.
Design and optimize data pipelines, data models, and automation processes to improve scalability, timeliness, and reliability of compliance data.
Partner with cross-functional teams (including Legal, HR, Audit, Risk, IT) to understand data needs and deliver actionable insights.
Enable data-driven investigations by extracting, analyzing, and interpreting relevant data.
Lead the evolution of analytics for our Ethics and Compliance organization, including the development of predictive analytics and forward-looking risk indicators.
Support the Strategy & Governance analyst to translate complex data into clear, business-friendly insights for leadership and stakeholders.



How to thrive in this role?


You have a Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
You have 5–8+ years of experience in data analytics.
You have advanced technical skills in:
SQL and data querying
Data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
You have familiarity with Databricks and programming languages such as Python or R; this would be considered an asset.
You have experience working with multiple, complex datasets and integrating them into cohesive reporting solutions.
You have an analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and hidden risks.
You demonstrate a high level of integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.
You are curious and adaptable, with an interest in advancing into predictive and advanced analytics.
You have the ability to build dashboards and tell a compelling data story to both technical and non-technical audiences.
You have experience working within an Ethics & Compliance, Risk, Audit, or Legal environment, as well as familiarity with compliance-related frameworks and data (e.g., hotline reports, investigations, risk management, policy adherence); this would be considered an asset.



Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!

Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

Bombardier is an equal opportunity employer and encourages persons of any race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, immigration status, disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics to apply.

Back up for Process Assistant duties

2+ years of professional or military experience

1+ years of project management experience

Description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.***


At Roofr, building a powerful user experience starts with data. As a Senior Data Analyst at an early-stage, high-growth company, you’ll play a critical role in turning raw data into insights that shape product decisions, drive strategy, and improve the customer experience. You’ll have a direct impact on how we use data to grow, and help influence the roadmap for how analytics evolves at Roofr.

This role sits at the intersection of data analytics and business, ideal for someone comfortable moving between modeling data, building dashboards, and advising senior leadership on growth opportunities.

What You'll Get to Do:


Partner directly with business and product owners to shape roadmaps, prioritize features, and measure success
Build an AI-first business intelligence platform to supercharge self-serve analysis
Deliver actionable insights on user behavior, market trends, and business performance to marketing, revenue and product teams.
Lead sales and marketing analytics by defining KPIs and optimizing our acquisition funnels.
Tell compelling data stories to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences
Transform, clean, and model raw data using DBT to create reliable, analytics-ready datasets
Take ownership of our analytics foundation, inheriting existing models (DBT) and data warehouse structure (Snowflake) to clean, improve, and scale them alongside a Senior Analytics Engineer.


What You'll Bring to the Role:


7+ years of experience in data analysis and/or data science, ideally on sales, marketing, and growth analytics at a SaaS company
Expertise hacking AI/ML and automation tools for growth purposes, on top of using Claude, Cortex and other AI tools to streamline analytics workflow
Proficient in BI tools like Metabase, Sigma, Tableau, Omni, or Looker
Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, PostgreSQL)
Hands-on experience with DBT for managing the Transform layer of ELT pipelines
Ability to work cross-functionally to define metrics, create dashboards, and ensure data quality
A strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and accuracy


Who You Are:


Loves transforming messy data into clean models and insights
Thrives at bringing structure to chaos and able to find focus while juggling multiple projects
Lead with intent and proactively bring ideas to our partners and stakeholders
Eager to elevate your team and organization to new heights
A strong communicator with great presentation skills
Analytical with a demonstrated ability to utilize data to make informed decisions
A critical thinker who doesn’t settle for the status quo


Compensation Band: $130,000.00 - $140,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:


1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
Flexible time off
80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
RRSP/401k match
Generous Parental Leave policy


🤝 Perks:


We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
Home office setup stipend
Internet and phone allowance
Remote first culture
Weekly Friday paydays!

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!

Build the future with us

Are you passionate about data and creating value? Would you like to contribute to decisions that shape the future of individual insurance?

As a Data Analyst within the Strategy and Analytics team in the Pricing, New Business and Claims division, you will play a central role in advancing our business intelligence capabilities. You will collaborate with data analysts, managers, pricing and claims specialists, and other business partners to transform data into performance drivers.

This position is a great opportunity to showcase your skills and fully realize your potential within a caring and trustworthy company. Here, people and their development are at the heart of our priorities, fostering an environment that encourages collaboration and innovation.

What You’ll Accomplish With Us

As a Data Analyst, you’ll be at the core of our mission. Here are the main responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and optimize business intelligence tools to support business decisions;
  • Contribute to risk management controls and market analyses;
  • Translate business needs into practical, tailored and well-documented solutions;
  • Analyze data and recommend key performance indicators;
  • Actively participate in the governance of business intelligence assets;

  • Support business partners in identifying and defining their needs by highlighting available data and value-creation opportunities.

What Could Accelerate Your Success In This Role

Why you’ll love working with us

  • A work environment where learning and development merge with a collective pursuit of excellence;

Title: Decision Support Analyst Decision Support
Description:
The Decision Support team provides analytical support to programs/services across Unity Health, as well as to key strategic, quality, performance and financial initiatives. Decision Support is a team of highly trained, experienced and diverse professionals across the domains of analytics, data management and health information. The team employs various analytical methods to support our clients in achieving their strategic and operational goals.

Reporting to the Manager, Case Costing & Decision Support, the Decision Support Analyst will leverage their strong analytical skillset, and understanding of healthcare data sets to support clients in evidence informed decision making, performance monitoring and improvement. The Analyst will work in collaboration with the broader team to provide in depth analysis, insightful interpretation and presentation of data, while maintaining the appropriate technical specifications/documentation.

Duties & Responsibilities


Work closely with a team of Decision Support members to provide analysis, insights, and presentation of data; as well as maintain technical specifications. Conducts validity and data quality checks as needed on outputs.
Support clinical and non-clinical clients in a variety of analytical needs including: development of robust analytical plans, statistical analysis, key performance indicators, benchmarking, data visualizations, and routine and ad hoc reporting.
In partnership with clients, provides insightful interpretation to support strategic, operational, quality and improvement plans. The analyst will incorporate data and information from a variety of sources (quantitative and qualitative) to improve insight generation.
Extracts, transforms and analyzes complex information from a variety of database servers and clinical systems.
Supports reporting to and from external agencies and data portals (MOHLTC, funding agencies, CIHI and etc.).
Adherence to internal policies & procedures, including the protection patient/employee confidentiality.
Under the direction of the manager, and senior staff to consult with clients on analytical needs related to a variety of projects including: strategy, business cases, quality improvement, performance, funding, research, evaluation etc.
Liaises with individuals at all levels of the organization on projects, reports and other ad-hoc requests.
Provide expert advice and educates end users on data results and interpretation, with the goal of improving data literacy in the organization.
Makes connections between the data and core business and clinical concepts.
Engages in data quality and other internal process improvement initiatives to support continuous improvement.
Collaborates with key partners (IT, Coding, Clinical Informatics, Finance, HR, Research, etc.) and peers to identify new data sources to incorporate into various analysis, as well as innovative analytical/statistical techniques (predictive, simulation, optimization models) that will generate new insights.
Identifies areas of opportunity with respect to routine reporting to increase efficiency and reduce manual work.
Commitment to learning and growth and contribution to share team educational goals.
Contributes to process standardization and tool development to support improvement within the department.


Qualifications


Undergraduate Degree in an applicable field required (Health Informatics, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Public Health, Statistics, Math, Engineering, Computer Science, Science, etc.).
Master's Degree (completed or in progress) in a related discipline is an asset.
Three (3) or more years of experience in a decision support or analytical environment required; healthcare experience is preferred.
Experience with hospital data (e.g. DAD, NACRS, OMHRS, NRS, CCRS) preferred.
Knowledgeable within the health care environment and of industry.
Experience working in a complex data environment, including with enterprise data warehouses and other relational databases required.
Demonstrated competency within qualitative and quantitative data analytics, visualization, and reporting.
Demonstrated proficiency in utilizing statistical and business intelligence tools such as SAS, SQL, Python, and Tableau.
Ability to analyze data and present complex information and recommendations in an easy to understand manner; excellent interpersonal, verbal and presentation skills.
Strong problem solving, analytical and critical thinking skill.
Demonstrated organizational and time management skills and ability to prioritize tasks in a complex, fast paced environment.
Self-starter with strong willingness to learn, teach and positively contribute in a team environment.
Demonstrated attention to detail in day-to-day work with a focus on quality of work, accuracy and customer service.
Strong computer skills including MS Office Suite (Excel, Access, Word, and PowerPoint)
Experience with the Epic Electronic Patient Record an asset


Unity Health Toronto is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive organization. We strive to provide a recruitment process that is barrier-free and in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and the Ontario Human Rights Code. We understand that you may require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process. When you are contacted, please inform the Talent Acquisition Specialist and we will work with you to meet your accommodation needs. We want to emphasize that all accommodation requests are handled with the utmost confidentiality, respecting your privacy and dignity.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Department: Technology

Employment Type: Permanent

Location: Greater Montreal Metropolitan Area, Canada

Reporting To: Software Engineering Manager

Description

Le Data Analyst sera responsable de la conception, de la création et de la maintenance de la couche analytique ainsi que des rapports destinés aux clients, reposant sur la plateforme Compliance Pro.

Au sein de l’équipe Reporting, ce rôle consiste à traduire des exigences complexes en matière de conformité et de sécurité en tableaux de bord robustes et en rapports tabulaires qui répondent aux besoins des utilisateurs finaux. Le Data Analyst sera responsable de la livraison de bout en bout : modélisation des données, création et mise à jour des tableaux de bord et des widgets, définition des meilleures représentations des données, ainsi que garantie de l’exactitude, de la performance et de la cohérence des rapports avec les données affichées dans CPro.

Ce rôle est fortement orienté client : une grande partie du travail consiste à créer et mettre à jour des rapports personnalisés pour des opérateurs spécifiques, à résoudre des problèmes en production et à s’assurer que les rapports critiques pour l’entreprise sont fiables et à jour.

Construire des solutions innovantes ; permettre des lieux de travail plus sûrs pour tous.

Nous allons créer un monde du travail plus sûr, en développant des logiciels pour soutenir un réseau mondial d'acheteurs, de fournisseurs et de partenaires responsables.

Aujourd'hui, chez Veriforce, nous soulageons plus de 50 000 organisations à travers le monde des contraintes de conformité, en les aidant à protéger leurs employés, leurs activités et la planète.

Nous veillons à ce que notre réseau de clients, de fournisseurs et de sous-traitants respecte les normes les plus importantes, qu'il s'agisse de santé, de sécurité, de développement durable ou de comportement éthique, en élaborant les meilleures solutions du marché.

La technologie que nous construisons aujourd'hui créera un avenir meilleur.

{Insérer une déclaration d'impact tirée du dossier d'appel d'offres.}

Anglais De Niveau Avancé

Cette exigence est requise puisque dans le cadre de cette fonction, vous aurez à intervenir auprès des clients, partenaires et/ou nos filiales internationaux sur une base récurrente tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.

Dans le présent document, le genre masculin est utilisé dans le seul but d'alléger le texte

Qu'est-ce Que Cela Signifie Au Jour Le Jour


Créer et améliorer des tableaux de bord et des rapports spécifiques aux clients
Assurer la mise en valeur des données (« data storytelling ») afin que celles-ci soient pertinentes et exploitables pour la prise de décision
Veiller à ce que les rapports Sisense reflètent fidèlement les données de l’application en production, tant en termes de valeurs que de mise en forme
Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents en production
Collaborer étroitement avec les Product Owners, les équipes QA, les parties prenantes internes et les équipes en contact avec les clients afin d’affiner les critères d’acceptation, clarifier la logique des données et valider les rapports nouveaux ou mis à jour
Mettre en place et maintenir des standards de reporting cohérents à travers l’environnement Sisense et les produits de reporting
Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie et de données pour identifier et modéliser de nouvelles sources de données lorsque nécessaire
Maintenir une documentation technique claire afin de faciliter la maintenance et l’intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs
Participer aux rituels agiles, utiliser Jira pour gérer les tâches et fournir des estimations, des mises à jour d’avancement et des livrables clairs pour le QAT


Ce Dont Vous Aurez Besoin Pour Réussir


Expérience pratique dans le développement de solutions analytiques avec Sisense (ou une plateforme BI similaire), incluant la création de tableaux de bord complexes et de rapports tabulaires avec filtres, widgets et champs personnalisés
Solides compétences en SQL et expérience en modélisation de données pour le reporting (jointures, agrégations, champs calculés, conversions de types de données, optimisation des performances)
Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de rapports critiques en environnement de production, incluant :
L’analyse des écarts entre les systèmes sources et les données produites
La correction des problèmes de données et de mise en forme
La maintenance de rapports opérationnels à fort enjeu
Capacité à interpréter des spécifications métiers détaillées et à les traduire en solutions de reporting précises
Excellentes compétences en « data storytelling » et solide compréhension des bonnes pratiques en reporting
Expérience dans l’analyse et l’amélioration de rapports Sisense existants
À l’aise pour collaborer étroitement avec les Product Owners, le QAT et les équipes en contact avec les clients, notamment pour valider le comportement des tableaux de bord, des filtres et des résultats
Grande attention aux détails et souci de la qualité
Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec aptitude à identifier des enjeux à travers plusieurs couches de données


Ce Que Vous Obtiendrez En Retour

Nous voulons que vous puissiez donner le meilleur de vous-même. Nous mettons l'accent sur les moyens de soutenir notre équipe pour qu'elle donne le meilleur d'elle-même. Voici quelques-uns des avantages que nous offrons :

Santé et bien-être personnel / Avantages

>🧠 Soutien intégré à la santé mentale et au bien-être

>🌴 Vacances - à partir de 3 semaines

>💟 Journées du bien-être et journée annuelle de dons - une occasion supplémentaire de se rendre service ou de rendre service à la communauté

>🩺 Couverture médicale et dentaire complète

>😴 Fin de l'année, fermeture de l'entreprise pour vous permettre de vous détendre et de vous ressourcer

Planification future

>🏫 Licence d'apprentissage LinkedIn pour la mise à niveau et le développement

Vous êtes intéressé(e) mais ne pensez pas répondre à toutes les exigences ?

Notre équipe de recrutement évalue et examine toutes les candidatures en fonction du poste et des besoins de l'entreprise. Nous croyons que les gens ont des compétences transférables et non techniques et nous voulons que vous sachiez que nous prenons en considération les cas où une personne ne répond pas à tous les critères, mais possède néanmoins les aptitudes et les capacités nécessaires. Notre priorité est de veiller à ce que les candidats soient en mesure de réussir. Nous prendrons une décision finale en déterminant si nous pouvons offrir le soutien nécessaire pour améliorer les compétences ou fournir le soutien au développement dont vous avez besoin pour tirer le meilleur parti de cette opportunité avec nous !

Apportez votre entièreté au travail.

Veriforce est fière d'être un employeur qui respecte l'égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à ce qu'aucun candidat ne soit discriminé en raison de son identité et de son expression sexuelles, de sa race, de son handicap, de son ethnicité, de son orientation sexuelle, de son âge, de sa couleur, de sa région, de sa croyance, de son origine nationale ou de son sexe. Nous sommes déterminés à développer une équipe diversifiée tout en continuant à créer un environnement inclusif où chacun se sent en sécurité et a la possibilité d'être lui-même.

Ce à quoi vous pouvez vous attendre si vous postulez :


Une réponse à votre candidature dans les 15 jours ouvrables
Un processus d'entretien comprenant
Un appel initial de découverte avec le recruteur
Un premier entretien via Microsoft Teams
Un entretien supplémentaire (probablement en face à face) avec les parties prenantes avec lesquelles vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration dans le cadre de votre fonction.

Nous tenons à ce que notre processus de recrutement vous permette de donner le meilleur de vous-même. Si vous souhaitez que nous procédions à des ajustements, n'hésitez pas à nous en faire part.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Role Overview




We are seeking a hands-on and business-focused Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Life Insurance operations.

The role will support Sales, Care & Support, and Lead Management through performance reporting, data analysis, process automation, and actionable insights. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to monitor performance, investigate trends, and identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness, customer retention, and operational efficiency.

This role is suited to an analyst who is comfortable working independently with data while continuing to develop their strategic and commercial analytics capability.




Key Responsibilities




1. Sales & Lead Analytics – 20%

Monitor lead performance, contact rates, conversion, sales performance, and advisor productivity.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring performance reporting.
Analyze lead sources, customer segments, and sales funnel performance to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
Support sales optimization, lead allocation, capacity planning, and performance analysis.
Conduct ad-hoc analysis to support Sales and Lead Management initiatives.




2. Care & Retention Analytics – 50%

Analyze post-sales customer and policyholder performance to identify drivers of retention, persistency, and customer experience.
Monitor and report on key Care & Support metrics, including retention, lapse, service levels, and customer engagement.
Conduct customer, cohort, and root-cause analysis to identify performance drivers.
Support the development and measurement of customer retention initiatives.
Partner with Care & Support teams to identify operational improvement opportunities and measure outcomes.




3. Reporting, Automation & Data Quality – 20%

Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and automated reporting solutions.
Use SQL and Python to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual reporting and improve reporting efficiency through automation.
Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure reporting accuracy.
Maintain clear KPI definitions, reporting documentation, and analytical methodologies.




4. Business & Knowledge Support – 10%

Support ad-hoc analytical requests across Sales, Care & Support, and Lead Management.
Document key business processes, analytical methodologies, and reporting frameworks.
Support knowledge-sharing and knowledge-transfer activities across teams.
Provide analytical support for new market initiatives as required.




Qualifications




Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field.
1–3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Experience in Life Insurance, Financial Services, Sales Analytics, Customer Analytics, or another regulated industry is preferred.




Technical Skills




Strong SQL skills, including Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL.
Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
Proficiency with Power BI and/or Tableau.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience with automated reporting, data validation, and ETL processes.
Working knowledge of statistical analysis and A/B testing is desirable.
Familiarity with AI/ML tools and concepts is considered a nice-to-have.




Core Competencies




Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate data into clear and actionable business insights.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
Curious, commercially aware, and comfortable investigating business performance.
Customer-focused mindset with an interest in developing deeper business and strategic analytics capability.




Why Join Us




Work directly on analytics supporting sales growth and customer retention.
Gain exposure to multiple areas of the Life Insurance customer lifecycle.
Develop technical, commercial, and strategic analytics capability.
Work closely with business leaders and cross-functional teams.
Opportunity to contribute to automation, process improvement, and future market initiatives.




Benefits




That's why you can expect to be rewarded for the hard work you put in through job satisfaction, career development and the fantastic range of benefits we offer:




What's in it for you?




4 weeks vacation per year
10 paid sick days per year
Hybrid role – 3 days in office and 2 days work-from-home
100% employer paid health benefits from day 1 including $500 Healthcare Spending Account
Parental leave top-up
5% RRSP matching after 3 months of service
Learning and growth opportunities
Free weekly lunches, epic social events, and more!




If this role interests you, we would love to hear from you!




Apply now!

Title: Analyste des données commerciales et digitales / Business and Online Data Analyst
Description:
Votre mission

Au sein de l'équipe Business Intelligence et Performance, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'analyse de la performance commerciale et digitale de l'entreprise. Grâce à votre expertise analytique et votre maîtrise des outils de reporting, vous transformez les données en informations stratégiques permettant d'orienter les décisions et d'optimiser les performances.

Vous contribuez également à l'amélioration continue des outils, des processus et de la qualité des données, dans un environnement collaboratif et omnicanal.

Principales responsabilités

Analyse et suivi de la performance commerciale


Assurer une compréhension approfondie de la performance globale de l'activité et des principaux leviers opérationnels.
Produire, analyser et présenter les reportings bimensuels et mensuels destinés aux équipes et à la direction.
Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles afin de soutenir les priorités opérationnelles et les décisions stratégiques.
Accompagner les exercices de prévision, les revues d'activité et le suivi de la performance grâce à l'analyse des données.
Garantir la fiabilité, la cohérence et la qualité des indicateurs, rapports et tableaux de bord.


Analyse de la performance digitale


Suivre et analyser les performances des différents canaux digitaux (site web, campagnes médias, SEO, CRM, etc.).
Concevoir, développer et optimiser les tableaux de bord de suivi de la performance digitale.
Veiller à la qualité du suivi et de la collecte des données en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et les parties prenantes concernées.
Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur les performances des campagnes, des promotions et des tendances de marché.
Présenter régulièrement les résultats et recommandations aux équipes métiers et aux partenaires internes.
Participer à des projets digitaux internationaux et transverses.


Gestion des données et amélioration continue


Extraire, analyser, valider et interpréter les données à l'aide d'outils tels que BigQuery et SQL.
Maintenir et faire évoluer les outils de reporting et les processus d'analyse existants.
Répondre aux besoins quotidiens en matière d'analyses et de reporting des différentes équipes.
Contribuer aux projets liés à l'omnicanalité, à la business intelligence et à la transformation de la donnée.
Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités d'amélioration visant à optimiser les processus de reporting et la qualité des données.


Profil recherché

Formation et expérience


Formation universitaire en analyse de données, statistiques, informatique, finance, marketing analytique ou domaine connexe.
Expérience significative dans un rôle d'analyse de données, de business intelligence ou de performance digitale.


Compétences techniques


Excellente maîtrise de SQL et de BigQuery.
Solide expérience dans la création et l'optimisation de tableaux de bord via Power BI, Looker ou des outils similaires.
Maîtrise avancée d'Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, formules complexes, automatisations et macros).
Bonne connaissance des outils d'analyse digitale tels que Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager ou équivalents.


Compétences personnelles


Forte capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes.
Rigueur, souci du détail et sens de l'organisation.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en présentation de données.
Capacité à vulgariser des analyses complexes et à influencer la prise de décision.
Aisance à travailler en mode transversal dans un environnement dynamique et omnicanal.
Esprit collaboratif, curiosité et orientation résultats.


Atouts


Expérience dans les environnements e-commerce, marketing digital ou omnicanaux.
Connaissance des outils de visualisation et d'analyse avancée de données.
Expérience dans un contexte international ou multi-marchés.


_________________________________

Your Mission

As part of the Business Intelligence & Performance team, you will play a key role in analyzing and monitoring the company’s business and digital performance. Leveraging your analytical expertise and reporting capabilities, you will transform data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and drive business results.

You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting tools, data quality, and business intelligence processes in a collaborative and omnichannel environment.

Key Responsibilities

Business Performance Analysis & Reporting


Develop a strong understanding of overall business performance and the key operational drivers impacting results.
Produce, analyze, and present bi-weekly and monthly business reports and dashboards for stakeholders and leadership teams.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to support operational priorities and strategic business decisions.
Provide analytical support for business reviews, forecasting activities, and performance tracking.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reports, KPIs, and dashboards.
Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to support business growth and operational efficiency.


Digital Performance Analysis


Monitor and analyze digital performance across key channels, including website, media, SEO, CRM, and other digital touchpoints.
Design, develop, and optimize digital performance dashboards and reporting solutions.
Ensure the quality and accuracy of tracking and measurement processes in collaboration with technical teams and relevant stakeholders.
Conduct in-depth analyses of campaign performance, promotional activities, customer trends, and digital initiatives.
Present performance results, insights, and recommendations to business and cross-functional teams.
Participate in global and cross-functional digital projects as required.


Data Management & Continuous Improvement


Extract, validate, analyze, and interpret data using tools such as BigQuery and SQL.
Maintain and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and recurring reporting processes.
Support day-to-day reporting and analytical needs across multiple business functions.
Contribute to omnichannel, business intelligence, and data transformation initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, data quality, automation, and overall analytical capabilities.


Profile

Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Marketing Analytics, Finance, or a related field.
Significant experience in a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, Digital Performance, or related analytical role.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.
Proven experience building and maintaining dashboards using visualization tools such as Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, data modeling, and automation.
Good knowledge of digital analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or similar platforms.


Personal Competencies


Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.
Ability to influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations.
Comfortable working cross-functionally within a dynamic and collaborative omnichannel environment.
Curious, proactive, and results-oriented mindset.


Assets


Experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, travel, hospitality, retail, or omnichannel business environments.
Knowledge of advanced analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence methodologies.
Experience working in an international or multi-market environment.

Title: ICQA Data Analyst
Description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Title: Analyste BI senior(e)
Description:
Aperçu

Joignez-vous à l'équipe des systèmes d'affaires et contribuez à transformer des données de projet complexes en informations claires et utiles. À titre d'analyste BI principal, vous collaborerez avec les équipes de projet, les parties prenantes d'affaires et les spécialistes technologiques afin de développer et d'améliorer des solutions d'intelligence d'affaires pour le secteur Grands projets.

Il n'est pas nécessaire de maîtriser toutes les technologies mentionnées ci-dessous. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne possédant de bonnes bases en BI, de solides capacités d'analyse et le désir d'apprendre et d'évoluer avec l'équipe.

Votre rôle


Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de les traduire en solutions BI concrètes.
Concevoir des modèles de données, des rapports et des tableaux de bord qui transforment les données brutes en informations pertinentes.
Développer et optimiser des requêtes SQL, des processus de transformation de données et des solutions de production de rapports.
Contribuer au développement, à l'amélioration et à la maintenance des solutions Power BI.
Soutenir la qualité, l'intégrité et la fiabilité des données utilisées pour les rapports et les analyses.
Participer aux essais et au déploiement des solutions, du développement jusqu'à la production.
Collaborer avec les développeurs, les analystes d'affaires, les chargés de projet et les responsables d'affaires.
Recommander des améliorations concrètes aux tableaux de bord, aux méthodes de production de rapports et aux pratiques de BI existantes.
Contribuer, lorsque pertinent, à l'automatisation des processus d'affaires et de production de rapports récurrents.


À propos de vous


Baccalauréat en informatique, en ingénierie, en technologies de l'information ou dans une discipline connexe, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pertinente.
Expérience pratique en développement de solutions d'intelligence d'affaires, de production de rapports ou d'analyse de données.
Expérience avec Power BI, notamment la modélisation de données, Power Query et DAX.

Expérience en conception, en développement ou en maintenance de rapports BI, de modèles de données ou de solutions d'entreposage de données.
Familiarité avec les processus ETL ou d'intégration de données.
Expérience avec des données provenant de plusieurs sources, par exemple des bases de données, des fichiers, des feuilles de calcul, SharePoint, des applications d'entreprise ou des plateformes infonuagiques.
Expérience en soutien de solutions, du développement jusqu'à la production.
Compréhension des pratiques de qualité, de gouvernance, de sécurité et de gestion des accès'aux données.

Une expérience avec un ou plusieurs des éléments suivants constitue un atout; la maîtrise de l'ensemble de cette liste n'est pas attendue:


Microsoft Power Automate pour l'automatisation de flux de travail ou de processus d'affaires.
API REST et services Web, notamment l'authentification, JSON, les points de terminaison, la pagination et la gestion des erreurs.
Python pour la préparation des données, l'automatisation ou l'analytique.
Flux de données Power BI.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Services Microsoft Azure tels qu'Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage ou Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric ou Databricks.
SharePoint et intégration d'applications d'entreprise.
Autres plateformes infonuagiques de données et d'analytique.
Conception d'entrepôts de données ou méthodes avancées d'intégration de données.
Connaissance pratique de SQL et des bases de données relationnelles.
Capacité à comprendre les besoins d'affaires et à les traduire en solutions techniques ou analytiques claires.
Solides capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et d'organisation.
Capacité à communiquer efficacement et à collaborer avec des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
Capacité à travailler de façon autonome tout en contribuant au travail d'équipe.
Curiosité et volonté d'apprendre de nouveaux outils et domaines d'affaires.
Approche collaborative et souci du service à la clientèle.
Capacité à expliquer clairement des sujets techniques.
Bon jugement et souci du détail.
Approche pragmatique et orientée vers les solutions.
Intérêt pour l'amélioration continue et le partage des connaissances.
Ce poste requiert la connaissance d'une autre langue que le français, soit l'anglais, puisque vous serez membre d'une équipe de direction canadienne, mondiale ou régional

Découvrez la rémunération et les avantages sociaux qui vous accompagnent à chaque étape de votre vie et de votre carrière chez AtkinsRéalis au Canada.

Bénéficiez d'une rémunération concurrentielle, d'une reconnaissance valorisante, et d'une gamme complète d'avantages flexibles, conçus pour s'adapter à vos besoins en matière de santé, de bien-être, de finances et de style de vie.

Profitez également de notre culture de travail hybride, de politiques de congés généreuses, et d'un environnement qui favorise l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle.

Obtenez votre reconnaissance. En savoir plus.

Nous sommes AtkinsRéalis, une organisation de calibre mondial de services d'ingénierie et d'énergie nucléaire. Nous lions individus, données et technologie pour transformer les infrastructures et les systèmes énergétiques du monde.

Title: Analyste BI senior
Description:
Overview

Join the Business Systems Team and help turn complex project data into clear, useful insights. As a Senior BI Analyst, you will work with project teams, business stakeholders and technology specialists to develop and improve business intelligence solutions for the Major Projects Sector.

You do not need to have experience with every technology listed below. We are looking for someone with a solid BI foundation, strong analytical skills and an interest in learning and growing with the team.

Your role


Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical BI solutions.
Design data models, reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful information.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, data transformation processes and reporting solutions.
Contribute to the development, enhancement and maintenance of Power BI solutions.
Support the quality, integrity and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Participate in solution testing and deployment, from development through production.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers and business owners.
Recommend practical improvements to existing dashboards, reporting methods and BI practices.
Help automate recurring business and reporting processes where appropriate.


About You


A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Practical experience developing business intelligence, reporting or data analytics solutions.
Experience using Power BI, including data modelling, Power Query and DAX.
The following experience would help you succeed in the role, but candidates with comparable or transferable experience are encouraged to apply:
Experience designing, developing or maintaining BI reports, data models or data warehouse solutions.
Experience working with data from multiple sources, such as databases, files, spreadsheets, SharePoint, enterprise applications or cloud platforms.
Experience supporting solutions from development through production.
Experience with one or more of the following would be an asset; expertise across the full list is not expected:
Microsoft Power Automate for workflow or business-process automation.
REST APIs and Web services, including authentication, JSON, endpoints, pagination and error handling.
Python for data preparation, automation or analytics.
Power BI Dataflows.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage or Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.
SharePoint and enterprise application integration.
Other cloud data and analytics platforms.
Data warehouse design or advanced data integration patterns.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of data quality, governance, security and access-management practices.
Familiarity with ETL or data integration processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.
Ability to communicate in both French and English when supporting stakeholders in both languages. The specific business need for English should be validated and stated in the posting where applicable.*
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical or analytical solutions.
Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment.
The ability to explain technical topics clearly.
An interest in continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools and business domains.
A collaborative and client-focused approach.
Sound judgement and attention to detail.
A practical, solution-oriented mindset.
This position requires knowledge of a language other than French, namely English, as it involves collaboration with members of the Canadian or global leadership team located outside Québec.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.

Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.

Make the most of diverse opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise.

And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Title: Senior Product Analyst - EA Sports FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this is a regular full-time (hybrid) role. Qualified applicants must be available to work in the Vancouver studio 3x per week. Canadian work authorization is required.

Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.
Explore user behavioral patterns to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies.
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Job Description:

Role Summary

The RA&S Analytics team partners with business, marketing, distribution, product, and technology teams to turn complex data into actionable insights that improve marketing performance, advisor engagement, sales outcomes, and the client experience. The team is evolving from primarily delivering reporting and analytical support to building scalable data products, automated measurement solutions, and decision-ready insights that enable faster and more informed business decisions.

Reporting to the Manager of RA&S Marketing Analytics, the Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will lead analytics from business-question definition through data integration, analysis, visualization, and recommendation. By connecting marketing, digital, prospect, client, advisor, and sales data, you will help stakeholders understand end-to-end journeys, identify performance opportunities, and translate analytical findings into measurable business actions.

Working collaboratively across RA&S and the broader Data and Analytics community, you will develop trusted reporting and analytical solutions, automate recurring processes, and communicate clear insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role is well suited to someone who combines strong technical capability with curiosity, business acumen, stakeholder partnership, and a passion for solving complex problems.

Sun Life views success in this role related to 4 key characteristics:

Fierce curiosity. You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles.

Understanding business. We’ve got a lot of data, but it’s not going to turn itself into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.

A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.

Technical skills. How to wrangle structured data is a must (i.e., SQL) with strong Python/PySpark skills needed as we migrate from on-prem computing using SAS to cloud based computing using Python. This role will also have a digital analysis component (Adobe Analytics).

What will you do?


Support analytical work from requirements specification, data gathering, analysis to presentations to solve business problems. Be the analytical resource for the RA&S marketing teams
Develop decision-ready reporting and dashboards that highlight performance drivers, emerging trends, and recommended actions.
Merge campaign and digital analytics data with back-end source data to highlight our client journeys from beginning to end
Draw out business insights from analytical output and work with team leads to put together business recommendations
Put together effective presentations of findings and desire to present to multiple levels of stakeholders
scalability, and team capacity.
Leverage internal training, peers and other sources to continue to grow capabilities


What will you need to succeed?


5+ years working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating and analyzing data and creating analytical reports)
Comfortable writing complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources
Expert using Python/PySpark to work with data, with the flexibility to use both languages as we transition from one to the other
Experience working with AWS stack – SageMaker, Glue, Lambda
Experience with Adobe analytics, data visualization tools like Tableau, Quick Sight or the ability to self-learn these tools in role
An effective and concise oral and written storytelling and communication skills
Ability to work as a team to help deliver multiple projects with courage in managing expectations of team leaders
Ability to document work
BSc in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)


What will be nice to have?


Experience in life insurance/wealth management, or other financial services industry (e.g., retail banking, credit card, re-insurance and casualty insurance)
Understanding of predictive and prescriptive techniques (i.e., regression, decision trees, deep learning etc.)
MSc preferably in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)
Experience working with unstructured data


Unique Requirements:


This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time. Important: Obtaining Reliability Status Clearance within a reasonable amount of time is a condition required to start employment for this role at Sun Life.
Must be able to satisfactorily complete applicable background checks prior to the start date and during employment, in accordance with Sun Life’s policies and practices.


The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
