Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

Your Moneris Career - The Opportunity

We are looking for a Business Data Analyst to join our analytics team and help deliver data-driven insights across product performance, customer onboarding, operational efficiency, and business reporting.

In this role, you will work with large datasets, build and maintain reports and dashboards, analyze business trends, and provide leadership teams with accurate, actionable insights. You will partner with stakeholders across Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to measure performance, identify opportunities, and support informed decision-making.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems through data, improving reporting processes, and translating complex information into clear recommendations. The successful candidate will contribute to reliable reporting, stronger business insights, and increased visibility into product and operational performance.

Location: You will be based in our Etobicoke office, balancing in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.

Reporting Relationship: You will report to the Manager, Analytics – Product & Operations.

Posting Type: Replacement.

Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is $71,000 - $100,000.

Total compensation may also include variable or discretionary incentive components, including but not limited to bonuses and commissions. Individual job offers are determined by various factors, including experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Build, maintain, and enhance recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical outputs used by business and leadership teams.
Analyze trends across product performance, customer onboarding, operational service levels, revenue, customer experience, sales channels, and business process efficiency.
Extract, validate, and analyze data from multiple systems using SQL, Excel, BI tools, and other analytics platforms.
Translate business questions into clear analysis, insights, and recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support recurring reporting cycles, leadership updates, performance reviews, and ad hoc analytical requests.
Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, establish metric definitions, validate assumptions, and ensure reporting accuracy.
Identify data quality issues, reporting gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to automate and improve reporting processes.
Maintain documentation for key reports, dashboards, data sources, metrics, assumptions, and business rules.
Contribute to analytics modernization initiatives, including dashboard enhancements, reporting automation, data model improvements, and migration to modern data platforms.


Your Moneris Career - What You Bring

Required skills and experience


Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered.
3–5 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Operations Analyst, or similar role.
Experience building and maintaining reports, dashboards, or recurring business performance reporting.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, data validation, and analysis of large datasets.
Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data preparation, and structured analysis.
Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Experience analyzing data from multiple sources to identify trends, issues, and business implications.


Experience That Would Set You Apart


Experience in payments, financial services, technology, product analytics, operations analytics, or customer experience analytics.
Experience with Python, Jupyter Notebook, Snowflake, dbt, reporting automation tools, or statistical analysis.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The RA&S Analytics team partners with business, marketing, distribution, product, and technology teams to turn complex data into actionable insights that improve marketing performance, advisor engagement, sales outcomes, and the client experience. The team is evolving from primarily delivering reporting and analytical support to building scalable data products, automated measurement solutions, and decision-ready insights that enable faster and more informed business decisions.

Reporting to the Manager of RA&S Marketing Analytics, the Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will lead analytics from business-question definition through data integration, analysis, visualization, and recommendation. By connecting marketing, digital, prospect, client, advisor, and sales data, you will help stakeholders understand end-to-end journeys, identify performance opportunities, and translate analytical findings into measurable business actions.

Working collaboratively across RA&S and the broader Data and Analytics community, you will develop trusted reporting and analytical solutions, automate recurring processes, and communicate clear insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role is well suited to someone who combines strong technical capability with curiosity, business acumen, stakeholder partnership, and a passion for solving complex problems.

Sun Life views success in this role related to 4 key characteristics:

Fierce curiosity. You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles.

Understanding business. We’ve got a lot of data, but it’s not going to turn itself into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.

A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.

Technical skills. How to wrangle structured data is a must (i.e., SQL) with strong Python/PySpark skills needed as we migrate from on-prem computing using SAS to cloud based computing using Python. This role will also have a digital analysis component (Adobe Analytics).

What will you do?


Support analytical work from requirements specification, data gathering, analysis to presentations to solve business problems. Be the analytical resource for the RA&S marketing teams
Develop decision-ready reporting and dashboards that highlight performance drivers, emerging trends, and recommended actions.
Merge campaign and digital analytics data with back-end source data to highlight our client journeys from beginning to end
Draw out business insights from analytical output and work with team leads to put together business recommendations
Put together effective presentations of findings and desire to present to multiple levels of stakeholders
scalability, and team capacity.
Leverage internal training, peers and other sources to continue to grow capabilities


What will you need to succeed?


5+ years working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating and analyzing data and creating analytical reports)
Comfortable writing complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources
Expert using Python/PySpark to work with data, with the flexibility to use both languages as we transition from one to the other
Experience working with AWS stack – SageMaker, Glue, Lambda
Experience with Adobe analytics, data visualization tools like Tableau, Quick Sight or the ability to self-learn these tools in role
An effective and concise oral and written storytelling and communication skills
Ability to work as a team to help deliver multiple projects with courage in managing expectations of team leaders
Ability to document work
BSc in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)


What will be nice to have?


Experience in life insurance/wealth management, or other financial services industry (e.g., retail banking, credit card, re-insurance and casualty insurance)
Understanding of predictive and prescriptive techniques (i.e., regression, decision trees, deep learning etc.)
MSc preferably in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)
Experience working with unstructured data


Unique Requirements:


This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time. Important: Obtaining Reliability Status Clearance within a reasonable amount of time is a condition required to start employment for this role at Sun Life.
Must be able to satisfactorily complete applicable background checks prior to the start date and during employment, in accordance with Sun Life’s policies and practices.


The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Legend

At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.

The Role

Legend is hiring a Senior Data Analyst, reporting directly into our Head of Data and Insights.

This is a high-impact opportunity for a Senior Data Analyst who wants to do more than answer questions with data. You’ll sit at the heart of our Sports business, partnering with teams across Product, Commercial, Marketing and SEO to uncover opportunities, challenge thinking and influence the decisions that drive performance.

You’ll be joining at an exciting point of transformation. With new products, evolving business models and a growing ambition for how we use data across Sports, you’ll play a key role in shaping the next phase of our analytics capability and how data is used to drive decision-making across the business.

From building smarter forecasting models and transforming how we measure performance, to exploring customer behaviour and laying the foundations for future personalisation, you’ll own complex analytical challenges from problem through to recommendation. This is a hands-on senior role with real visibility, autonomy and the opportunity to make data a genuine driver of commercial and product strategy.

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact


Deliver end-to-end analytical projects that help shape commercial, product and marketing decisions across our Sports portfolio.
Build advanced forecasting models that combine financial planning, historical performance, seasonality and sporting events to improve business forecasting.
Redesign and enhance our Tableau dashboard suite, providing stakeholders with faster, more actionable performance insights.
Improve the quality and accessibility of data by identifying gaps, optimising reporting and partnering with Data Engineering to strengthen data pipelines.
Apply statistical analysis, behavioural analytics and experimentation to uncover opportunities that drive revenue, conversion and long-term business growth.
Mentor team members while proactively identifying future analytical opportunities that help mature our Performance & Insights function.


What You'll Bring


Expert-level SQL alongside strong Python (preferred) or R, Tableau and statistical analysis skills.
Proven experience independently delivering end-to-end analytical projects from scoping through to implementation.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Commercial mindset with experience using data to influence business strategy and decision-making.
Experience mentoring or supporting team members while driving high standards across analytical delivery.
Experience within sports betting, iGaming or another digital business with strong web analytics exposure is highly desirable.


The Interview Process

1st: Initial Chat with Talent Partner (30 mins via Zoom)

2nd: Interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Senior People Partner (1 hour video via Zoom)

3rd: Take home task - you will be given a task to complete and return to us for assessment

4th: Final interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Sports Stakeholder (1 hour video via Zoom)

Why Legend?


Super smart colleagues to work alongside and learn from.
Engaging development opportunities at all levels.
Tailored flexibility for your work-life balance.
Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts.
Paid annual leave PLUS a well-deserved break to recharge your batteries during the festive season! Our offices are closed between Christmas and New Year's, allowing you to enjoy downtime without dipping into your annual allowance.
Exciting global Legend events, where we unite in person to ignite our shared passion and unveil the exciting strategies for the year ahead!


Unlock your full potential by joining the Legend team. To support you on this journey, we provide an extensive array of benefits and perks, as outlined in our global offerings above. For country specific benefits please reach out to your talent partner.

Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on  [email protected] , and we'll do all we can to support you.

Generate data exports and reports by developing queries to retrieve data from the databases and ensuring data quality and assurance
Perform data analysis to present meaningful representation of data for the management and executive team
Ad-hoc data integrity cleanup projects as required

Title: Data Analyst, Go-To-Market Sales Insights
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data is at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to build the tools and analytics that drive revenue for the sales organization behind Lyft's B2B portfolio — a multi-billion-dollar book of business spanning healthcare, business travel, corporate commute, automotive, and transit. This team has real say in what gets built.

You will be the analytical partner to our Sales and account teams — someone who can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Build the tools and analytics sales leaders use to grow their accounts — pacing views, account-health signals, territory and segment views that change what a rep or manager does next
Field requests from Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, leadership, and external stakeholders, and decide what's worth building, what's worth a sharp piece of analysis, and what's out of scope
Build and maintain production data pipelines, and automate recurring workflows, with documentation and validation clear enough that a teammate — or an AI agent — can use them without asking you first
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Contribute to the internal tools and semantic layer — prompts, context, and guardrails — that let stakeholders query B2B data in natural language and trust what comes back
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally supporting a sales, go-to-market, or B2B organization
Proficiency in SQL — able to read, write, and review structured, efficient queries on large data sets, whether you wrote them yourself or an AI coding assistant did; you own the correctness of every query and result before it reaches stakeholders
Experience building production data assets — pipelines, data models, or orchestrated tables (Airflow, dbt, or similar) — not only ad-hoc analysis
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Hex, Mode, or similar
Experience with sales or account analytics — pipeline, bookings, pacing to target, account segmentation — is a strong plus
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Commercial instinct paired with a builder's instinct — a track record of turning a recurring request into a durable tool or dataset instead of answering it one more time
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Description:
Mistplay est l'application de fidélité n°1 pour les joueurs mobiles. Notre communauté de millions de joueurs mobiles engagés utilise Mistplay pour découvrir de nouveaux jeux et gagner des récompenses. Les joueurs sont récompensés pour le temps et l'argent qu'ils consacrent aux jeux et peuvent échanger ces récompenses contre des cartes cadeaux. Mistplay a pour mission d'être le meilleur moyen de jouer à des jeux mobiles pour tous, partout dans le monde ! Téléchargez Mistplay sur le Google Play Store ici et suivez-nous sur Instagram, Twitter et Facebook.




📍 Veuillez noter : Au Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay suit un modèle hybride de 2 jours/semaine en bureau à Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montréal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)




Mistplay is the #1 loyalty app for mobile gamers. Our community of millions of engaged mobile gamers come to Mistplay to discover new games to play and earn rewards. Gamers are rewarded for their time and money spent within the games and can redeem those rewards for gift cards. Mistplay is on a mission to be the best way to play mobile games for everyone everywhere! Download Mistplay on the Google Play Store here and follow us on Instagram, Twitter and Facebook.




📍 Please Note: In Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay follows a 2 days/week in-office hybrid model in Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montreal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)







Au sein du service des données de Mistplay, l'analyste de données sénior I, Produit jouera un rôle crucial dans l'amélioration de la performance commerciale de Mistplay grâce à une analyse perspicace et à une stratégie d'analyse dynamique. Rattaché au Responsable de l'analyse des données et de l'expérimentation, tu collaboreras avec les responsables des produits et du cycle de vie pour planifier et analyser les résultats des tests A/B, et tu conduiras des rapports d'analyse afin d'informer le lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités du produit et de stratégies d'engagement.


Tes missions chez Mistplay : 






Mener des analyses proactives pour identifier des informations exploitables, notamment en se plongeant dans l'entonnoir du produit de base, les cohortes d'utilisateurs et en analysant les données relatives au comportement des utilisateurs, afin d'identifier les domaines de l'expérience utilisateur qui peuvent être améliorés pour générer de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires.








Définir des ICP pour l'entreprise et construire des tableaux de bord automatisés, des rapports et des modèles pour permettre aux équipes de Mistplay de prendre de meilleures décisions.








Concevoir, coordonner et analyser les résultats d'expériences multivariées sur les produits afin de stimuler la croissance, d'améliorer les caractéristiques des produits existants et de tester de nouveaux domaines d'opportunités.








Collaborer avec les parties prenantes des données, du produit, du marketing et de l'ingénierie pour définir les problèmes commerciaux, les projets, identifier les risques et les dépendances, et créer des plans d'exécution.







Ce que tu apporteras à Mistplay :






BA/BS en informatique, mathématiques, économie, statistiques ou autres domaines quantitatifs.








4+ ans d'expérience dans l'analyse quantitative (de préférence dans l'industrie technologique) et une expérience avérée de l'impact sur les décisions relatives à l'entreprise ou au produit.








Capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des concepts et des analyses complexes de manière simple et facile à comprendre, à un large éventail de publics techniques et non techniques.








Expérience des tests A/B et solides connaissances de base des concepts de statistiques inférentielles (signification, puissance, intervalles de confiance, variance, etc.)








Maîtrise du langage SQL. Expérience de l'extraction de données complexes et hautement dimensionnelles, ainsi que de la modélisation de scénarios et de l'analyse de sensibilité à l'aide d'Excel.








Expérience de Python ou d'un autre outil de programmation pour la modélisation statistique








Familiarité avec Tableau ou tout autre outil de BI 








Familiarité avec les technologies de données en nuage telles que AWS, Azure ou Databricks pour interroger et construire des modèles de données et des rapports. 








Une attitude positive et une bonne dose de curiosité naturelle. Il faut répondre aux questions et nos données ne vont pas s'analyser toutes seules. (Nous y travaillons.)







Un atout si tu as... :






Une passion pour les jeux et une bonne connaissance de l'industrie du jeu.








Une compréhension de la science des données et des techniques d'apprentissage automatique








Une expérience du travail avec de très grands ensembles de données et de l'informatique distribuée (Hive/Hadoop).









Nous travaillons dur pour rendre notre environnement de travail aussi accueillant et plaisant que possible ! Un poste chez Mistplay s’accompagne de toute une série d'avantages que nous proposons en mode virtuel ou présentiel : Dîners d'équipe, soirées jeux, événements à l'échelle de l'entreprise, et bien plus encore.




Notre culture est profondément ancrée dans la croissance et soutenue par une équipe de personnes intelligentes, dynamiques et enthousiastes. Nous utilisons les données pour apprendre, améliorer et adapter en permanence. Nous favorisons un environnement dans lequel chacun est encouragé à partager ses idées, à repousser les limites, à prendre des risques calculés et à voir ses visions se concrétiser.

Senior Data Analyst I, Product


The Senior Data Analyst I, Product  within Mistplay's Data department will play a crucial role in enhancing Mistplay's business performance through insightful analysis and driving analytics strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Data Analytics & Experimentation, you will collaborate with Product & Lifecycle Managers to plan and analyze the results of A/B tests, and drive insights reporting in order to inform the release of new product features and engagement strategies.





What You'll Be Doing:







Conduct proactive analysis to identify actionable insights, including diving into the core product funnel, user cohorts, and analyzing user behaviour data, in order to identify areas of the user experience that can be improved to drive new business opportunities.








Define KPIs for the company and build automated dashboards, reports, and models to enable teams at Mistplay to make better decisions.








Design, orchestrate, and analyze the results of multivariate product experiments to help drive growth, improve existing product features, and test new areas of opportunity.








Collaborate with data, product, marketing, and engineering stakeholders to define business problems, scope out projects, identify risks and dependencies, and create execution plans.







What We're Looking For:






BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields








4+ years of work experience doing quantitative analysis (preferably in the tech industry) and a proven track record of impacting a business or product decisions








Pro-level ability to synthesize and communicate complex concepts and analyses in simple, easy-to-understand ways, to a wide range of technical and non-technical audiences








Past experience in A/B testing, and a strong foundational knowledge of core inferential statistics concepts (significance, power, confidence intervals, variance, etc.)








Fluency in SQL. Experience pulling highly dimensional and complex data, as well as modeling scenarios and sensitivity analysis using Excel








Experience with Python or another programming tool for statistical modeling








Familiarity with Tableau or any BI tool 








Familiarity with cloud data technologies such as AWS, Azure, or Databricks to query and build data models and reports 








Positive attitude and a healthy dose of natural curiosity. Questions have to be answered and our data isn't just going to analyze itself. (We're working on that.)







Bonus if you have:






A love of gaming and familiarity with the games industry








Understanding of data science and machine learning techniques








Experience working with very large data sets and distributed computing (Hive/Hadoop)

Strong SQL skills, including Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL.
Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
Proficiency with Power BI and/or Tableau.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience with automated reporting, data validation, and ETL processes.
Working knowledge of statistical analysis and A/B testing is desirable.
Familiarity with AI/ML tools and concepts is considered a nice-to-have.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate data into clear and actionable business insights.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.

Curious, commercially aware, and comfortable investigating business performance.
Customer-focused mindset with an interest in developing deeper business and strategic analytics capability.




Why Join Us




Work directly on analytics supporting sales growth and customer retention.
Gain exposure to multiple areas of the Life Insurance customer lifecycle.
Develop technical, commercial, and strategic analytics capability.
Work closely with business leaders and cross-functional teams.
Opportunity to contribute to automation, process improvement, and future market initiatives.




Benefits

Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization

EV Charging & Energy Infrastructure

Location: Toronto, ON — On-site

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Department: Product Innovation

Reports To: Director of Product & Innovation

Position Type: Individual Contributor

About ECAMION / Jule

eCAMION Inc., operating under the Jule brand, is a Toronto-based clean-technology company developing, deploying, and operating electric vehicle fast charging and energy storage infrastructure.

We design and manufacture our own charging and battery systems, develop the software that manages them, and operate our own charging network. Our work spans hardware, firmware, cloud software, site deployment, and long-term asset operations.

This integrated business creates an opportunity to connect technical performance with financial outcomes—and use those insights to improve the profitability of individual sites and the overall portfolio.

Learn more: www.julepower.com

Position Overview

We are seeking a Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization to evaluate and improve the operational and financial performance of Jule’s EV charging network.

You will use programming, financial analysis, and forecasting to turn raw data into reliable insights at the charger, site, and portfolio levels. You will investigate differences between forecast and actual performance, identify underlying causes, and help implement solutions that improve profitability.

A central responsibility is to develop, prototype, and refine workflows for routine performance and profitability reviews. Once these workflows are validated and sufficiently mature, you will automate them directly or coordinate their handoff to the teams responsible for ongoing operation and software implementation.

Working closely with Product Innovation, Finance, Network Operations, and Software Engineering, you will follow the full improvement cycle: measure performance, investigate gaps, implement changes, and verify results.

Key Responsibilities2. Programming, Data Preparation & Forecasting3. Performance Gap & Root-Cause Analysis4. Workflow Development, Prototyping & Automation5. Solution Development & Implementation


Portfolio Performance & Profitability Analysis
Conduct routine charger-, site-, and portfolio-level performance reviews, including monthly profit-and-loss analysis and comparisons against forecasts, budgets, and prior periods.
Develop and maintain consistent performance metrics covering utilization, availability, charging activity, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and site contribution margins.
Evaluate the drivers of site profitability, including customer demand, pricing, electricity costs, demand charges, equipment performance, maintenance, and site-related expenses.
Work with Finance to reconcile operational and financial information, validate cost assumptions, and apply consistent allocation methods across the portfolio.
Use SQL and Python to extract, clean, validate, and combine raw charging, diagnostic, energy, payment, and financial data into structured inputs for reports and models.
Develop reusable scripts and analytical tools that reduce manual work and improve the consistency, accuracy, and traceability of recurring analysis.
Build and maintain models to forecast charging demand, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and profitability, incorporating site characteristics and clearly documented assumptions.
Use visualizations, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis to illustrate expected outcomes, key uncertainties, and the financial implications of potential decisions.
Evaluate forecast accuracy against actual results and improve models as new data and operating experience become available.
Identify material differences between forecast and actual results, quantify their financial impact, and prioritize issues for investigation.
Distinguish data-quality problems and incorrect modeling assumptions from genuine changes in customer demand, equipment performance, operating conditions, or costs.
Develop and test hypotheses using detailed records, comparisons across sites and periods, and input from engineering, finance, and operations.
Validate likely causes with the relevant teams, clearly distinguishing confirmed findings from unresolved hypotheses or information gaps.
Design and prototype repeatable workflows for routine profitability checks, performance reviews, exception reporting, and follow-up analysis.
Define the data inputs, calculation methods, validation checks, reporting frequency, exception thresholds, and follow-up responsibilities required for each workflow.
Pilot workflows with intended users, gather feedback, and refine them for accuracy, reliability, usability, and efficiency before wider adoption.
Automate validated workflows using scripts and scheduled processes where appropriate, and collaborate with Software Engineering when production-system integration is required.
Prepare mature workflows for handoff through documented logic, test cases, operating instructions, exception-handling procedures, and clearly agreed ownership.
Monitor workflow performance after implementation and address changing business requirements, data sources, or recurring failures.
Propose practical solutions to identified performance gaps, supported by an assessment of expected financial benefit, implementation effort, risks, and dependencies.
Implement improvements within the role’s scope, including revised analytical models, reporting processes, automated checks, decision-support tools, and operating review procedures.
Coordinate approved cross-functional improvements with the responsible teams, such as changes to pricing, operating practices, maintenance priorities, or software functionality.
Track actions through completion, measure results against the original baseline, and determine whether the underlying performance gap has been resolved.
Communicate findings and recommendations through clear dashboards, reports, and presentations that explain what changed, why it matters, what action is recommended, and whether the action worked.


Scope & Collaboration

This role owns the analytical process and the development of performance-monitoring workflows. It is also expected to drive approved improvements through implementation, rather than ending its involvement at the recommendation stage.

Finance retains responsibility for accounting policies and financial reporting approval. Network Operations and Engineering retain responsibility for operational interventions, equipment changes, and production-system releases. The analyst works with these teams to ensure that improvements are implemented appropriately and their impact is measured.

Qualifications

Required


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Industrial/Financial Engineering, Engineering Science, Business Analytics, Computational Finance, or a related quantitative field.
3+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, operational analytics, business intelligence, financial analytics, or a related role.
Strong SQL skills, including joining multiple data sources, time-based analysis, aggregation, and investigating incomplete or inconsistent records.
Hands-on Python skills for data preparation, analysis, modeling, visualization, and workflow automation, using libraries such as pandas and NumPy.
Demonstrated experience developing a repeatable analytical or reporting workflow, improving it through practical use, and automating it or transferring it to an ongoing owner.
Working knowledge of profit-and-loss analysis, revenue and cost drivers, contribution margins, and forecast-versus-actual variance analysis.
Experience building and evaluating forecasts or scenario models, with an understanding of seasonality, uncertainty, and forecast error.
Strong investigative skills, including the ability to test competing explanations for performance gaps and avoid treating correlation alone as proof of causation.
Experience contributing to the implementation of a business, analytical, or operational improvement and assessing its results.
Strong Excel skills and experience presenting findings through Power BI, Tableau, Python-based visualizations, or comparable tools.
Good documentation, version-control, and testing practices for analytical code and recurring workflows.
Ability to communicate clearly, coordinate cross-functional work, and follow through on unresolved issues.
Legal entitlement to work in Canada.


Preferred


Experience analysing EV charging, energy storage, electricity consumption, connected equipment, or multi-site infrastructure operations.
Familiarity with electricity tariffs, demand charges, energy losses, asset availability, or site-level operating economics.
Experience reconciling operational data with payment records, utility bills, or financial reporting systems.
Experience with time-series forecasting or machine learning, including model validation and comparison against simpler baseline methods. Familiarity with TensorFlow or similar frameworks is an asset.
Familiarity with AWS-based data environments, scheduled data-processing jobs, or integration with production reporting systems.
Experience supporting site investment assessments, deployment forecasts, or portfolio-level financial models.


What Success Looks Like

Success means Jule has a reliable, repeatable process for understanding and improving portfolio profitability. Reports require less manual preparation, material performance gaps are identified and explained sooner, forecasts become better grounded in operating evidence, and approved improvements produce measurable results.

Mature workflows are documented, automated where appropriate, and handed over with clear ownership—allowing this role to continue addressing new performance challenges rather than becoming permanently occupied with manual reporting.

What You Will Gain


Hands-on experience connecting EV charging and energy storage performance with site and portfolio economics.
Opportunities to develop practical skills in forecasting, financial analysis, workflow automation, and operational improvement.
Direct exposure to decisions across product, finance, software, and network operations.
Professional growth toward broader responsibilities in portfolio analytics, asset performance, or operational optimization.


Pay Transparency & Hiring Process

This position is being posted to fill an existing vacancy.

We are a fair, equitable, and inclusive employer committed to transparent and human-centered hiring practices. As part of this commitment, we do not use artificial intelligence or automated systems to screen applications. Every résumé is reviewed by a member of our hiring team to help reduce bias and ensure candidates are assessed fairly and thoughtfully.

All candidates who participate in an interview will be informed of the hiring decision in accordance with applicable Ontario employment requirements.

The expected salary range for this position is $75,000 to $95,000 per year, with final compensation determined based on skills, qualifications, education, technical capabilities, and relevant experience. We are committed to pay equity and to offering compensation that is fair, transparent, and competitive.


Comprehensive health and dental benefits.
Paid time off.
On-site parking.
Professional growth and development opportunities.


Jule is committed to an inclusive, accessible hiring process in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and AODA. Accommodations are available at any stage of the selection process upon request.

How To Apply

Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter describing your relevant experience. Highlight an example where you used programming to develop or automate a workflow, investigated a performance gap, and helped implement an improvement. Describe your personal contribution and the resulting outcome.

eCAMION is committed to an inclusive and accessible hiring process. Accommodations are available at any stage of the selection process upon request.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Description:
The Data Analyst, Reporting is responsible for delivering accurate financial and business reporting and providing insights that support the needs of clients and internal stakeholders. This role translates stakeholder needs into clear reports, dashboards and recurring deliverables.

Support improvements to the firm’s reporting capability by assessing and applying appropriate tools and approaches.
Prepare data from various sources for reporting and analysis in Excel, Power BI and other business intelligence tools.
Interpret financial and business information to identify trends, risks and relevant insights for stakeholders.
Translate stakeholder objectives, measures and requirements into clear and accurate reporting deliverables.
Validate and reconcile reports, dashboards and underlying data, resolving discrepancies before distribution.
Prepare client reporting packages, including quarterly and annual presentations, financial templates and ad hoc information.
Develop matter management reports for clients and internal stakeholders.
Advise lawyers and Business Services professionals on reporting requirements, deliverables and interpretation.
Provide reporting and analytical coverage during absences, peak periods and changing business needs.
Maintain documentation for data sources, reporting requirements, calculations and processes.
Review reports, dashboards and supporting analysis prepared by other Analysts for accuracy, completeness and appropriate interpretation.
Provide financial data, reporting and analytical support for projects and firm initiatives.

3 to 5 years of related experience, preferably within a professional services firm.
Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, with expert knowledge of Excel, including pivot tables, is required.

Experience in extracting data from a complex accounting system is required. Experience with 3E would be an asset.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly grasp complex assignments; the aptitude to analyze a variety of considerations, determine what’s important, and assess possible courses of action.
Ability to plan, organize, schedule, and deliver within tight deadlines in a high-pressure environment.
Strong client service orientation combined with the ability to manage multiple client needs at the same time.
Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to interact with individuals at all levels of the organization with tact and diplomacy.
Ability to build strong working relationships with key stakeholders of the firm.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work well both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Strong aptitude for utilizing technology and continuous process improvement.
Sound judgment including the ability to deal with confidential information with utmost discretion.
Exceptional attention to detail.



Hybrid

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

The Client Data Analyst II (analyst) position is responsible for partnering with our clients and teams to drive their initiatives with strategy, analytics and actionable insights, optimizing program measurement to drive field team success, and constantly engaging with the team to better understand where they can have the greatest impact. Experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or reporting roles.

Business requirements gathering and KPI management are also integral parts of the role.

The Senior Analyst will also support the development of innovative solutions, design and implement new processes, and monitor business performance against key metrics. Transform raw data into data structures in our data lake and Snowflake data warehouse that are leveraged for business decision making.

Will have obtained a Bachelor’s degree or higher in 2027.

Experience building and maintaining data pipelines.
Ability to clearly explain technical terms to a non-technical audience.

Experience in a Linux environment
Experience using Python
Experience using Git or other version control systems
Experience with AWS or other cloud service providers
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Previous intern experience

We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.

Job Description

Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.

You will be working on a flexible hybrid schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.

The work location for this role is 483 Bay Street in Toronto until approximately late 2026, when the work location will change to the new Mississauga office at 3 Robert Speck Parkway.

Company Overview

At Fidelity Canada, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future. Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.

Business Overview

Reporting to the Manager, Reporting and Analysis, the Data & Visual Insights Analyst supports the organization's reporting, analytics and business intelligence functions by gathering, organizing, analyzing and distributing insights that feed operational, financial and strategic decision-making. The role is responsible for maintaining recurring reports, designing dashboards, administering data feeds, monitoring data quality, performing foundational analyses, and assisting with reporting automation initiatives.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior analysts and business leaders, develop technical expertise in reporting, SQL, data management, visualization, and business intelligence while helping stakeholders understand business performance through accurate and timely information. They will also be detail-oriented, intellectually curious professionals with a passion for data and continuous learning.They combine strong analytical thinking, technical aptitude, and business awareness to deliver accurate reporting and actionable insights. Through reliable report delivery, strong stakeholder support, and ongoing development of SQL, reporting, visualization, and analytical skills, they build the foundation for progression into senior analytics and business intelligence roles.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Reporting & Performance Monitoring


Maintain and update daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual performance reports
Produce recurring operational, financial, and management reporting packages
Administer systematic reporting processes and ensure reports are delivered accurately and on schedule
Monitor business performance metrics and identify notable trends and exceptions
Assist with report enhancements and modifications based on stakeholder requirements
Coordinate reporting activities and support reporting schedules across business areas


Dashboard Development & Data Visualization


Create and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and visual reports that communicate business performance
Design basic visualizations using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools
Support senior analysts in dashboard development and reporting projects
Prepare presentations and reporting materials that communicate analytical findings effectively
Apply visualization best practices and standardized reporting formats


Data Quality, Governance & Data Management


Validate data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across multiple systems
Maintain critical reporting tables, data repositories, and reporting datasets
Document source tables, data definitions, business rules, and reporting processes
Identify, investigate, and escalate data quality issues and reporting discrepancies
Support data governance initiatives and maintain compliance with reporting standards
Assist with the management of internal and third-party data feeds used for reporting and analysis


Data Analysis & Insights


Gather, organize, and analyze data from multiple sources
Perform ad-hoc analyses to support business questions and decision-making
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement
Support senior analysts in evaluating operational and financial performance
Provide meaningful business context and insights alongside analytical outputs
Assist with performance measurement and KPI reporting initiatives


Data Retrieval


Write and maintain basic queries to retrieve and validate data using the appropriate tool/scripting language for the task
Extract data for dashboards, reports, and analytical projects.
Learn relational database concepts, reporting structures, and data models.
Support reporting automation and data optimization initiatives.
Assist with maintaining reporting datasets and data warehouse structures


Reporting Automation & Process Improvement


Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting activities.
Assist with optimization of existing reports and reporting workflows.
Support efforts to improve reporting efficiency, speed, and usability.
Help eliminate redundant reports and streamline information delivery processes.
Participate in reporting enhancement and data management projects


Stakeholder Support & Training


Work closely with managers and business partners to understand reporting requirements.
Respond to data and reporting inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
Assist in educating end users on reporting tools, data sources, and analytical capabilities.
Build positive working relationships across departments.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly and effectively


The Expertise You Bring


Analytics & Problem Solving
Data Management
Business Intelligence & Reporting, visualization tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Business Objects
Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
Communication & Professional Skills


Experience, Education


University Degree in Computer Science, Finance. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, related analytical discipline or equivalent experience
2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, Finance Analytics or a related field
Experience working with data, spreadsheets, reports, or dashboards.
Exposure to SQL, BI tools, or reporting systems is considered an asset.
Experience analyzing data and communicating findings through reports or presentations is preferred


Nice to Have


Financial services experience considered an asset
Basic understanding of financial reporting and performance analysis
Familiarity with data warehouse concepts
CPA, or other analytical or business designations considered an asset

Title: Senior Analyst, Market Intelligence
Description:
As a Senior Analyst on the Market Intelligence team at Canadian Tire Corporation, you will play a critical role in shaping and executing competitive intelligence and pricing strategies across multiple banners. You will work collaboratively with cross‑functional partners to translate competitive pricing data into actionable insights that inform pricing decisions at both national and regional levels.

This role is ideal for a strong data analyst or analytics‑leaning candidate who enjoys working with complex datasets, building analytical workflows, and translating data into insights that directly inform pricing and executive decision‑making. Your insights will directly support pricing strategy, executive decision‑making, and the continued evolution of Market Intelligence as a more data‑driven, insight‑led capability.

What You'll Do


Own advanced analysis of competitive pricing data across banners, supporting national and regional initiatives, including competitive pricing behaviour, dispersion, and positioning
Design and execute structured, repeatable analytical approaches that move beyond ad‑hoc reporting to support scalable insight generation
Build and enhance analytical workflows (ex. KNIME-based workflows) to support ongoing pricing analysis, monitoring, and insight delivery, evolving processes from manual to more automated and standardized where appropriate
Translate complex competitive pricing datasets into clear, actionable insights that inform pricing strategy, regional decisions, and leadership discussions
Support the readiness, structure, and usability of competitive pricing data to ensure it is fit for downstream analytics, reporting, and decision‑making
Design, build, and maintain standardized reports and interactive dashboards (ex. Power BI) to monitor competitive pricing, trends, and performance across initiatives
Develop reporting that clearly communicates insights, key drivers, and exceptions to cross‑functional teams and leadership
Ensure all reporting and insights are delivered with appropriate context, assumptions, definitions, and implications to support informed decision‑making
Support executive‑level materials by embedding analytical depth, clear visuals, and concise narratives into competitive pricing updates and presentations
Collaborate closely with Pricing Strategy, Regional Pricing, and Merchandising teams to support and expand Market Intelligence initiatives
Partner with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and translate business questions into well‑structured, actionable analyses
Act as a senior contributor to ensuring competitive data accuracy, consistency, and analytical integrity.
Partner closely with internal teams and external vendor to investigate data issues, define business logic, and resolve data quality challenges.
Proactively identify data gaps or risks and recommend improvements to strengthen analysis and outputs.


What You Bring


3+ years of experience in analytics, pricing, market intelligence, business intelligence, or a related analytical role, preferably within retail, pricing, or a data‑driven business environment
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative or analytical discipline
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) also data analytics and BI tools such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, and/or SQL, with experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at various levels within the organization and externally with dealers.
Demonstrated leadership skills to provide thought leadership, influence stakeholders, cultivate relationships with key stakeholders of varied levels, representing a broad range of functions.
Experience using KNIME is an asset.
Ability to work independently and take initiative in a fast-paced business environment with rapidly changing priorities
Highly organized and detail-oriented; able to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively.


We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:


Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs
Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs
Other perks to support your well-being
Career growth opportunities and product discounts


Broadband Salary Range: $64,000 – 106,000.

Our typical hiring range is between $64,000 and $75,000. Salary decisions are also dependent on other factors such as your experience, industry benchmarks, internal equity and other role-specific requirements. It is an especially exciting time to join CTC and its family of companies where career opportunities are wide-ranging! Join us, where there's a place for you here.

We are committed to fostering an environment where belonging thrives, and diversity, inclusion and equity are infused into everything we do. Leverage SQL, Databricks, DAX, and Power Query to transform, model, and analyze data, delivering scalable reporting solutions and actionable insights for business stakeholders. CUSTOMER


Produce specialized reporting packages, dashboards and scorecards for businesses, with focus on understanding objectives and delivering insights for: (1) product design and development; (2) customer engagement; (3) account management; and (4) business decision making.
Use various methodologies to rapidly generate impactful interactive visualizations or tools.
Lead the implementation of initiatives in support of overall business/function strategy.
Conduct analysis to provide enhanced BI to inform management leadership team.
Create complex and comprehensive BI reporting packages and dashboards utilizing data infrastructure, localized DataMart's and external data sources and transform into visual stories using appropriate systems to support client objectives.
Identify and propose data presentations to meet evolving business's needs; utilize various technology/ applications/ methodologies to rapidly generate impactful visualizations.
Build basic layouts and templates to be utilized by internal partners.
Validate the quality and integrity of the data included in the Reporting Packages and Dashboards
Develop meaningful and insightful commentary/ insights on new and existing reporting packages.
Work with business partners to understand business objectives and develop value-added reporting and provide ad-hoc data extracts.
Adopt, implement and effectively evolve report automation and/or visualization standards.
May as a subject matter expert, to provide advisory or consultative services for supported colleagues and/or businesses regarding multi-format data visualization techniques


SHAREHOLDER


Adhere to enterprise frameworks or methodologies that relate to activities for our business area.
Consistently exercise discretion in managing correspondence, information and all matters of confidentiality; escalate issues where appropriate.
Ensure business operations are in compliance with applicable internal and external requirements (e.g. financial controls, segregation of duties, transaction approvals and physical control of assets)
Participate in cross-functional / enterprise / initiatives as a subject matter expert helping to identify risk / provide guidance for complex situations.
Conduct internal and external research projects; support the development/ delivery of presentations / communications to management or broader audience.
Conduct meaningful analysis at the functional or enterprise level using results to draw conclusions, make recommendations, assess the effectiveness of programs/ policies/ practices.
Monitor service, productivity and assess efficiency levels within own function and implement continuous process / performance improvements where opportunities exist.
Lead / facilitate and/or implement actions / remediation plans to address performance / risk /governance issues.
Actively manage relationships within and across various business lines, corporate and/or control functions and ensure alignment with enterprise and/or regulatory requirements.
Maintain a culture of risk management and control, supported by effective processes in alignment with risk appetite.


EMPLOYEE / TEAM


Participate fully as a member of the team, support a positive work environment that promotes service to the business, quality, innovation and teamwork and ensure timely communication of issues/ points of interest.
Provide thought leadership and/ or industry knowledge for own area of expertise in own area and participate in knowledge transfer within the team and business unit.
Keep current on emerging trends/ developments and grow knowledge of the business, related tools and techniques.
Participate in personal performance management and development activities, including cross training within own team.
Keep others informed and up to date about the status / progress of projects and / or all relevant or useful information related to day-to-day activities.
Contribute to team development of skills and capabilities through mentorship of others, by sharing knowledge and experiences and leveraging best practices.
Lead, motivate and develop relationships with internal and external business partners / stakeholders to develop productive working relationships.
Contribute to a fair, positive and equitable environment that supports a diverse workforce.
Act as a brand ambassador for your business area/function and the bank, both internally and/or externally


Breadth & Depth


Work independently as the senior analyst / subject matter expert and may provide technical support to others.
Requires advanced knowledge of reporting and BI platforms, tools and techniques, and ability to effectively leverage it to support diverse reporting and BI functions.
Considered a subject matter expert within a given area.
Expert knowledge of all main data sources for the data used within the business unit and ability to effectively utilize these data sources for reporting purposes.
Experienced professional role providing specialized data visualizations with an emphasis in Power BI to support business needs.
May be expected to have a knowledge of broader enterprise reporting platforms and data sources and ability to integrate data across the enterprise.
May be expected to present to senior management or executives.
Oversee and/or independently perform tasks from end to end.
Generally, focus on broad range of moderately complex issues that may span from short to medium term (e.g. monthly-quarterly),
Generally, reports to a Senior / Manager role


Experience And / Or Education


Undergraduate degree or advanced technical degree preferred (e.g., math, physics, engineering, finance or computer science) Graduate's degree preferred with either progressive project work experience or
3+ year of relevant experience; higher degree education and research tenure can be counted.
Design and implement custom data solutions using SQL, Databricks, DAX, and Power Query, ensuring robust semantic models, efficient data processing, and trusted Power BI reporting capabilities.


Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Title: Business and Market Data Analyst
