The Ontario Securities Commission (OSC) is the statutory body responsible for regulating Ontario’s capital markets in accordance with the mandate established in the provincial Securities Act and the Commodity Futures Act. The mandate of the OSC is to provide protection to investors from unfair, improper or fraudulent practices, to foster fair, efficient and competitive capital markets and confidence in the capital markets, to foster capital formation, and to contribute to the stability of the financial system and the reduction of systemic risk. This mandate is performed through policy, operational, and enforcement activities. The OSC also contributes to national and global securities regulation development.




We offer a diverse, fair, and flexible work environment and take pride in our challenging and rewarding work.




The Investment Management Division oversees the regulation of investment funds and structured products that offer securities to the public in Ontario. Our function in the OSC’s mandate of providing investors protection is a vital one. We have a leadership role in developing new rules and policies within the OSC and within the Canadian Securities Administrators (CSA) to adapt to the changing environment in the investment fund and structured products industry. Our scope of activity includes reviewing and considering investor protection issues related to the offerings of investment products (including mutual funds, exchange traded funds, structured products, scholarship plans and labour-sponsored funds); assessing product disclosure, including prospectus and continuous disclosure filings; and considering applications for discretionary relief from Ontario securities legislation and rules.




The Business and Market Data Analyst position will involve playing a key role in profiling the activities of the Investment Management Division by reporting on the success and impact of Division initiatives and core work processes. The Divisions core processes include rule and policy consultation, prospectus and exemptive relief application reviews and issue-oriented reviews of important regulatory development. The Business and Market Data Analyst’s primary function will be to support the Division’s core processes by conducting research, collecting and interpreting market data and activities and supporting special policy projects the Division undertakes (i.e. Risk Methodologies, and Regulatory burden-reduction initiatives).




Reporting to the Manager, Analytics, the Business and Market Data Analyst will be instrumental in developing, maintaining and analyzing key financial data to measure, and report on, internally and for publication (i.e. quarterly and annual reports).




Key Duties and Responsibilities:




Market Research for Division Core Processes




Provide research, including conducting background research on topics relating to investment activities in the funds industry, novel investment products, capital market development, and investor protection concerns, as requested.
With division staff identify, plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative market research to inform on mutual funds industry trends which impact on core Division processes and decisions, including prospectus, application and continuous disclosure reviews.
Conduct analysis of investment products’ attributes and risks using internally developed analytical datasets and frameworks.
Monitor, assess and interpret trends in the investment funds and structured products markets, both in Canada and globally, and prepare and design requirements on these trends.
Proactively identify additional market data and information to collect, maintain and analyze which is conducive to the efficient and effective operation of Investment Management Division.
Identify problems whereby efficiencies can be achieved, research and evaluate various alternatives and proceed with the most efficient solution.
Assess data quality, completeness, and limitations, and document analytical assumptions and methodologies. Present research findings to the Division management team, senior staff, policy project leads and/or committees (i.e. CSA) and address questions and/or defend analysis.




Data Collection, Preparation and Analysis




Work with other divisions to identify, evaluate, access, organize, clean, validate, and maintain internal and external data sources required to support Division research, analysis, and reporting.
Maintain analytical datasets and models to support market monitoring, operational oversight, and risk‑based analysis.
With division staff interpret information related to Division operations, analyze market data, and present and report issues, findings and trends that impact on the work of the Division.

Develop, maintain dashboards and report, using Division-wide operational performance measures, to better reflect how the Division is meeting its mandate (i.e. for use in quarterly reports).
Analyze trends, anomalies, and emerging risks in market and operational data and surface issues that may require supervisory, policy, or operational action.




Enterprise Systems and Data Access




Leverage enterprise systems and platforms to extract and use data required for Division analysis and reporting.
Coordinate with enterprise system and digital teams as required to ensure appropriate data access and alignment with organizational standards.




Skills & Qualifications:




Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collect, organize, and translate data into clear insights.
Knowledge of financial markets and investment products, including mutual funds and ETFs, with the ability to analyze market trends and interpret data.
Excellent presentation, problem-solving and strategic thinking skills.
Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated tact and sensitivity when negotiating with diverse parties.
Ability to interact professionally with management and professionals at various levels.
Demonstrated ability to respond to ad hoc unstructured problems with planning, flexibility, communication and execution.
Demonstrated ability to conduct research and prepare dashboards.
Ability to work with minimal direction and prioritize and meet strict deadlines.
Knowledge or experience in the securities industry.
Understanding of investment funds regulation and funds’ operations.




Education & Training:




University degree in Business, Finance or a related discipline.
Experience working with data analysis and visualization skills with, data science tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, Python and SQL for data preparation, automation and analytical initiatives.
A minimum of 3-5 years of intermediate-level experience in the financial and/or regulatory sector, performing a similar function. Equivalent combinations of education, experience, and demonstrated competencies will be considered.
Understanding of the Canadian securities regulatory environment, with the capability of assessing the impact of various regulatory actions on stakeholders and the capital markets.
Basic knowledge of the Ontario Securities Act, regulations, policy statements, rules and internal operating procedures.
High proficiency in the MS Office suite of products.
Completion of the Canadian Securities Course, an asset.

Title: Business and Data Analyst
Description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Business & Data Analyst to support the launch and growth of our consumer lending business in Canada.

This is a key role in building our data and analytics capabilities from the ground up. The successful candidate will initially play a hands-on role in establishing our data, BI and reporting foundation, and will progressively take on broader business analytics across customer acquisition, application and conversion, product performance, operations, customer lifecycle and overall business performance.

The ideal candidate combines a strong quantitative and analytical foundation, hands-on data capabilities, and strong business sense. You should be comfortable working directly with data, building dashboards and reporting solutions from scratch, identifying the drivers behind business performance, and translating analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.

Experience in consumer lending, fintech, banking or other credit-related businesses is highly preferred.




Key Responsibilities

1. Business Intelligence & Reporting

Build and develop the company's BI and reporting capabilities from the ground up.
Develop and maintain dashboards and recurring reports covering key business and operational metrics.
Establish and maintain a consistent KPI framework and business performance reporting structure.
Extract, consolidate and transform data from multiple sources to support business reporting.
Automate recurring reporting processes and continuously improve reporting efficiency and accuracy.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate them into practical data solutions.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency and reliability of key management reports and dashboards.

2. Data Management & Analytics

Use SQL and other analytical tools to extract, clean, transform and analyze data from multiple sources.
Build reliable datasets and analytical tables to support reporting and business analysis.
Conduct data quality checks and identify data gaps, inconsistencies and anomalies.
Develop a strong understanding of data structures, business definitions and relationships across key systems.
Work with Technology and other cross-functional teams to improve data availability, quality and usability.
Support the development of data processes and analytical infrastructure as the business grows.

3. Business Performance Analytics

Analyze end-to-end business performance across customer acquisition, applications, conversion, funding, repayment and operations.
Monitor key business metrics and identify trends, anomalies and opportunities.
Analyze acquisition channels and marketing campaigns to understand customer acquisition and conversion performance.
Analyze the application funnel and identify key customer drop-off points and conversion drivers.
Conduct cohort, segmentation and trend analysis to understand changes in business performance over time.
Analyze loan origination, loan volume, average loan size, revenue and other key business metrics.
Conduct root-cause analysis and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.

4. Product & Customer Analytics

Analyze customer behavior and performance across the customer journey, from acquisition and application through funding and repayment.
Analyze product performance, customer segments, conversion rates and customer behavior.
Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, application experience and product conversion.
Support Product and Business teams with data-driven analysis for new products, features, processes and initiatives.
Conduct customer segmentation, cohort analysis and other analytical exercises to identify customer trends and business opportunities.
Support A/B testing and other data-driven initiatives where appropriate.

5. Business Decision Support

Partner closely with Business, Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance and Technology teams to support data-driven decision making.
Translate complex data and analytical findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
Provide ad-hoc analysis to support strategic and operational business decisions.
Proactively identify emerging business trends, operational issues and opportunities through data analysis.
Prepare analytical materials and insights for management discussions and business reviews.
Go beyond reporting what happened to understand why it happened, what it means for the business, and what actions should be taken next.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or above in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or another quantitative discipline.
3–5 years of relevant experience in business analytics, data analytics, BI, product analytics, marketing analytics or a related analytical role.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to work with complex datasets and conduct structured analysis.
Strong hands-on experience with SQL and data extraction, transformation and analysis.
Experience building dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau or similar BI tools.
Strong Excel skills and experience with data manipulation and analysis.
Strong understanding of data cleaning, data transformation and data quality management.
Demonstrated ability to translate data into meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.
Strong business acumen, with the ability to understand the business context behind the numbers and identify the underlying drivers of business performance.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working independently and taking ownership in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience in consumer lending, fintech, banking or other credit-related businesses.
Experience analyzing lending or financial services data.
Experience with customer acquisition, marketing analytics, product analytics or application funnel analysis.
Experience with loan origination, customer lifecycle or repayment data.
Experience with Python, R, SAS or other analytical programming languages.
Experience with data modeling, ETL or modern data platforms.
Experience with A/B testing, cohort analysis or customer segmentation.
Experience building BI and analytics capabilities in a new or rapidly growing business.




What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is strong with numbers, comfortable with data, and genuinely interested in the business.

The ideal candidate is not simply a reporting analyst who tells us what happened. You should be able to look at the data and ask:

Why did application or conversion rates change?
Which acquisition channels are performing best, and why?
Where are customers dropping off in the application journey?
Which customer segments or products are performing differently?
What operational issues are affecting customer experience or business performance?
What opportunities can we identify from the data?
What should the business do differently based on the analysis?

You will have the opportunity to play a key role in building the data-driven foundation of a new Canadian consumer lending business from 0 to 1, while working closely with senior management and multiple business functions.

Title: Sr. Analyst, Business Intelligence
Description:
At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

We are seeking an experienced Senior Analyst to join our dynamic Business Intelligence team. The Senior Analyst will play a pivotal role in driving marketing strategies, optimizing campaign performance, and maximizing ROI through advanced analytics and insights generation. This position offers an exciting opportunity for an analytical thinker with a passion for marketing to make a significant impact within our organization.

What You'll Do Here:

Lead the development and delivery of strategic reports and insights, translating complex data into actionable recommendations that drive business growth and marketing optimization.
Conduct advanced analysis and modeling using both primary and secondary research methods to uncover trends, opportunities, and performance drivers.
Act as a strategic partner to cross-functional teams, providing data-driven recommendations to support key business initiatives and decision-making.
Develop and optimize sophisticated dashboards and reporting frameworks using BI tools to enable leadership with real-time, actionable insights.
Ensure data governance and compliance, collaborating with technology, product, and data engineering teams to maintain data integrity and regulatory standards.
Drive process improvements and innovation, identifying opportunities to enhance analytical capabilities, streamline workflows, and implement best practices.
Manage and consolidate data from diverse sources, ensuring comprehensive and high-quality inputs for business analysis and strategic planning.
Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members, fostering knowledge sharing and skill development across the team.
Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, leveraging insights to provide thought leadership and shape future business strategies.
Lead stakeholder engagements, effectively communicating insights, recommendations, and complex data concepts to non-technical audiences at various organizational levels.

You'll Need To Have:

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data analysis, or related roles. Marketing agency work experience preferred.
Experience with DSPs, Paid Media, and social media platforms preferred.
Experience in executing brand tracking and Brand Lift research preferred.
Experience in Google Cloud Platforms and BI tools such as Looker and Looker Studio preferred.
Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Python, R, SQL, or similar scripting languages.
Experience with marketing analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or similar tools.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas to non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail and a passion for problem-solving and continuous improvement.

Title: Business Insights Analyst
Description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:




BCU Financial is seeking a motivated and analytical full-time Business Insights Analyst to join the Product, Sales & Marketing team. Reporting to the Manager, Product, Sales & Marketing, the role supports data-driven decision-making by analyzing member, product, sales, marketing, channel, and operational data. The analyst develops reports, dashboards, and performance insights that help leadership monitor results, identify trends, and measure organizational performance. 




Working primarily with Product, Sales & Marketing and collaborating with Finance, Operations, Technology, and Member Service teams, the Business Insights Analyst transforms data into actionable business intelligence that supports planning, performance management, member growth, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate combines strong analytical capability, attention to detail, business curiosity, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:




Business Analytics & Insights

Analyze member, product, channel, marketing, sales, and operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities. 
Perform routine, ad hoc, and exploratory analyses in support of business initiatives and operational priorities. 
Interpret findings and develop clear, actionable recommendations for management and business partners. 
Conduct root-cause analysis to investigate performance variances, emerging issues, and business challenges. 
Prepare analytical summaries, presentations, and briefing materials for management and senior leadership. 




Business Decision Support

Provide analysis and performance information to support management decisions, operational reviews, and strategic initiatives. 
Assist with business cases, forecasting exercises, budgeting activities, and project evaluations. 
Evaluate the performance and business impact of products, services, campaigns, programs, and process enhancements. 
Participate in cross-functional projects by contributing analytical expertise, measurement frameworks, and evidence-based recommendations. 




Member & Market Analysis

Conduct member segmentation, demographic, behavioural, and lifecycle analyses to support growth and engagement strategies. 
Monitor member acquisition, retention, product adoption, channel utilization, and service usage trends. 
Analyze member behaviours and product utilization to identify opportunities to strengthen member experience and relationships. 
Research competitor activity, financial services trends, and market developments to support planning. 
Prepare comparative analyses and benchmarking reports on market position, member trends, and product performance. 




Data Management & Quality

Collaborate with Technology, Operations, Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other business teams to ensure the availability and reliability of data sources.
Investigate data discrepancies and recommend corrective actions to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistency.
Maintain documentation of reporting methodologies, calculation logic, business definitions, and analytical processes.




Performance Reporting & Dashboard Development

Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, recurring reports, and business intelligence tools based on approved business requirements. 
Collaborate with business owners to define, track, and report on approved key performance indicators and operational metrics. 
Produce weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for management and leadership teams. 
Monitor performance against established targets and highlight significant trends, exceptions, and areas requiring attention. 
Automate and streamline reporting processes to improve efficiency, consistency, and data accessibility. 
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of reporting outputs and underlying data sources. 




Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

Partner with business teams to understand operational challenges, analytical needs, and reporting requirements. 
Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. 
Provide guidance to business users on interpreting reports, dashboards, performance metrics, and analytical findings. 
Assist users in understanding reporting tools and dashboard functionality. 
Encourage effective use of performance information and analytics across the organization. 




Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, automation, and predictive analytics. 
Recommend enhancements to data visualization, KPI frameworks, and analytical methodologies. 
Remain current on business intelligence tools, analytics practices, financial services trends, and industry developments. 
Contribute to initiatives that strengthen organizational reporting and analytical capabilities. 




Success Measures

Accurate and timely reports, and analytical summaries.
Clear identification of trends, exceptions, and areas requiring management attention.
Improved visibility into member, product, sales, marketing, and operational performance.
Effective support for business planning, performance monitoring, and decision-making.
Strong collaboration with stakeholders and clear communication of findings.
Continued improvement in reporting consistency, data quality, and dashboard usability.




QUALIFICATIONS:




Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
Three or more years of experience in business analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or performance measurement. 
Experience analyzing business data and translating findings into practical recommendations. 
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI tracking tools. 
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and practical experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, attention-to-detail, and communication skills. 
Ability to present data and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
Experience working with business systems and information sources to extract, organize, validate, and analyze data. 




Preferred Assets

Experience in financial services, banking, credit unions, insurance, or another regulated industry. 
Experience supporting product, sales, marketing, member experience, or business performance initiatives. 
Experience with member or customer analysis, market research, forecasting, trend analysis, or business case development. 
Experience with CRM systems, business intelligence platforms, or enterprise reporting solutions. 
Experience with Power Query, data modelling, or DNA’s CRM BI tool. 
Knowledge of SQL, data warehousing concepts, or statistical analysis techniques.
Experience working in member-focused, community-based, or culturally diverse organizations.




COMPENSATION:




Salary Range: $68,000 - $82,000 annually




Compensation for this role will be determined based on experience and qualifications. BCU Financial also offers a competitive and comprehensive beneﬁts package.




This role represents an existing vacancy. Interested candidates are invited to apply for this role exclusively by submitting their application via email to hr@bcuﬁnancial.com. Please note that while we thank all applicants for their interest in a career with BCU Financial, only those chosen for an interview will receive further communication.




BCU Financial Group is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. BCU Financial Group provides accommodation during the recruitment process upon request. Requests received relating to accommodation will be addressed conﬁdentially.




About BCU Financial:




BCU Financial is a member-owned ﬁnancial cooperative dedicated to improving the lives of its members and their community. As part of the growing Ontario-based BCU Financial Group, it provides Ukrainian-Canadians with diversiﬁed ﬁnancial services and products.




BCU Financial Group offers a compelling alternative to traditional banking through its various divisions. BCU Financial provides a no-fee personal chequing account, along with savings accounts, loans, mortgages, credit cards, and online banking to its members. The broader BCU Financial Group also encompasses BCU Wealth Management and BCU Insurance, serving clients with investment and insurance services respectively, and supports the community through BCU Foundation and its donors. BCU Financial, together with its BCU Wealth Management division, currently oversees $1.2 billion in assets.




Underscoring its commitment to building a strong community, BCU Financial Group provides generous sponsorship funding annually to a wide array of Ukrainian community-based projects and activities. The Credit Union and its member-supported charitable institution, BCU Foundation, provide sponsorship funding of over $1 million annually for community organizations, charity fundraisers, student scholarships, cultural events, and educational projects.

Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

Job Title: Manager, Data Analytics

Data Analyst plays a critical role in enabling enterprise-wide data-driven decision-making by managing and advancing McKesson’s data assets. This position is responsible for identifying, capturing, analyzing, and organizing data to support strategic and operational objectives. The role ensures adherence to information governance standards and leverages advanced analytics to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that inform key business decisions. The analyst designs and maintains relational databases, creates dashboards and reports, and implements statistical models to guide decision-making. Collaborating with governance teams, data stewards, and business stakeholders, this position drives improvements in data quality, accessibility, and usability while influencing best practices across the organization.

Job Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do:


Manage and advance the data fabric to organize, integrate, and deliver enterprise data assets.
Design, create, and maintain relational databases and data systems, ensuring scalability and reliability.
Implement and apply statistical models to identify trends, patterns, and relationships that support decision-making.
Contribute to the management of central data stores and metadata, establishing and enforcing quality expectations.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, including automation and procedural enhancements for data entry and validation.

Title: Transformation Analyst
Description:
At Environmental 360 Solutions Ltd. (E360S), we don’t just manage waste - we redefine the industry. Fueled by an ambitious and innovative entrepreneurial vision and decades of leadership, we’re building a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable future. Our team is made up of driven professionals who thrive on challenge, embrace technology, and never stop learning. If you’re looking to do work that matters - where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your impact is real - you’ve come to the right place.




The Transformation Analyst provides the analytical backbone of the transformation program, delivering analytical support and dashboard development for both the broader business and the transformation initiatives themselves. This role builds interactive KPI dashboards that measure business and initiative performance, surfaces insights and flags that drive action, and applies AI and analytics tools to make reporting faster, sharper, and more predictive. The role works closely with the Transformation Finance Lead, IT, workstream leads, business stakeholders, and SMEs to ensure dashboards reflect accurate, well-governed data from approved data sources.




Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain interactive KPI dashboards tracking both business and transformation initiative performance (financial, operational, and milestone-based).
Partner with the Transformation Finance Lead, workstream leads, and business stakeholders to define KPIs, metrics, and underlying data sources across both the business and the transformation program.
Leverage AI and analytics tools to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks within business and program data.
Build automated flagging and alerting logic that highlights at-risk KPI and business metrics, along with a recommended call to action defined according to SME rules and logic.
Support data collection, cleansing, and integration across multiple source systems spanning business and transformation reporting needs.
Prepare analytical support and visuals for business stakeholders as well as SteerCo and Board reporting.
Prototype and pilot AI-enabled tools that support the Transformation Office's operations and broader business reporting (e.g., automated reporting, natural-language dashboard querying).
Partner with IT to ensure dashboards are built on approved, well-governed data sources.
Ensure data integrity, governance, and consistent metric definitions across all business and transformation dashboards.
Continuously refine dashboards and reporting based on stakeholder feedback and evolving business and program needs.




Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or BI development roles.
Proficiency with BI/dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and SQL.
Experience with AI/ML tools or LLM-based analytics solutions is a plus.
Prior experience in a transportation and / or environmental waste environment.
Experience building L1, L2, and L3 interactive dashboards for all levels of management and business functions




Key Skills & Competencies

Strong analytical rigor. Able to validate data quality and challenge inputs rather than building dashboards on unverified numbers.
Skilled at translating ambiguous or conflicting stakeholder requests into clear, well-defined KPIs and metric logic.
Working knowledge of AI/ML and automation tools, with the judgment to know where they add real value versus where they add complexity without benefit.
Ability to build flagging/alerting logic that produces genuinely actionable insights, not noise or false positives that erode stakeholder trust.
Strong data governance instincts, insisting on approved, well-documented data sources rather than convenient but unreliable ones.
Comfortable partnering with IT to resolve data access, integration, and quality issues
Ability to present data-driven insights persuasively to both business and transformation stakeholders, tailoring the message to the audience.
Adaptable and proactive. Able to iterate dashboards quickly based on feedback without losing consistency in underlying metric definitions.
Comfortable operating with incomplete or evolving requirements, typical of a fast-moving transformation environment.

Bring your expertise, your curiosity, and your drive. Let’s build a sustainable future we can all be proud of. Apply today and discover what’s possible when purpose meets progress.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Business Analyst with experience in Data Analysis, Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate should possess strong data analytical skills, be proficient in SQL and reporting tools, and have hands-on experience validating business requirements through functional testing and stakeholder engagement. Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will be preferred.




Key Responsibilities

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders.
Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, gaps, and actionable insights.
Develop and execute test cases, test scenarios, and UAT plans based on business requirements.
Validate data accuracy, business rules, and system functionality through testing activities.
Perform root cause analysis for data and reporting issues and coordinate resolution with technical teams.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI and Tableau.
Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
Utilize Python for exploratory data analysis, data validation, and automation of repetitive tasks.
Collaborate with business users, QA teams, developers, and project managers during project delivery.
Facilitate UAT sessions, track defects, and ensure timely closure of issues.
Prepare business requirement documents (BRDs), functional specifications, test cases, and user documentation.
Support production releases and post-implementation validations.




Required Skills

Must-Have

2-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or related role
Strong proficiency in SQL for data analysis and validation
Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis and reporting
Experience with Power BI and/or Tableau
Strong understanding of Testing and UAT methodologies
Experience in requirement gathering, stakeholder management, and business process analysis
Ability to translate business requirements into test scenarios and acceptance criteria
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills




Preferred Skills

Data Quality Assessment and Reconciliation
Test Planning, Defect Tracking, and UAT Coordination
Knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts
Exposure to ETL processes and data pipelines
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies
Experience working with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools




Preferred Domain Experience

Insurance domain experience preferred but not mandatory
Exposure to Property & Casualty (P&C), Claims, Underwriting, Policy, or Reporting processes will be an added advantage




Communication & Soft Skills

Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong stakeholder management and client interaction capabilities
Ability to facilitate workshops, requirement discussions, and UAT sessions
Strong attention to detail and documentation skills
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

Title: Staff Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Risk Data Science team builds the data foundations, models, and measurement frameworks that power Stripe's risk and product decisions — from underwriting and reserves to merchant interventions and enablements. We're at an inflection point: as Stripe increasingly offers risk capabilities as a product to platforms and users, we need a data leader to shape how we build, measure, and evolve our risk data strategy.

What you’ll do

We are looking for an experienced data analyst to drive the data strategy for our risk as a product offering. Define the metrics, data products, and analytical frameworks needed as Stripe brings risk capabilities to platforms and connected accounts at scale. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Risk leadership to ensure data investments align with the product roadmap. You will design metrics, pipelines, and data products that serve as the analytical backbone for risk decisioning.

You will own the definition, reliability, and visibility of our most important risk metrics. Establish a canonical set of north star and operational metrics and ensure they are trustworthy, well-documented, and consistently surfaced to the right audiences. Build and maintain the infrastructure that keeps these metrics accurate as our data and product landscape evolves, including clear ownership, alerting on regressions, and scalable pipelines that reduce the cost of keeping insights current.

You will also own and evolve Stripe's risk experimentation strategy by defining what we test, how we measure, and how we learn. Ensure we can rigorously evaluate the impact of changes to risk policies, merchant journeys, and risk models across diverse merchant populations.

Finally, you will mentor and raise the bar for the Data Analysts on the team. Set technical and strategic standards. Guide junior and senior analysts on how to frame ambiguous problems, structure analyses for maximum impact, and communicate findings to senior stakeholders.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


10+ years in Data Analytics, Data Science, or related roles
Track record of defining and driving data strategy across multiple teams — not just executing on a roadmap, but shaping it
Experience designing experimentation frameworks or measurement strategies for complex, multi-variant systems (e.g., risk policies, pricing, marketplace dynamics)
Deep expertise in SQL; proficiency in Python
Strong ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical approaches and communicate findings to executive stakeholders
Experience building and scaling data products (metrics frameworks, pipelines, dashboards) that become operational infrastructure, not one-off analyses
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across engineering, product, and business teams
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis and coding



Preferred Qualifications


Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related technical field
Experience in risk, trust & safety, or related domains and understanding of risk in the Fintech space
Experience building data for platform/product offerings where data is part of the product surface, not just internal analytics
Familiarity with causal inference and A/B testing in non-standard environments (e.g., where randomization is constrained by risk considerations)



Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $179,000 - $268,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Title: Data Analyst, Reporting
Description:
The Data Analyst, Reporting is responsible for delivering accurate financial and business reporting and providing insights that support the needs of clients and internal stakeholders. This role translates stakeholder needs into clear reports, dashboards and recurring deliverables.


Develop and maintain complex financial and non-financial reports and dashboards for client, management and business needs.
Support improvements to the firm’s reporting capability by assessing and applying appropriate tools and approaches.
Prepare data from various sources for reporting and analysis in Excel, Power BI and other business intelligence tools.
Interpret financial and business information to identify trends, risks and relevant insights for stakeholders.
Translate stakeholder objectives, measures and requirements into clear and accurate reporting deliverables.
Validate and reconcile reports, dashboards and underlying data, resolving discrepancies before distribution.
Prepare client reporting packages, including quarterly and annual presentations, financial templates and ad hoc information.
Develop matter management reports for clients and internal stakeholders.
Advise lawyers and Business Services professionals on reporting requirements, deliverables and interpretation.
Provide reporting and analytical coverage during absences, peak periods and changing business needs.
Maintain documentation for data sources, reporting requirements, calculations and processes.
Review reports, dashboards and supporting analysis prepared by other Analysts for accuracy, completeness and appropriate interpretation.
Provide financial data, reporting and analytical support for projects and firm initiatives.



Qualifications


Post-secondary degree or diploma in Finance or Accounting, or equivalent experience, is essential.
3 to 5 years of related experience, preferably within a professional services firm.
Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, with expert knowledge of Excel, including pivot tables, is required.
Working knowledge of SQL and Power Query in Excel is required. Experience with Power BI Desktop, MDX, and/or DAX would be an asset.
Experience in extracting data from a complex accounting system is required. Experience with 3E would be an asset.



Core Competencies


Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly grasp complex assignments; the aptitude to analyze a variety of considerations, determine what’s important, and assess possible courses of action.
Ability to plan, organize, schedule, and deliver within tight deadlines in a high-pressure environment.
Strong client service orientation combined with the ability to manage multiple client needs at the same time.
Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to interact with individuals at all levels of the organization with tact and diplomacy.
Ability to build strong working relationships with key stakeholders of the firm.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work well both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Strong aptitude for utilizing technology and continuous process improvement.
Sound judgment including the ability to deal with confidential information with utmost discretion.
Exceptional attention to detail.



Hybrid

This position is part of our hybrid work model with 3 days in the office per week. As part of our onboarding, new hires are required to be in the office more often for the first few months of employment to ensure they receive the requisite cross training.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

Title: Senior Analyst, Business Analysis and Insights
Description:
Position Summary...The Senior Analyst, Business Analysis and Insights will manage and analyze data to provide actionable insights and recommendations. This role may involve interpreting complex data sets, ensuring data accuracy, and collaborating with various teams to drive business growth through strategic decision-making.

What You'll Do...

The Senior Analyst, Business Analysis and Insights will manage the interpretation, analytics reporting, and analysis for key insights and performance recommendations. The role may involve compiling and analyzing data, leading client-facing analysis, and ensuring data accuracy through regular audits and data visualization processes. This position may also assist in the development of measurement tools and platforms while fostering strong business partnerships.

The role will involve leading marketing initiatives, tracking and reporting participation in events, and improving site performance through various optimization techniques. Additionally, it may include preparing category-level analysis and collaborating with product teams to create automated reports.

The position will work closely with various stakeholders to understand their evolving information needs and build a tangible data strategy. Responsibilities may include data management, extraction, and visualization, as well as managing job responsibilities in an AGILE (SCRUM) fashion. Business requirements gathering and KPI management are also integral parts of the role.

The Senior Analyst will also support the development of innovative solutions, design and implement new processes, and monitor business performance against key metrics. The role involves analyzing quantitative and qualitative data to identify opportunities and drive continuous improvement projects that lead to scalable processes.

Qualifications


3-5 years of experience in Data Analytics
Proficient in SQL and Visualization Tools (PowerBI or Tableau)
Strong analytics, problem solving and storytelling capabilities with data
Proven ability to lead cross-functional programs and drive operational outcomes
Excellent oral and written communication and documentation skills
Retail or eCommerce experience is an asset, particularly Canadian retail experience


Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Loyalty Analytics Analyst to lead data-driven insights for our CRM & loyalty program. You will own the analytics function for loyalty, turning complex customer, transaction, and engagement data into strategic recommendations that boost retention, increase lifetime value, and maximize program ROI. This is a high-impact senior role where your expertise will directly shape loyalty strategy.

What You'll Do


Development and optimization of advanced SQL queries and data models to extract, transform, and analyze large volumes of loyalty, transactional, subscription, and behavioral data from multiple sources.
Design, build, and maintain self-served Power BI dashboards and reports using advanced DAX, star-schema modeling, and performance optimization techniques to track key loyalty metrics such as retention/churn, customer lifetime value (CLV), segment performance, redemption rates, campaign ROI, and tier effectiveness.
Conduct in-depth Ad Hoc analysis about customer segmentation, cohort evaluation, behavioral deep-dives, and program performance to identify opportunities and risks.
Support end-to-end loyalty analytics: evaluate marketing campaigns effectiveness and provide clear, actionable recommendations to the loyalty and Marketing teams.
Partner closely with Product, Finance, and Executive teams to translate insights into prioritized business strategies and roadmaps.
Present compelling, executive-ready insights and storytelling dashboards/Presentations to senior leadership.


Let's Talk About You


Advanced SQL expertise – highly proficient with complex queries (CTEs, window functions, performance tuning, and optimization) on large-scale datasets.
Expert-level Power BI proficiency is a must – strong command of DAX, data modeling, row-level security, custom visuals, and Power BI Service governance.
Previous experience with loyalty programs – proven track record analyzing loyalty initiatives (points, tiers, rewards, redemption, retention mechanics).
5+ years of hands-on analytics experience, preferably in loyalty, CRM, customer retention, or related domains.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong business acumen and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and present to executive audiences.


What’s in it For You?


A company built on Canadian roots and heritage
Your work is recognized with a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards Program
Opportunities for career growth through numerous internal and external programs
Recognize and be recognized by your peers with our Goose Rewards & ICON Rewards

Inspiring leaders and colleagues who will lift you up and help you grow

3-5 years of related work experience

Intermediate (advanced is ideal, not required) Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills including formulas, pivot tables, V-look-up

Participate in reporting enhancement and data management projects

Data Management
Business Intelligence & Reporting, visualization tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Business Objects
Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
Communication & Professional Skills

University Degree in Computer Science, Finance. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, related analytical discipline or equivalent experience
2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, Finance Analytics or a related field
Experience working with data, spreadsheets, reports, or dashboards.
Exposure to SQL, BI tools, or reporting systems is considered an asset.
Experience analyzing data and communicating findings through reports or presentations is preferred


Nice to Have


Financial services experience considered an asset
Basic understanding of financial reporting and performance analysis
Familiarity with data warehouse concepts
CPA, or other analytical or business designations considered an asset

Title: Business Insights & Analytics Analyst
Description:
At OSL Retail Services, we believe people are the heart of everything we do, and it is an exciting time to be part of something special! Our momentum is growing, and is fueled by innovation, collaboration, and a shared entrepreneurial spirit that drives real results. Founded in 2012 in Mississauga, Ontario, OSL delivers customized sales solutions in retail, direct sales, and customer acquisition, all built on a foundation of integrity, respect, and passion. Our culture thrives on connection, purpose, and growth. If you’re looking for a place where your talents are valued, your ideas matter, and your career can grow, we’d love to meet you.




About The Role

We are currently seeking a Business Insights & Analytics Analyst. This role advances our analytical maturity in the fast-paced retail and direct sales industries. Going beyond standard reporting, the position focuses on uncovering what is happening, why it is happening, what is likely to happen next, and what the business should do about it. The ideal candidate is a curious, commercially minded analytical thinker who can translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations while partnering with business leaders to drive better decision-making.




What you’re responsible for:




Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, relationships, and business opportunities, going beyond standard reporting to uncover the “so what”
Translate analytical findings into clear insights, recommendations, and actions that support measurable business outcomes
Apply statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, and other advanced techniques to solve business problems
Identify opportunities to use predictive analytics and machine learning to understand drivers and anticipate future outcomes
Partner with business leaders to translate challenges into analytical questions, hypotheses, and actionable insights
Provide analytical thought partnership on strategic and operational decisions (forecasting, workforce planning, sales performance, customer behavior, and operational performance)
Leverage generative AI and AI-powered tools to accelerate data exploration, research, analysis, and insight generation
Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and other functions to understand needs and identify analytical opportunities
Develop dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations when appropriate to communicate insights and support decisions
Use tools such as SQL, Python, Domo, Power BI, Tableau, and other analytical technologies to explore, analyze, and communicate data
Partner with BI Developers and data teams to ensure analysis is based on accurate, reliable data and to translate requirements into scalable solutions




To join our team




Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Management Information Systems, or a related field
5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, financial analytics, market research, statistics, or a related analytical role (retail or data-driven environment preferred)
Strong SQL and data analysis skills, with experience applying statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, predictive analytics, or other advanced techniques
Experience with analytical and visualization tools such as Python, Domo, Power BI, Tableau, R, or similar
Familiarity with machine learning, generative AI, and AI-powered analytical tools, with interest in applying emerging technologies
Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with ambiguity and independently identify opportunities from data
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear, compelling insights for non-technical audiences




The salary for this role is $71K to $78K, with a yearly eligible 5% bonus. Your final compensation will reflect your years of experience and beyond the numbers, we’re proud to offer a holistic package that includes:

Generous time off: Start with 3 weeks of vacation.
Comprehensive benefits package: Includes medical, dental, vision and a health spending account.
Retirement support: Company-sponsored RRSP matching program to help build your financial future.
Award-winning culture: Proud to be one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies for 8 years running — now a Platinum Club member.
Invested in you: Structured employee development programs designed to help you thrive.




We’re committed to supporting your success every step of the way. What are the next steps?




The Interview Process

Step 1: If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first conversation with the recruiter.

Step 2: The next step is a virtual or in person interview with the hiring manager.

Step 3: The final step is an in-person interview with the hiring manager and extended team members.




Ready to bring your talent to a team where your impact matters? Apply today — we can’t wait to meet you!




We thank all interested applicants; however, only qualified candidates will be contacted. This position requires successful completion of a criminal background check. Title: Analytics Consultant, Decision Support, Business Intelligence - FT (J0426-0587)
Description:
Company Bio

North York General is one of Canada’s leading community academic hospitals with a vision to deliver World-Class Care, 24/7. Affiliated with the University of Toronto, our multi-site campus supports our diverse community through every stage and life-defining moment by providing a wide range of acute care, ambulatory and long-term care services.

What defines North York General goes beyond exceptional quality care. Our superpower is how we deliver that care – the unparalleled compassion we bring to every encounter, during the moments that matter. Through partnerships, collaboration and academic endeavours, we seek to set new standards for People-Centred Care—a cornerstone of our culture and central to our Mission: People-Centred Care for a healthier community.

North York General is a member of the North York Toronto Health Partners, an Ontario Health Team that integrates local care with patients, primary care and community partners.

We are proud to be a place where the best people come to learn, grow and innovate. Join North York General to accelerate your career!

Position Summary

Analytics Consultant, Decision Support Your goal in this position is to work with health system administrators and professionals to facilitate evidence-based decision making that is aligned with North York General Hospital’s strategic directions. You will support the organization regarding information needs and analysis for decision making, quality improvement, internal/external reporting requirements and gaining insights into its business. You will provide support and assistance to various stakeholders on patient activities, resource utilization, evaluation of quality of care, benchmarking and validation and research. You have a solid understanding of population funding methodology including HBAM/HBAM Inpatient Group methodology and Quality Based Procedures. You have a good understanding of clinical and corporate data needs in a hospital setting. You have excellent oral and written communication skills. You have strong problem solving, data management and analytical skills. You are able to communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders and work with all levels of management. You can multi-task and manage multiple projects concurrently and meet deadlines. You have strong organizational and time management skills. This position contributes to the shared responsibility of ensuring health and safety policies are followed to provide for a healthy environment for patients, staff, physicians, volunteers and families.

On a practical level, you will


Integrate and analyze clinical and utilization/administrative data to produce reports to support decision making
Provide centralized consulting services through education, communication and presentations to all levels of management (Directors, Managers, etc.)
Take a lead role in providing advice and recommendations on analytical approaches/methodologies to drive stakeholders toward making data-driven/evidence informed decisions
Extract data, develop and generate standard reports, and respond to ad-hoc requests using Business Intelligence (BI) tools (e.g., Cognos, PowerBI, Tableau), SQL, R, Python, Excel or other analytic tools
Assist with benchmarking activities related to clinical and corporate performance data
Provide critical analysis of data to assist clinical teams with optimizing the use of clinical practice guidelines
Prepare custom reports for day-to-day business use, and data quality and validation purposes
Perform quality control reviews including data processing flow analysis to ensure reliability and accuracy of collected data
Coordinate and implement Decision Support related projects through the phases of project management
Track and analyze key corporate performance indicators
Provide guidance and expertise with respect to indicator and metric development for performance monitoring
Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to support reporting and evaluation projects
Support and help advance the Data & Analytics Governance program (e.g., data quality, metadata)
Coach and explain technical matters to other staff and assist BI Report writers and other staff in the hospital.


Qualifications


Degree in Health Information or a related field (Business Administration, Computer Science, Statistics, Health Sciences or Health Information Management, mathematics or data science), or equivalent education/experience. A Master’s degree is an asset.
Three to five years of experience working with databases and various health information systems
Experience with data science solutions, including data analysis and linkage, data modelling, and advanced analytics is an asset
In-depth knowledge of databases used to capture information in various health sectors including: Hospital databases (e.g., NACRS, DAD, OMHRS), data tools (e.,g., intelliHealth, CIHI Your Health System Insights)provincial/regional data repositories (e.g., Wait Times Information System) and Hospital standards including ICD-10CA
Expert knowledge of SQL and advanced Excel skills
Knowledge of statistical tools, such as R, Python, etc
Experience with BI tools, such as Cognos, PowerBI and Tableau
Proficient in the use of Windows Operating System and Microsoft Office suite (PowerPoint, Word)
Strong data management and statistical analysis skills required
Experience with information systems used for managing and reporting clinical and corporate data


What We Offer

Working at NYGH means working with a dynamic team of fellow healthcare providers, staff, and volunteers in one of Canada’s leading hospitals. This is a Full-time Regular Position with 8 hour shifts,D ays shifts in the Decision Support, Business Intelligence department . We offer a highly competitive total compensation package that includes benefits, pension, and vacation. The decision to join a company is a big one. We have opportunities for hard working, energetic and reliable people just like you.

Does working with some of Canada’s most talented minds in innovation supporting retail, digital consumer solutions and analytical platforms excite you? Loblaw Technology powers some of Canada’s most game-changing retail solutions, giving our customers the ability to live their lives well.

Come work with a team that values diverse ideas, fosters a culture of inclusion and develops our talent from within. Loblaw Technology gives you the chance to excel and helps you to strive for success in a big way. Keep reading to learn more!

As an Analyst on the Business & Customer Insights team, you will play a pivotal role in driving data-informed decision-making for PC Optimum, the largest loyalty program in Canada. In this role, you will extract actionable insights from PC Optimum data and help build stories with data enabling our stakeholders to make informed strategic decisions that enhance the overall customer experience and drive business growth. You will work closely with data to uncover insights that create meaningful value for our customers.

What You'll Do:


Apply your analytical expertise to collaborate with a wide range of business stakeholders and support data-informed decision-making. Your work will include both strategic and tactical initiatives such as reporting, process automation and dashboard development
You will be responsible for extracting, reviewing, and preparing complex operational and customer-behavior data from multiple databases. Your insights will help solve business problems, identify new opportunities, and shape strategic direction.
In this role, you will synthesize large volumes of data from diverse sources—including customer transactions, consumer and syndicated research, market share data, and campaign performance—interpreting key findings to deliver clear, value-added recommendations.
You will also develop and present materials that effectively communicate insights, simplifying complex information for audiences at all levels, including senior leadership.
Additionally, you will build and maintain stakeholder-focused dashboards that use data visualization to clearly highlight key trends and insights.


What You Bring


University Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Business or other relevant fields
1-2 years of experience in a similar role translating data into relevant and actionable business insights
The ability to define problems, collect and synthesize large amounts of data, form complex queries, establish facts and draw valid and actionable conclusions
Intermediate knowledge of SQL, BigQuery, Looker Studio
Basic knowledge of Python, R is an asset
Strong attention to detail and critical thinking skills to ensure data accuracy and quality
A curious mindset to continually explore new ideas and willingness to ask clarifying questions to navigate ambiguity, while being a strong self-starter
Strong communication, critical thinking and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to stay on top of a dynamic and fast-moving business

Ontario Medical Supply is a Leading Distributor of medical equipment, supplies, and services for healthcare organizations and home healthcare clients across Ontario. Specializing in long term care, assisted living, retirement and home health care. Ontario Medical Supply is partnered for success with Royal Drugs. Royal Drugs is a healthcare company providing specialty pharmacy, infusion therapy, and retail pharmacy services. Together, we work towards supporting optimal health outcomes and better quality of life.




Come Join Our Team!




Purpose:

In this role the Inventory Analyst will be the analytical foundation for our inventory and planning operations. Your work will significantly influence strategic and operational decisions by transforming raw data into insights, actionable dashboards, and supply chain strategies. You will help improve service levels, optimize inventory management, and enhance ERP data integrity.




Position: Inventory Analyst

Location: Ontario Medical Supply. – Mississauga (2785 Skymark Ave, Mississauga, ON L4W 4Y3),

No. of Positions: 1

ATR:#5188

Type: Full Time, Permanent

Salary: $53,200-$60,000/year




This job posting is for an existing vacancy




Job Responsibilities:

Data Analytics & Insights

Perform in-depth analysis on inventory, purchasing, demand forecasts, and supply chain KPIs.
Identify patterns, risks, and opportunities to improve efficiency, service levels, and cost performance.
Develop simulation and what-if analysis for key planning scenarios.




Reporting & Dashboards

Design, automate, and maintain dashboards (using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar) for inventory performance, order fulfillment, supplier reliability, and system optimization metrics.
Prepare weekly and monthly reporting packs for leadership, identifying key variances and root causes.




Planning Support

Support demand and replenishment planning by providing accurate, data-backed inputs.
Collaborate with purchasing and warehouse teams to align stock levels with demand trends and customer requirements.
Assist in safety stock analysis, min/max planning, and ABC categorization.




ERP & Master Data Integrity

Assist in ensuring the ERP system reflects accurate lead times, order quantities, and item attributes.
Partner with the Inventory and Purchasing Manager to enhance master data quality and maintain accurate planning parameters.




Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with warehouse, sales, finance, and customer service teams to align operations and mitigate supply chain risks.
Support ad hoc analysis requests from business stakeholders




Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business Analytics, or related field.
APICS/ASCM or other supply chain certification (CPIM, CSCP).
2–4 years of experience in supply chain analysis, inventory planning, or operations analytics.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, advanced formulas); experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
Experience working with ERP systems (preferably in the distribution or medical products sector).
Experience with SQL, Python, or other data tools.
Familiarity with demand planning, S&OP, or inventory optimization methodologies.




Skills:

Candidates must demonstrate strong communications skills (both verbally and written), organization, ability to --negotiate, good mathematical skills, sound judgment and initiative
Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and ability to turn data into decisions.
Must be a highly-motivated, self-driven person who can learn quickly and be comfortable in a fast-paced environment
Proficient in Microsoft Office Tools (excel, pivot tables, Power BI etc.) Use of SAP, WMS, Pronto etc.
