Comprehensive health benefits package, including MSP, extended health and dental and municipal pension plan
Grow your career with employer-paid training and leadership development opportunities
Wellness supports, including counselling, critical incident and innovative wellness services are available to employees and their immediate families
Award-winning recognition programs to honour staff, medical staff and volunteers
Access to exclusive discount offers and deals for VCH staff


At Vancouver Coastal Health, our vision of healthy lives in healthy communities inspires us and our values and pillars guide us. We encourage applications from equity-deserving communities, including Indigenous Peoples and members of racialized groups, people with disabilities and people of all gender identities and expressions and sexual orientation.

Vancouver Coastal Health is proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, BC’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers and Canada's Top Employers for Young People in 2026.

Only short-listed applicants will be contacted for this posting.

Current VCH employees who apply to this posting using this external site will be considered as an external candidate. Seniority will not apply.***

Thank you for your interest in Vancouver Coastal Health.

Diploma in a related program plus three to four (3-4) years' recent, related experience in a complex health care environment with progressively more responsible secretarial and administrative positions supporting senior level management, experience in information analysis and benchmarking, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Advanced computer skills in spreadsheet, database, graphics and word processing programs is required, e.g. Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio.


Knowledge & Abilities


Employs expertise in the use of computer software and applications to create a variety of analytical reports, documents, and presentations, and to maintain databases.
Applies acquired skills and knowledge to efficiently and independently resolve administrative issues/ problems.
Effectively utilizes both verbal and written communication skills when providing advice or information or seeking/acquiring information.
Develops and maintains strong relationships with key internal and external partners to promote and enhance services provided with sensitivity to diversity and indigenous lens.
Practices the recognition, inclusion and support of all types and aspects of diversity at all stages of engagement, with an understanding of the issues faced by people from equity-deserving groups.
Optimizes departmental effectiveness and contributes to organizational success by applying excellent time management skills to prioritize and complete assignments and schedule activities.
Practices diligence and care when maintaining, monitoring, calculating and summarizing data, records and budget information.
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

Title: Quantitative Equity Analyst Process Engineering
Description:
We are looking for a Quantitative Equity Analyst to join our Quantitative Equity Team! We are a high-performance team embedded in a top-performing quantitative equity fund that manages over $78+ billion USD in financial assets. We are dedicated to the mission-critical operation of our investment engine—a well-tuned machine responsible for generating key decisions that drive trades and investment insights. Leveraging finance skills and cutting-edge technology, we ensure data quality, continuous process improvement, and operational excellence.

As a core member of our team, you'll collaborate with investment experts to tackle challenging analytical problems, be accountable to ensure accurate and timely trade generation, and drive operational innovation. Based in West Coast Vancouver, we value mentorship, collaboration, and growth in a supportive and innovative environment. Join us to make a significant impact on our investment engine and overall success.

What You Will Do

This is an exciting full-time role for individuals who are passionate about learning the quantitative equity investment management business and excited to tackle a broad range of investment, mathematical, and technology challenges.

You will start with a comprehensive training program, learning about various elements of quantitative equity investment management and our investment process.

You will then continue to a specialized role utilizing data science and process engineering skillsets to accelerate the Quantitative Equities Team’s various investment functions. Your specialized role may involve building, scaling, managing and/or analyzing our quantitative model, portfolios, data assets and optimizers.

You will be supported with coaching and mentorship from senior members of the team.

We are creating the conditions for you to grow your career steadily over time.

Investment Process Management

The team you will be joining is our Investment Process Management (IPM) group within our Quantitative Equities Team. IPM plays a central role in building highly scalable, efficient, and robust process management systems. The processes and infrastructure we maintain are critical in the team’s ability to develop systematic investment insights and generate daily trades to capture these insights in portfolios. The opportunity within the IPM group allows ambitious individuals to drive their career growth within IPM, or across the other functions of the Quantitative Equities Team in Research, Portfolio Construction, or Trading.

Skills

While we take the approach of tailoring the career path for the individual, we have found our functions to cover two main overarching technical skillsets:

Process and Reliability Engineering


Design, implement and test production processes to run the alpha and risk, portfolio optimization and market implementation processes.
Design robust, high performance and effective process orchestration.
Monitor production health and respond to critical issues in a timely manner.
Effectively communicate real-time production issues to portfolio managers, traders and researchers.
Identify computational bottle necks and improve run speeds in production systems.
Collaborate with investment teams to ensure their process needs are being met.
Find and evaluate areas for process improvements.
Assess and evaluate data quality of production processes.
Maintain process repos, clean code and tools within production processes.


Data Science


Construct and run algorithms to explore and assess data effectively.
Validate structured and unstructured data sets for data quality.
Design and test data loaders and security matching processes and specifications.
Perform data analysis and provide data expertise to support researcher’s projects.
Facilitate production machine learning operational pipelines with effective and timely auditing and analysis.
Enable accessibility and clarity within our data assets through robust documentation and data scrubbing.
Develop robust methodologies for assessing and analyzing data in time critical production environments.
Respond to and mitigate vendor data issues effectively in a production setting.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate traditional and alternative data into existing analytical frameworks and decision-making processes.
Present findings and recommendations to key stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.


What You Bring


Analytical Mindset – You think critically and creatively and are adept at balancing intuition with statistical validation.
Financial Knowledge – You possess a thorough understanding of (or strong desire to learn) key drivers of business success, including financial theory, economic models, and corporate financial statements.
Self-Starter – You are motivated and willing to take personal accountability for quality and timeliness of work.
Collaborative Approach – You thrive in a collaborative environment and value shared success. You proactively solicit and provide input and excel at communicating complex and technical concepts.
Time Management – You have the ability to manage and prioritize multiple ongoing projects and daily responsibilities.
Academic Training – At a minimum, an undergraduate degree in finance, mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline. Completion of CFA or relevant graduate degree is considered an asset.
Industry Experience – You have a passion for quantitative finance, equity investment, data science or related fields.


We welcome applications from candidates with a range of experience, including new graduates and experienced professionals. The annual base salary range is $155,000 – $350,000. Our compensation and benefits package includes a substantial variable year-end bonus, RRSP contribution matching, health benefits, and family-building benefits.

As a private organization owned by active leaders, our structure provides opportunities for exceptional contributors to participate in profit sharing and, over time, potentially become equity owners of the firm.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume, cover letter, and academic transcript.

Learn more by exploring our website: www.cclimq.com

We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.

AI may be used to support certain stages of our screening & recruitment process. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment and decision-making.

Title: GIS Analyst
HTML:
Explore A Career At Mosaic
Mosaic is a diversified, 100% Canadian-owned land solutions company focused on long-term value creation from private forest lands and public forest tenures. Through an integrated, multi-use approach, Mosaic manages its land base across sustainable forestry, renewable energy, watershed services, recreation, real estate and carbon programs, bringing together innovation and stewardship to strengthen economic performance and environmental resilience. By aligning these complementary uses within a single land portfolio, Mosaic builds lasting value while helping shape the future of sustainable land management. Learn more at MosaicForests.com.

The Opportunity 
Mosaic is seeking a GIS Analyst to work out of one of our Vancouver Island offices in Nanaimo, Nanoose Bay, or Campbell River, British Columbia.

The Role 
Reporting to the Manager, Forest Information Systems (FIS) Services, the GIS Analyst takes on the full range of spatial work across Mosaic’s landbase, from sustainable forestry and watershed services to renewable energy, recreation, real estate and carbon projects. One week might involve improving inherited data and rebuilding a workflow; the next, running an analysis for an operational plan and producing a map series for field crews, or scoping spatial data for a new project. We're looking for someone comfortable taking on an unfamiliar problem and working out how to solve it. Specific responsibilities will vary with business priorities and and will include:

  • Conduct spatial analyses that support operational planning and land management decisions — constraint and net-area analysis, terrain modelling, suitability assessment, and change detection;
  • Integrate and quality-control spatial data from internal, contractor, provincial, and third-party sources — layouts, as-builts, cruise data, imagery and LiDAR;
  • Produce operational maps, map series, and web maps for field crews, reports, and regulatory submissions;
  • Automate repetitive analysis and data workflows using Python, ModelBuilder, and FME; and
  • Work directly with planners, foresters, and project teams to scope spatial data needs and translate results into clear, actionable insights.

What We’re Seeking:

  • Post-secondary degree or diploma in GIS, Geography, Geomatics, Forestry, Environmental Science, or a related spatial discipline;
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in GIS analysis, spatial data management, and cartographic production;
  • Solid spatial data QC skills — the ability to find and fix problems in data from a range of sources;
  • Strong working knowledge of the Esri ArcGIS Suite, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Enterprise;
  • Experience building and maintaining project and file geodatabases, and working within established data standards;
  • Experience automating GIS processes using Python, ModelBuilder, and/or FME;
  • Working knowledge of relational databases, including MS SQL Server, in a GIS environment;
  • Comfort working across a variety of project types, including unfamiliar ones, with limited direction;
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills;
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, communicate clearly, and manage multiple priorities;
  • Familiarity with Trimble Land Resource Manager (LRM), forestry data systems, and coastal BC terrain is considered an asset; and
  • Forestry work experience and/or registration with the ABCFP as an RPF or RFT (or eligibility for registration) is considered an asset.

Mosaic values diversity and recognizes that talent comes in many forms. Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. We’re eager to learn about your unique knowledge, skills and experiences. 

What You Get
We are proud of our highly collaborative, respectful, and innovative work environment. Our employees are empowered with high levels of role autonomy and the ability to make decisions and lead change.

At Mosaic, we believe in rewarding our employees with a comprehensive and competitive package that reflects the value they bring to our team. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect when you join us:

  • Competitive compensation that matches your skills and experience.
  • Annual bonus tied to both individual and company performance, recognizing your contributions to our success.
  • Employer-paid premiums for a robust benefits package to support your wellness.
  • Company-funded defined contribution pension plan to help secure your future.
  • Generous paid vacation program, to recharge and relax.
  • Up to one day per week of remote work, subject to role requirements and leader approval.
  • We also offer various additional benefits and programs, including maternity and parental leave EI top-ups, opportunities for continuing education and professional development.

 All programs and benefits are subject to change.

Compensation
The annual salary range for this position is $72,000 to $90,000. Individual compensation is commensurate with skill, relevant experience, and education.

To Apply
Visit mosaicforests.com/careers and click on the Job Opportunities to apply.  This position will remain posted until filled.

At Mosaic, we believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can contribute their whole, authentic selves to help us achieve our strategic goals. We’re proud to be an Employer Partner of the Canadian Centre for Diversity and Inclusion and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment that values diversity and promotes equity.

Job Summary

The Department of Psychiatry at the University of British Columbia invites applications for a full-time Research Computing Analyst with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning and scientific computing. The successful candidate will work under the direct supervision of the Principal Investigator, Prof. Sophia Frangou, President’s Chair in Brain Health, and will receive detailed instructions on assignments. The successful candidate will carry out programming and technical tasks, troubleshoot computational problems, and contribute to the development and implementation of solutions under the guidance of senior members of the research team. Work will be reviewed for accuracy, completeness and timeliness.

The successful applicant will primarily contribute to the CentileBrain Project. This is a computational neuroimaging initiative focused on individual-level brain characterization. It combines large-scale imaging data, normative modelling, harmonization and machine learning. The platform generates individualized centile and deviation scores across the lifespan. The goal is to support precision neuroscience and clinically meaningful individual inference.

Organizational Status

The Department of Psychiatry at the University of British Columbia invites applications for a full-time Research Computing Analyst with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning and scientific computing. The successful candidate will work under the direct supervision of the Principal Investigator, Prof. Sophia Frangou, President’s Chair in Brain Health, and will receive detailed instructions on assignments. The successful candidate will carry out programming and technical tasks, troubleshoot computational problems, and contribute to the development and implementation of solutions under the guidance of senior members of the research team. Work will be reviewed for accuracy, completeness and timeliness

Work Performed


Oversees the implementation of established machine-learning, artificial-intelligence and statistical methods in research datasets, modifies existing scripts as required using detailed specifications, and recommends computational workflow modifications to the PI.
Performs data preparation, quality control, feature extraction and other defined computational tasks for large-scale research studies.
Integrates multimodal datasets using established analytical procedures and modifies existing code as required to support data compatibility and processing.
Runs and maintains computational workflows on local and high-performance computing systems, including monitoring processing and addressing routine execution issues.
Resolve routine technical problems in code, data processing and computational workflows and escalate new issues for consultation with senior team members.
Provides first-level technical support to research team members using established computational workflows and systems.
Maintains clear documentation of code and script modifications, analytical procedures, software versions, testing results and computational outputs.


Consequence of Error/Judgement

The Principal Investigator will provide oversight for this position. Given the importance of the work to the research program, errors or poor judgment could substantially compromise research quality, delay project completion, and adversely affect future funding opportunities. Inaccurate or ineffective representation of the team’s work could also damage relationships with funding agencies and collaborators. The position therefore requires consistently high standards of accuracy, judgment, efficiency, and communication.

Supervision Received

The successful candidate will work within the broad direction established by the Principal Investigator and research team, with a high degree of independence and minimal supervision. The successful candidate will be expected to exercise sound judgment in carrying out defined responsibilities, collaborate effectively with team members, and proactively identify and bring emerging issues, risks, or unusual circumstances to the attention of the Principal Investigator.

Supervision Given

The successful candidate may assign tasks to students and provide oversight and review of their work.

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of one year of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.


Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion


Preferred Qualifications


An undergraduate or master’s degree in computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, statistics or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience with analyses of human neuroimaging MRI data
Strong programming skills
Demonstrated experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence or advanced statistical modelling.
Experience working with high-dimensional or complex biomedical, biological or scientific datasets.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Note: Candidates are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas. We are particularly interested in applicants who combine strong computational skills with the ability and interest to apply them to human neuroscience and biomedical research

Title: Analyste de l’information
Description:
La personne titulaire est chargée de mener des enquêtes fondées sur le renseignement de sources ouvertes afin d’appuyer les activités de la Mise en application de l’OCRI. Son rôle ne se limite pas à la collecte de données : il consiste également à interpréter et à synthétiser des renseignements complexes provenant de diverses sources, à dégager des tendances, des liens et des constatations clés qui orientent la stratégie relative aux dossiers et ouvrent de nouvelles pistes d’enquête. La personne titulaire transforme des données brutes et des éléments de preuve en renseignement clair donnant matière à intervention disciplinaire. En collaboration avec les équipes de la Mise en application, elle joue un rôle essentiel dans l’avancement des enquêtes par l’exercice de son jugement analytique, le maintien de l’intégrité des données et la gestion de multiples priorités dans un environnement dynamique axé sur les dossiers.

Principales responsabilités

Enquêtes


Mener des enquêtes approfondies sur les sociétés autorisées et les personnes autorisées en réponse aux plaintes du public (dont celles traitées par l’Évaluation des dossiers de l’OCRI), en réalisant des recherches exhaustives à partir du renseignement de sources ouvertes.
Consulter des bases de données internes et externes, des sources ouvertes et les médias sociaux afin de recueillir, de valider et d’analyser le renseignement pertinent.


Analyse et soutien à la Mise en application


Collaborer avec les équipes de la Mise en application en organisant, en interprétant et en présentant des données et des éléments de preuve à l’appui des dossiers en cours, y compris en préparant des pièces matérielles et en présentant les constatations à la direction et aux collègues.
Au moyen des outils logiciels disponibles, recueillir et analyser des renseignements complexes, produire des visualisations de données et rédiger des rapports de renseignement clairs mettant en évidence les principales constatations, les tendances observées, les lacunes relevées et les mesures à prendre recommandées afin de soutenir la prise de décisions à l’égard des enquêtes et les mesures disciplinaires.
Soutenir les procédures disciplinaires en témoignant lors d’audiences, au besoin.


Développement de la fonction de renseignement


Participer aux réunions d’équipe et contribuer aux projets d’amélioration continue en proposant des démarches novatrices concernant les pratiques, les processus et l’efficacité opérationnelle globale du renseignement.
Repérer les lacunes en matière de renseignement, les difficultés à relever dans les enquêtes, les liens entre les sources d’information ainsi que les occasions de renforcer les stratégies d’enquête.
Concevoir et tenir à jour des outils de suivi des données (p. ex. systèmes de gestion de la relation client [GRC], feuilles de calcul Excel et tableaux de bord Power BI), effectuer la saisie et l’agrégation des données, et améliorer continuellement les flux de travaux et les processus d’analyse afin d’accroître l’efficacité et d’améliorer les résultats des enquêtes.
Développer et maintenir une fine connaissance des systèmes de l’OCRI, des sources de données, des outils d’analyse (p. ex. systèmes de GRC, Excel, i2, Power BI et logiciels de renseignement de sources ouvertes) ainsi que des technologies émergentes grâce à du perfectionnement professionnel continu et à l’apprentissage autonome.
Établir des relations de travail efficaces avec les parties prenantes en matière de réglementation et les autorités compétentes d’autres territoires afin de soutenir la mission de l’OCRI et de renforcer les activités d’enquête et de renseignement.


Aptitudes et compétences clés

Éléments essentiels


Diplôme d’études postsecondaires en criminologie, en finance, en affaires ou en comptabilité
Compétences ou expérience en matière d’enquêtes fondées sur le renseignement de sources ouvertes
De 3 à 5 années d’expérience dans le secteur du placement à travailler avec des données
Grande maîtrise de l’ensemble des fonctionnalités de Microsoft 365
Connaissance des outils de visualisation de données comme Microsoft Power BI et i2
Bon jugement dans l’évaluation de la pertinence, de l’utilité et de l’importance de l’information Grand souci du détail et souci de fournir de l’information qui peut être utilisée dans une audience contestée
Aptitudes pour la gestion et la coordination de projets
Expérience des logiciels de base de données et expérience en saisie de données
Esprit d’équipe et excellente aptitude pour la communication orale et écrite


Atouts


Expérience dans les secteurs de la réglementation, de l’application de la loi, de la comptabilité ou de la finance
Connaissance pratique des stratégies de négociation des participants et de leurs clients
Capacité à communiquer en français et en anglais

La personne titulaire transforme des données brutes et des éléments de preuve en renseignement clair donnant matière à intervention disciplinaire. Principales responsabilités

Enquêtes

  • Mener des enquêtes approfondies sur les sociétés autorisées et les personnes autorisées en réponse aux plaintes du public (dont celles traitées par l’Évaluation des dossiers de l’OCRI), en réalisant des recherches exhaustives à partir du renseignement de sources ouvertes.
  • Consulter des bases de données internes et externes, des sources ouvertes et les médias sociaux afin de recueillir, de valider et d’analyser le renseignement pertinent.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes de la Mise en application en organisant, en interprétant et en présentant des données et des éléments de preuve à l’appui des dossiers en cours, y compris en préparant des pièces matérielles et en présentant les constatations à la direction et aux collègues.
  • Au moyen des outils logiciels disponibles, recueillir et analyser des renseignements complexes, produire des visualisations de données et rédiger des rapports de renseignement clairs mettant en évidence les principales constatations, les tendances observées, les lacunes relevées et les mesures à prendre recommandées afin de soutenir la prise de décisions à l’égard des enquêtes et les mesures disciplinaires.
  • Soutenir les procédures disciplinaires en témoignant lors d’audiences, au besoin.

  • Participer aux réunions d’équipe et contribuer aux projets d’amélioration continue en proposant des démarches novatrices concernant les pratiques, les processus et l’efficacité opérationnelle globale du renseignement.

  • Grande maîtrise de l’ensemble des fonctionnalités de Microsoft 365

  • Bon jugement dans l’évaluation de la pertinence, de l’utilité et de l’importance de l’information Grand souci du détail et souci de fournir de l’information qui peut être utilisée dans une audience contestée

  • Esprit d’équipe et excellente aptitude pour la communication orale et écrite

Title: Quantitative Equity Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a Quantitative Equity Analyst to join our Quantitative Equity Team! We are a high-performance team embedded in a top-performing quantitative equity fund that manages over $78+ billion USD in financial assets. We are dedicated to the mission-critical operation of our investment engine—a well-tuned machine responsible for generating key decisions that drive trades and investment insights. Leveraging finance skills and cutting-edge technology, we ensure data quality, continuous process improvement, and operational excellence.

As a core member of our team, you'll collaborate with investment experts to tackle challenging analytical problems, be accountable to ensure accurate and timely trade generation, and drive operational innovation. Based in West Coast Vancouver, we value mentorship, collaboration, and growth in a supportive and innovative environment. Join us to make a significant impact on our investment engine and overall success.

What You Will Do

This is an exciting full-time role for individuals who are passionate about learning the quantitative equity investment management business and excited to tackle a broad range of investment, mathematical, and technology challenges.

You will start with a comprehensive training program, learning about various elements of quantitative equity investment management and our investment process.

You will then continue to a specialized role utilizing data science and process engineering skillsets to accelerate the Quantitative Equities Team’s various investment functions. Your specialized role may involve building, scaling, managing and/or analyzing our quantitative model, portfolios, data assets and optimizers.

You will be supported with coaching and mentorship from senior members of the team.

We are creating the conditions for you to grow your career steadily over time.

Investment Process Management

The team you will be joining is our Investment Process Management (IPM) group within our Quantitative Equities Team. IPM plays a central role in building highly scalable, efficient, and robust process management systems. The processes and infrastructure we maintain are critical in the team’s ability to develop systematic investment insights and generate daily trades to capture these insights in portfolios. The opportunity within the IPM group allows ambitious individuals to drive their career growth within IPM, or across the other functions of the Quantitative Equities Team in Research, Portfolio Construction, or Trading.

Skills

While we take the approach of tailoring the career path for the individual, we have found our functions to cover two main overarching technical skillsets:

Data Science


Construct and run algorithms to explore and assess data effectively.
Validate structured and unstructured data sets for data quality.
Design and test data loaders and security matching processes and specifications.
Perform data analysis and provide data expertise to support researcher’s projects.
Facilitate production machine learning operational pipelines with effective and timely auditing and analysis.
Enable accessibility and clarity within our data assets through robust documentation and data scrubbing.
Develop robust methodologies for assessing and analyzing data in time critical production environments.
Respond to and mitigate vendor data issues effectively in a production setting.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate traditional and alternative data into existing analytical frameworks and decision-making processes.
Present findings and recommendations to key stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.


Process and Reliability Engineering


Design, implement and test production processes to run the alpha and risk, portfolio optimization and market implementation processes.
Design robust, high performance and effective process orchestration.
Monitor production health and respond to critical issues in a timely manner.
Effectively communicate real-time production issues to portfolio managers, traders and researchers.
Identify computational bottle necks and improve run speeds in production systems.
Collaborate with investment teams to ensure their process needs are being met.
Find and evaluate areas for process improvements.
Assess and evaluate data quality of production processes.
Maintain process repos, clean code and tools within production processes.


What You Bring


Analytical Mindset – You think critically and creatively and are adept at balancing intuition with statistical validation.
Financial Knowledge – You possess a thorough understanding of (or strong desire to learn) key drivers of business success, including financial theory, economic models, and corporate financial statements.
Self-Starter – You are motivated and willing to take personal accountability for quality and timeliness of work.
Collaborative Approach – You thrive in a collaborative environment and value shared success. You proactively solicit and provide input and excel at communicating complex and technical concepts.
Time Management – You have the ability to manage and prioritize multiple ongoing projects and daily responsibilities.
Academic Training – At a minimum, an undergraduate degree in finance, mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline. Completion of CFA or relevant graduate degree is considered an asset.
Industry Experience – You have a passion for quantitative finance, equity investment, data science or related fields.


We welcome applications from candidates with a range of experience, including new graduates and experienced professionals. The annual base salary range is $155,000 – $350,000. Our compensation and benefits package includes a substantial variable year-end bonus, RRSP contribution matching, health benefits, and family-building benefits.

As a private organization owned by active leaders, our structure provides opportunities for exceptional contributors to participate in profit sharing and, over time, potentially become equity owners of the firm.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume, cover letter, and academic transcript.

Learn more by exploring our website: www.cclimq.com

We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.

AI may be used to support certain stages of our screening & recruitment process. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment and decision-making.

Title: EA Sports FC Player Experience Analyst - FC Quality Verification
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

FC Live Platform Quality Verification is searching for the next game product expert to drive critical activities that support creating an optimal player experience and will be a key point of contact for decision-making from our stakeholders across production and development teams. The EA Sports FC Player Experience Analyst will report to the Development Manager.

This is a hybrid role, working at least 3 days a week in our Burnaby office.

Responsibilities


Create data-driven insights, reports and presentations to showcase trends and players' sentiment
Help promote game and experiential quality across FC by applying “the voice of the player"
Be an advocate of “the voice of the player” by creating a bridge between FC Live Platform Quality Verification and our partners
Promote improvements across functional quality; with a main focus on experiential quality
Monitor internal communication channels, public discussion forums, and social media platforms to help identify player-affecting issues and collect players' feedback
Coordinate with Production to prioritize recurring player feedback effectively


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience in Quality Assurance
4+ years of experience with testing and defect tracking software, preferably Jira
4+ years of experience with Agile/Scrum software development methodologies
Synthesize community feedback and player sentiment into clear, relevant insights that can be discussed with producers and Live Operations partners to improve the player experience
2+ years of experience writing reports and providing updates to stakeholders
Knowledge of gaming consoles and their systems
Experience using collaboration tools, preferably Confluence, Miro, and Slack
Experience working across different time zones and international teams
Understanding of football tactics and in-game strategies.
A genuine love for football as a fan, player, referee, gamer, or coach.
Please include a cover letter to let us know your love/knowledge of the FC game or football (soccer) as a sport.


Learn more about QD from some of our team members at Electronic Arts: Ravi Minhas | Jessica Myk | Rob Weber | Barbara Homewood

Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$77,700 - $107,900 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Title And Summary

Senior Specialist, Product Management – Attributes & Insights

Our Purpose

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion (https://www.mastercard.us/en-us/vision/who-we-are/diversity-inclusion.html) for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

About The Team

Mastercard Identity, within the Security Solutions organization, leads the development of products and services that enable global commerce, powers financial inclusion, prevents crime and makes some of the most seamless experiences possible.

As part of Mastercard Identity, the Attributes & Insights team drives the development and management of products, programs, and services focused on deterministic attribute verification. The team delivers significant value across the ecosystem, helping to combat new fraud and address regulatory requirements. Our vision is to deliver a single, rail-agnostic platform and a real-time suite of solutions.

Job Description

Role Overview

The Senior Specialist will support Account Status Inquiry (ASI) as a data-driven product manager focused on understanding customer usage, evaluating product performance, and translating insights into product actions. This role will analyze ASI adoption across regions, customers, segments, and use cases to identify growth opportunities, product improvements, and customer value drivers. The specialist will partner with regional, sales, engineering, and customer success teams to strengthen ASI reporting, support adoption, develop product documentation, and contribute to data-backed business cases for future enhancements. This role will help improve visibility into ASI utilization, identify underpenetrated customer and regional opportunities, and support roadmap decisions that drive adoption, customer value, and product growth.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong product knowledge of Account Status Inquiry and the broader Attribute & Insights suite of products, including customer use cases, product rules, transaction flows, and value drivers

Analyze ASI usage, transaction trends, customer behavior, regional performance, and segment-level adoption to identify growth opportunities, product improvement areas, and customer value drivers

Build and maintain KPI reporting and performance summaries that clearly communicate ASI usage, adoption, revenue opportunities, customer impact, and product performance trends

Translate data insights into product requirements, enhancement recommendations, business cases, best-practice use cases, and customer-facing value narratives

Support customer, regional, partner, and internal product/sales inquiries by using product knowledge and data analysis to diagnose trends, answer questions, and recommend next steps

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support successful product launches, enhancement delivery, reporting improvements, and operational readiness

Create and maintain product documentation, best practices, sales materials, operational processes, and customer enablement content

Required Skills And Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have experience in product management, payments, financial services, analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience analyzing transaction-level, customer, and usage data to inform product strategy. The candidate should possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable product insights.

Experience analyzing transaction-level, customer, or usage data to identify trends, anomalies, growth opportunities, and product improvement areas

Proficiency with SQL, advanced Excel, and dashboarding or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms

Ability to define product KPIs, build performance reporting, and communicate insights that inform product decisions and stakeholder discussions

Familiarity with statistical analysis or data science techniques, including trend analysis, segmentation, hypothesis testing, and data-driven decision making

Product management mindset with the ability to connect customer needs, product capabilities, usage trends, and business outcomes

Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data and product topics for business and technical audiences

Knowledge of transaction processing, card-not-present payments, authorization flows, or network products is a plus

Work Conditions: Some travel required

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.



In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

Pay Ranges

Toronto, Canada: $94,000 - $138,000 CAD

Vancouver, Canada: $94,000 - $138,000 CAD

Title: Compensation Analyst
Description:
We know it is our people who make us great at what we do.




We are looking for a compensation professional to support our growing compensation consulting team on several current and up coming client projects, and other initiatives. We are looking for someone, based in Vancouver or Toronto, with superb analytical and communication skills who is highly motivated, has a fine eye for detail, and can juggle multiple tasks and deliverables.




A typical day-in-the life of a Compensation Analyst involves meeting with clients, performing data analysis, understanding compensation trends to inform clients on compensation-related inquiries, and supporting internal projects. As a team member, you will work in partnership with the project managers to support clients all across Canada and gain exposure to the many areas of compensation practices including salary structure design, market analysis, job documentation and evaluation, executive pay, pay equity, salary surveys and many more!




If you are looking to take your HR and compensation career to the next level, this may be the right role for you!




This posting is for an existing vacancy that we are actively seeking to fill.




Roles and Responsibilities

Utilize Excel and other analysis tools to build compensation-related tools, dashboards, and analysis by adopting advanced techniques to compute and aggregate data, and conduct market comparisons
Interpret data and derive key market insights for clients and other reports
Support consulting team members on client projects by providing high-touch data analysis covering a wide-spread of broad compensation activities, including external market analysis using salary surveys, salary structure design, executive pay, incentive plan design, pay equity, and job evaluation
Conduct market benchmarking by reviewing client data, determining appropriate peer groups, and performing data compilation/aggregation among multiple sources, sectors, and industry databases
Collect, organize, track, and interpret client pay program information and policy material
Support national and custom external market compensation survey activities relating to questionnaire setup, create job capsules, survey tracking, database management, administration, data validation, and client communications
Help clients write job descriptions (JDs) by reviewing existing job documentation, organizational structures, JD templates, and conducting interviews
Support consultants on project management duties, including managing client documentation, coordination, scheduling, meeting note documentation, and general status tracking
Support the job evaluation process by reviewing and creating job descriptions and evaluating roles using a job evaluation methodology
Conduct research and perform financial analyses of industry sectors and client peer groups to understand business strategy, corporate performance, compensation, and rewards practices and trends
Support the team in preparation of client and business development-related presentations and executive reports; translate data into broader total rewards themes and recommendations, utilizing multiple applications including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint




What we offer

Collaborative and engaging atmosphere
Variety in work and ability to evolve and grow your career
Working with colleagues across Canada and across multiple practice areas
Opportunities to help build and evolve our practice
Competitive compensation in terms of salary, bonus and paid vacation time (commensurate with experience)
An entrepreneurial, collegial work environment
Hybrid work style and dress for your day approach

What you offer

0-2 years of relevant experience is preferred but not required. Previous co-op terms, internships, or other related experience will be considered an asset
Bachelor's degree specifically in Business, Commerce, Economics, or a related field (required) with a baseline understanding of the different organization structures
Analytical skills and basic proficiency in MS Excel (comfortable with lookups, pivot tables, and basic formulas) combined with a strong knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and database management
Strong oral and written communication skills including the ability to independently write a strong first draft report or insights presentation for clients
Strong desire to learn and develop through exposure to various projects and clients
Demonstrated ability to follow established standards and procedures
Ability to work in a team environment while managing multiple priorities and projects
Excellent interpersonal skills, strong verbal and written communication skills
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
Commitment to superior client satisfaction




Strong assets but not required

Prior co-op/ internship experience in data analysis, consulting, and/or compensation
Previous work experience in compensation with knowledge in market matching and benchmarking, job evaluation, job description writing, pay equity, or executive compensation
In the process of completing or willingness to complete the Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation
Bilingual in both English and French (reading, writing, and speaking)




Who we are:

At Eckler, we are driven by our purpose to care and to do right by people so that together we can achieve a brighter, more secure future. It’s just one of the reasons Eckler has been recognized multiple times as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures. Our origins go back to 1927, making us one of Canada’s first actuarial practices. Based in Canada and the Caribbean, we’re a team of committed and highly skilled professionals consulting in the areas of pension, retirement, financial wellness, investment, group benefits, insurance, change management and communication and technology. Owned and operated by its active Principals, the company has earned a reputation for service continuity and high professional standards. Eckler is a founding member of Abelica Global – an international alliance of independent actuarial and consulting firms operating in over 20 countries.




At Eckler, we value diversity of all types. Our organization is made up of smart, collaborative, and thoughtful people with a wide range of backgrounds, skills, and experiences. We are committed to an inclusive, diverse, and accessible workplace and encourage all interested applicants to submit a cover letter and resume for consideration. Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process or those needing job postings in an alternative format may e-mail a request to careers@eckler.ca.




Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used during the recruitment process to screen or assess applications. All evaluations involving AI are reviewed by in-house recruiters prior to making any final decisions.




We thank all applicants for their interest, but only those selected for the short list will be contacted.

www.eckler.ca

Title: Senior Associate, New Verticals - Canada Strategy & Operations
Description:
About the Team

New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores across the US and Canada. This team focuses on building our Canadian marketplace to ensure we are able to deliver exactly what consumers are looking for when they want it, with speed and quality.

About the Role

We are hiring a few Senior Associates on our Canada New Verticals Strategy & Operations. One role will focus on improving how we partner with our Dashers and driving efficiencies to how they operate. The second role will focus on driving quality improvements to our platform that enhances the shopping experience resulting in higher consumer spend. Both roles will require you to understand marketplace data and constraints to strategize actionable plans to improve efficiency levers impacting things like in-store navigation, in-app experience, dasher pay, pricing & promotions and so much more! These roles require you to understand our three-sided marketplace and the unit economics that impact our financial success all while balancing growth, cost and quality. You'll need to weigh both sides of that tradeoff in every lever you pull.

These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

You will report into a Manager on our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team and be an individual contributor position. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together. We have two positions so throughout the interview process, we will consider you for two roles and align on role fit throughout the interview process!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Strategize. From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.
Operate. Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.
Experiment. Design, launch, and share out operational experiments and product features that impact things like dynamic delivery windows, order batching, predictive ordering, in-app merchandising, etc.
Analyze. Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.
Build with AI. You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
Lead, collaborate and Influence. You'll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product, analytics and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.
Own. You will manage core metrics across Dashers or Consumers and be the DRI for the success of metrics ranging from acceptance rates, batch rates, subtotals, basket size and so many others!
Partner. Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and our US Logistics counterparts to share learnings and scale what works.


We're excited about you because…


You solve problems from first principles. You resist "this is how it's always been done" thinking.
You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.
You are an operator. You solve problems by actually understanding the problem.
You like data, and you let it win arguments. You're comfortable building complex SQL queries across multiple data sources and have experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools.
You're energized by AI tools — and you actively experiment with them. You don't wait to be told how to use a new tool; you're already exploring tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini and more. You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.
You're unafraid of uncharted territory. This role is still taking shape, and you're excited to help define it rather than inherit a fixed playbook.
You have 2-4+ years of experience. You've succeeded in high-performing cultures (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, startups or a related experience).
You have a completed Bachelor's Degree.


Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.

$97,000—$121,000 CAD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Title: Actuarial Analyst II
Description:
Why BCAA?

Feel proud of what you do and help shape the future of BC at a BC Top Employer. We’re driven by purpose – delivering peace of mind to one in three BC households with insurance, roadside assistance, auto repair, Evo Car Share and Evolve E-Bike Share. With a long history of keeping roads safe and giving back in ways that build stronger communities, we offer a wide variety of meaningful, rewarding careers that move BC forward.

We are currently hiring an Actuarial Analyst (Level I OR II) based in our Head Office in Burnaby.

Please note that this is a hybrid role based out of our Burnaby, BC office. Applicants who are not located within commuting distance of our Head Office or are not looking to relocate to the Greater Vancouver/Lower Mainland/Fraser Valley region will not be considered.

As an Actuarial Analyst (Level I OR II), you’ll play a key role in supporting pricing sophistication, underwriting capability, and product development for BCAA’s Property & Casualty insurance products. This role blends actuarial analysis with hands-on problem solving to deliver insights that enhance rating methodologies, support P&C portfolio performance, and strengthen decision-making across our insurance business.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone progressing through CAS actuarial exams who wants to grow in a collaborative, corporate environment. You’ll work closely with senior actuarial team members, contribute to research and predictive modeling projects, and gain valuable exposure to property and casualty insurance analysis, product design, and risk assessment.

Who you are:


You are analytical and detail-oriented, with a strong foundation in actuarial methods and insurance concepts.
You thrive on problem-solving and enjoy using data to uncover insights and develop practical solutions.
You are highly organized, capable of managing competing priorities with accuracy and focus.
You work well independently but also collaborate effectively in a team environment.
You’re motivated to continue writing CAS actuarial exams and building your actuarial career.
You communicate technical findings clearly, tailoring your message to both technical and non-technical audiences.



What you’ll do:


Contribute to the development of rating models and actuarial analyses to support product pricing and underwriting strategies.
Assist in preparing and reviewing actuarial studies, including loss ratio analysis, trend analysis, reinsurance governance, etc.
Work with senior team members to scope projects and establish appropriate actuarial or statistical approaches.
Extract, clean, and analyze internal and external data sources to build accurate actuarial datasets.
Document methodologies and summarize results in a clear, concise manner for senior actuaries and leadership.
Contribute to research projects to deepen understanding of insurance portfolio performance and emerging risks.
Continuously build actuarial knowledge while proactively sharing insights with team members.



What you bring:


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, or a related quantitative field.
Minimum 2 years of actuarial or analytical experience, ideally within insurance. Consideration will also be given to candidates with relevant project or internship experience.
Completion of at least 2 CAS actuarial exams, with continued progress towards an Associate designation.
Knowledge of actuarial concepts including pricing, reserving, and risk analysis.
Strong skills in statistical tools/languages such as R or Python.
Experience working with large datasets and databases, and the ability to query, merge, and prepare data this data.
Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences.
A proactive approach to problem solving, with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Experience with dashboarding/visualization tools such as PowerBI or Tableau.
Exposure to machine learning algorithms, clustering, or advanced predictive modeling.
Familiarity with insurance product development or regulatory filings.
Understanding of GIS or spatial analytics tools.
Bonus Skills & Experience:
Experience with predictive modeling or machine learning techniques applied to P&C insurance.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements impacting property and casualty insurance.
Knowledge of claims analytics, loss development, and reserving methodologies.
Exposure to reinsurance structures and their impact on portfolio management.



The salary range for this position is $75,363.00 to $103,624.44 and is determined via job-related knowledge, skills, experience, certifications, market demand and internal equity. In addition to base salary and BCAA benefits, this position is eligible for a performance bonus target of 9%, with the opportunity to earn up to 15%.

What we offer:


The chance to make a difference every day in the lives of British Columbians, BCAA Members and our communities.
Career and personal development to help you grow and reach your goals.
Incentives that recognize team and individual sales and performance.
Flexible benefits to support your health and lifestyle, and wellness dollars* to keep your body, mind and soul thriving.
A competitive rewards package including salary performance bonus programs, pension plan*, and more to help build your personal wealth.
Paid time off including vacation, and days for wellness, volunteering, and cultural, spiritual or religious connection.
BCAA membership, with valuable perks and Member savings on every day and special spending, from gas and coffee to clothes, sports and event tickets, and hotels.
Meaningful, rewarding work for a BC Top Employer known for putting people first and constantly building a better workplace for all our team members.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Strategic Analytics Coordinator to support the ongoing sustainment and optimization of Langara College’s Workday Student platform and related ERP systems. This hands-on role will work with business and technical teams to analyze requirements and issues, document solutions, support testing and releases, and provide production support. The successful candidate will have experience with Workday Student or a comparable ERP/SIS environment, with knowledge of one or more student-related functional areas such as Admissions, Records, Registration, Curriculum, or Advising. Experience with requirements analysis, data analysis, testing, documentation, or application support is preferred. Exposure to Workday configuration, business processes, security, integrations, Agile/Scrum, or CRM platforms is an asset.

Job Description

Duties & Responsibilities


Works in partnership with Strategic Analytic Consultants (SAC)’s to analyze current processes, future requirements and the gaps that exist between current information system capabilities and future requirements.
Supports a range of projects that involve objective and comprehensive business analytics, data analysis, research, business process reviews/re-engineering and management reporting and for providing recommendations.
Supports SAC’s in enhancing and optimizing Workday configurations in improving processes and enabling them through use of the Workday platform and automation.
Documents business processes, business scenarios, detailed business requirements.
Develops testing strategies, including writing and coordination of test script execution within Workday.
Supports business process development, setup modifications, integrations, security, and overall maintenance of Workday.
Creates and maintains simple system configuration and troubleshooting of business processes.
Assist with bi-annual releases, including analysis of impacts of new functionality, testing, integrations and cross-functional up and downstream analysis.
Prepares in depth business and analytical reports.
Synthesizes and consolidates complex information into succinct and meaningful written and verbal management reporting, leveraging productivity tools such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Works cross-functionally to develop management productivity tools such as dashboards, apps, reports etc. in order to improve operational performance.
Triages, assesses, prioritizes, and resolves Workday end-user tickets and provides Tier 1 ITSM coverage on as needed basis.
Actively promotes best practices in the security and privacy of personal information and data; makes recommendations to improve processes and procedures where necessary.
Solicits feedback from manager and SAC’s and respective stakeholders, fostering an agile, innovative, and collaborative environment. Partners with relevant stakeholders to resolve issues related to engagement, adoption, sustainment, and continuous improvement.
Analyzes, troubleshoots, and diagnoses root causes and applies appropriate solutions to restore end-user issues.
Develops Tier 0/1 content materials to enhance knowledge base and keep information accurate and current; prepares and maintains service centre documentation is accordance with prescribed standards.
Performs other related duties as assigned.


Qualifications Required

Education & Experience


Degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or related discipline.
Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a similar role includes system support, analysis, and ERP implementation.
An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
Superior analytical, problem-solving and system analysis skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office suite with intermediate knowledge of Excel.
Experience working in customer service environments.
Experience with an ITSM and JIRA system is an asset.
Experience working with integrated corporate HRIS such as Workday or similar cloud-based ERP preferred.


Skills & Abilities


Strong attention to detail.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills. Strong analytical mind; demonstrated critical thinking and analytic skills with strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
Excellent collaborator and a team player.
Well-developed root-cause analytical skills with the ability to configure and troubleshoot issues and defects.
Ability to communicate with stakeholders of varying technical ability and subject matter expertise.
Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess the clients’ needs and situation.
Ability to prioritize workload and provide timely follow-up and resolution.
Ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and priorities while working under pressure to meet critical, time sensitive deadlines.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

At Langara College, we support the College’s vision of promoting wellness and fostering personal and professional growth for our employees. We are dedicated to embracing, honouring, and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion, while offering a competitive and inclusive benefits package that reflects our commitment to overall health, financial security, and work-life balance.

🎨 OpusClip is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.

We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 20 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.

We have raised $50 million in total funding and are fortunate to have some of the most supportive investors, including SoftBank Vision Fund, DCM Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, Fellows Fund, AI Grant, Jason Lemkin (SaaStr), Samsung Next, GTMfund, Alumni Ventures, and many more.

Check out our latest coverage by Business Insider featuring our product and funding milestones, and our recognition as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2024.

Headquartered In Mountain View, We Are a Team Of 100 Passionate And Experienced AI Enthusiasts And Video Experts, Driven By Our Core Values


Be a Champion Team
Prioritize Ruthlessly
Ship fast, Quality Follows
Obsess over customers


Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

About The Role

OpusClip is looking for a product-oriented Data Scientist to help us build trusted metrics, improve data quality, and turn complex product and customer data into clear business decisions.

Title: Senior Analyst, Fulfillment Inventory Management
Description:
This is a high-impact role at the intersection of inventory, analytics, supply chain and strategy, with significant visibility across the organization. You will build models and turn complex data into actionable insights, identify risks and opportunities, and help drive meaningful business results.

The ideal person is a self-starter and strong program manager who can bring clarity to complex, cross-functional initiatives, build alignment across teams, and turn strategy into execution. A consulting background combined with strong retail or supply chain experience would be particularly relevant. There is also a strong continuous-improvement mandate - this is someone who will challenge how things are done and find better ways to drive results.

This is a contract through January 2028.




Who – The Company:

Our client is one of Vancouvers most sought-after companies to work for, with global operations and an impeccable reputation.




What- The Role:

The Fulfillment Inventory Management team plays a critical role in maintaining inventory health, optimizing network capacity, enabling strategic inventory placement across the NAM fulfillment network, and ensuring the timely exit of end‑of‑life inventory. They partner closely with a broad range of cross‑functional teams to deliver on investment commitments while governing the processes that support effective inventory management and end‑of‑life execution.

They design and evolve core operational processes, lead governance routines, strengthen organizational connectivity, and generate data‑driven insights that fuel continuous improvement and risk mitigation. Through consistent and scalable governance frameworks, we drive efficient, standardized inventory practices that improve product availability, maximize DC space utilization, and minimize impacts on DC operations.

This role will lead a team to deliver on key mandates and financial commitments in a highly cross-functional area.

Lead and influence cross‑functional forums (analyst through director level) to enhance collaboration and partnership in support of shared operational, financial, and strategic outcomes.
Build complex operational–financial models that quantify process impacts, identify key drivers and KPIs, evaluate scenarios, surface risks, and recommend actionable improvements.
Partner across the network to improve inventory health, accelerate end‑of‑life inventory turnover, and optimize DC space utilization and overall operational efficiency.
Drive cross‑functional KPI improvements (e.g. inventory health, capacity, labor efficiency) by leading root cause analysis, quantifying possible levers to improve, and enabling teams with the right data, tools, and governance routines to support strategic prioritization and accountable execution.
Analyze large, complex datasets (Excel, Power BI, and related tools) to generate timely, accurate insights to support operational and financial decisions.
Support a multi-million dollar savings portfolio by creating and enabling processes and tactical execution plans, leveraging strong cross-team communication and influencing skills to proactively identify risks and develop initial risk mitigation strategies.
Support existing processes and enable new optimizations by creating integrated tools that provide transparent KPI visibility and faster, more effective issue escalation and resolution.
Continuously optimize current-state fulfillment processes to improve accuracy, speed, and alignment with evolving business priorities and strategic direction.




Who- the Candidate:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Supply chain or similar; Analytics is an asset; MBA or CPA preferred
5-8 years of experience, preferably in consulting, strategy or equivalent experience with product/supply chain internal function within a large corporation
4+ years of experience working within a highly cross-functional team
Proven ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects with varying timelines and scopes; including ability to plan, budget and manage project execution
Self-starter approach to work, with an eagerness to consistently meet and exceed objectives and foster this within your team
Excellent attention to detail given the complex nature of the work and the high exposure of the content across various groups and leadership
Creative thinking and excellent problem-solving skills – must be able to solve problems in a new way, seeing past what is established and create a new way of doing things
Demonstrated ability to create clarity and drive alignment towards a common goal and across team members in various functions
Advanced proficiency with MS PowerPoint, Excel, Word necessary. Experience using Power BI is an asset
Strong process documentation skills and excellent spoken and written communication skills (verbal and non-verbal)




How much:

Competitive hourly wage in the range of $55-57.50/hr + 4% vacation pay, if incorporated, please discuss with Swim.




Where:

Vancouver, hybrid working conditions, minimum 3 days onsite.




When & How To Apply:

Title: Fraud Prevention Analyst
